izzyondroid:com.cho3ek89.ChronoRover.name: ChronoRover
izzyondroid:com.cho3ek89.ChronoRover.summary: Accurate time signal generator for radio-controlled watches.
izzyondroid:com.cho3ek89.ChronoRover.description:
ChronoRover is a precise time signal generator that emulates official long-wave time broadcasts to synchronize radio-controlled watches with atomic accuracy using your phone’s speaker or headphones.
 Among the currently supported signals are: DCF77 (Germany), MSF (United Kingdom), WWVB (United States), JJY (Japan), and BPC (China).
 Whether you’re a watch enthusiast, collector, or simply want the most accurate time possible, ChronoRover turns your smartphone into a portable time signal transmitter.
 Perfect solution for Casio and Citizen owners who live beyond the range of any official time signal transmission station!
 CAUTION! This application generates loud, high-pitched noises that may cause discomfort or potential hearing damage! Leave the room while transmission is active.

izzyondroid:com.darkrockstudios.apps.ham.name: Hammer
izzyondroid:com.darkrockstudios.apps.ham.summary: A simple tool for building stories.
izzyondroid:com.darkrockstudios.apps.ham.description:
Please join our Discord to report issues! https://discord.gg/GTmgjZcupk
 Multi-platform
 This app is where ever you are. Your phone, tablet, desktop, laptop, this program can be installed and run, not simply a website-in-a-box, but instead using native client side technologies to provide the best experience possible.
 Offline first
 I was frustrated with most of the story writing software I was finding as they were using web technologies (aka: Web Page in a box) which always seems to run into problems while being used offline for long periods of time. Hammer is designed from the ground up to be entirely local, no internet connection required, ever.
 Transparent Data
 Your data is yours. It's not stored in the cloud, or some opaque database. It is stored in simple, human readable files, just using files and folders to define the project structure. You can open your OSes file browser and take a look for your self. If this program went away today you would be able to easily interact with your data.
 Intelligent Syncing between devices
 Your data can be synchronized between devices allowing you to work on your story from anywhere, and have no fear of a change on one device, overwriting a change on another device.
 Optional and Self hosted Syncing
 Syncing is entirely optional, you can install the client and use it on one device, or you can install the server and sync your data between devices.
 Wear OS companion
 Capture notes and story ideas from your wrist with the Wear OS app, then pick them up on your other devices. Dictate or type a quick note and file it under a project. Add the Capture tile to start a note or story idea in a single tap, or put the Hammer complication on your watch face to open a new note. The watch app syncs through your Hammer sync server.

izzyondroid:de.buttercookie.disabletarge.name: Disable Target API Block
izzyondroid:de.buttercookie.disabletarge.summary: Xposed module for disabling Android 14's installation block for old apps
izzyondroid:de.buttercookie.disabletarge.description:
On Android 14, Google started blocking old apps (those targeting a target API lower than 23, i.e. anything before Marshmallow/Android 6) from being installed.
 While this behaviour can be overridden by calling adb install (respectively pm install if you've got access to a root shell on your device) with the --bypass-low-target-sdk-block flag, it still breaks simple manual installation of older APKs, as well as any backup apps and other software like that which hasn't yet been updated for this new behaviour.
 This Xposed module hooks the app installation process to always behave as if that flag had been passed and to therefore generally allow installation of old apps.

fdroid:ac.mdiq.podcini.X.name: Podcini.X - Podcast instrument
fdroid:ac.mdiq.podcini.X.summary: Modern, feature-rich, without access to Youtube
fdroid:ac.mdiq.podcini.X.description:
Podcini, an open source podcast instrument, attuned to Puccini, adorned with pasticcini and aromatized with porcini, invites your harmonious heartbeats.
Do I hear your heartbeats? Great!
Common functionalities of a podcast player are well-supported:
 Search, discover and subscribe to podcasts, by keywords, simple RSS URLs, or OPML files.
 Download, stream or queue episodes, and enjoy them the way you like with adjustable playback speeds.
 Save effort, battery power and mobile data usage with powerful automation controls for auto-downloading/auto-enqueuing episodes.
 If the feed contains no media (plain RSS feed), Text-to-Speech engine is used to play the text.
 Listening progress can be instantly synced through a NextCloud server or across devices in the same Wi-Fi network without a server.
So what's special with this podcast app among the many?
Well, aside from doing the above well, the following make it stand out:
 It's open sourced, free to use and free of ads, free as in beer and free as in speech!
 It takes advantage of modern frameworks to be efficient and conserve energy.
 In addition to subscriptions, it allows you to create your own synthetic podcasts to compile your interested episodes from various sources to better focus on your interests.
 While the list of episodes (filtered and sorted by you) in each podcast serves a natural playlist for you, it also empowers you with multiple queues each associable with any podcasts to group similar contents for better listening.
 On any podcast/episode, you can assign 5 levels of rating allowing you to make better decisions on where to put your attention.
 You have 12 levels of play states (like to play soon, play again, etc) to better plan and enhance your listening experiences.
 You can also keep your personal notes with your opinions/comments on each podcast/episode.
 It has sophisticated sorting and filtering options for you to better select contents.
 When you unsubscribe a podcast, it allows you to preserve your important episodes of the podcast in a synthetic feed.
 It keeps a record of your unsubscribed podcasts and notifies you if you unknowingly try to re-subscribe to some.
 It caches streamed audio for seamless local rewind and replay.
 You can record audio clips or mark positions on any episodes for better review.
 You can also set selected episodes related for better grouping.
 Sure, you can play any episodes in your car's speakers.
 And, it's not all about audio, video is well handled.
 You can cast the audio/video to Chromecast speakers/screens.
Some other podcast players can also do all of the above?
 Join the Podcini community! 
Podcini is under active development by volunteers.
You can contribute too, with code, comments or improvements.
See source code on github.com/XilinJia/Podcini.X

fdroid:com.gurkenwerfer.calyx.name: Calyx - Grow Tracker
fdroid:com.gurkenwerfer.calyx.summary: Track indoor gardens, plant schedules, and hardware entirely offline.
fdroid:com.gurkenwerfer.calyx.description:
Calyx tracks indoor garden environments, plant schedules, and hardware. Commercial alternatives lock features behind cloud subscriptions and isolate data from local smart devices. Calyx stores its 30,000-strain database entirely offline and integrates directly with Home Assistant to control grow room sockets without a monthly fee.
 Environment and hardware control 
The application queries the Home Assistant REST API to display temperature, relative humidity, and Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD). Users toggle smart sockets directly from the application interface. Calyx also monitors for light bleed during scheduled dark periods and pushes an alert if it detects illumination.
 Plant and tent management 
Users define physical grow tents and assign plants to them. The application references an offline database of 30,000 strains. When a user logs a plant, an automatic calculator uses the strain genetics to determine the optimal harvest window. Growers capture and view chronological photos in a full-screen gallery overlay, which renders the days since germination and current growth phase on the image.
 Feeding and scheduling 
The application provides a nutrient solution recipe database to store feeding mixtures. Users assign custom quick actions, such as pruning or nutrient application, to individual plants. Tapping a nutrient action automatically attaches a specific recipe and liquid volume to the plant's history. A soil moisture reading below 30% places a watering indicator on the calendar.
 Standalone and self-hosted options 
The application runs as a standalone tool, writing records to a local SQLite database. Growers who require multi-device synchronization can deploy the provided Docker container to connect the application to a self-hosted backend.

fdroid:com.jordanadema.nebula.name: Nebula HDR screensaver
fdroid:com.jordanadema.nebula.description:
A deep-space nebula rendered in real-time volumetric raymarching on the GPU. The camera flies through translucent clouds of emissive gas, sculpted by a tiling 3D noise field with Worley erosion and lit by gradient relief, shell halos, and ionization-front rims.
The palette centres on deep violet and indigo, with magenta and cool-blue accents. Foreground masses occlude background stars with true depth. Dense star clusters glow as pointillistic distant galaxies, and the brightest stars throw subtle aperiodic HDR flares with four-point diffraction spikes.
A split-resolution pipeline keeps stars pin-sharp at native resolution while the gas runs at an adaptive lower resolution. Each screensaver activation randomises the camera path, nebula formation, and star field so no two sessions look alike.
Features:
- Volumetric raymarching through a 3D noise field
- HDR output with automatic SDR fallback
- Configurable render resolution, frame rate, and zoom speed
- Burn-in safe: every element moves or cross-fades, so no pixel holds a static image
- No network access, no ads, no tracking
Optimized for the NVIDIA Shield and HDR displays, but runs on any Android phone or TV with a sufficiently powerful GPU.

Core features include work-profile setup, a searchable work-app list, freeze and unfreeze, launch, application details, and user-confirmed uninstall. Harbor contains no advertising, analytics, accounts, or network access.
Optional Advanced tools integrate with a separately installed Shizuku service for local diagnostics, cloning eligible installed packages with Android's install-existing operation, and experimental multiple full-user workspaces. Core isolation and management never require Shizuku.

fdroid:com.safrone.trackexploder.name: Track Exploder
fdroid:com.safrone.trackexploder.summary: Extract, remix, and practise with barbershop learning tracks
fdroid:com.safrone.trackexploder.description:
Track Exploder turns part-predominant barbershop learning tracks into the practice mix you need.
Load the tenor, lead, baritone, and bass files for a song. The app extracts the isolated voice from each stereo track, aligns the parts automatically, and gives you a four-part mixer.
Use Track Exploder to:
 solo your part or leave it out to sing against the other voices
 adjust each part's level, stereo position, channel, mute, and inclusion
 preview the mix with per-part waveforms
 slow practice audio to 0.5× without changing its pitch
 save reusable mix presets
 export one mix or generate several mixes in bulk
 write WAV and FLAC files while preserving shared source tags
Publishers do not always place the song at exactly the same point in every part file. Track Exploder measures the set and corrects those offsets automatically while keeping spoken introductions and pitch pipes together. Each part's adjustment remains visible and can be fine-tuned manually.
All audio processing happens on your device. Track Exploder has no accounts, advertising, analytics, tracking, or servers, and it does not upload your music.
Track Exploder is free and open-source software released under the MIT License.

Unlike traditional messaging apps, Briar doesn't rely on a central server - messages are synchronized directly between the users' devices.

fdroid:run.moritz.howmany.name: how many? - Count from Photo
fdroid:run.moritz.howmany.description:
How many pipes are in that stack? How many coins on the table, windows on the building, fish in the tank? Take a photo, mark one object, and how many? counts all the others.
How it works
1. Take a photo or pick one from your gallery.
2. Drag a box around one of the objects you want to count.
3. Tap GO. how many? finds and marks every object that looks like it.
4. Check the result: tap a point to remove a wrong one, or tap an object to add one that was missed. Drag the edges to count only part of the photo.
Count anything
how many? isn't trained on a fixed list of things. You show it what to count, so it works on pipes, boards, screws, nuts, pills, coins, eggs, fruit, bottles, books, birds, windows, tiles and much more, even with hundreds or a thousand objects in one photo.
Private by design
Counting runs entirely on your phone. The app has no internet permission, so your photos never leave the device. No account, no ads, no tracking.
Free and open source
how many? is free software under the MIT license. It counts with GeCo2, a few-shot counting model by Jer Pelhan, Alan Lukežič and Matej Kristan, run on the phone with ONNX Runtime.
Good to know
Counting takes a few seconds and works best when the objects are clearly visible, not too small and photographed in good light. The count is a starting point: a few taps usually fix it. how many? needs a 64-bit ARM phone with Android 12 or newer.
Source code, questions and feature requests: https://github.com/EiSiMo/howmany

flathub:org.libretro.RetroArch.name: RetroArch
flathub:org.libretro.RetroArch.summary: Frontend for emulators, game engines and media players
flathub:org.libretro.RetroArch.description:
RetroArch enables you to run classic games on a wide range of computers and consoles through
 its slick graphical interface. Settings are also unified so configuration is done once and for
 all.
 RetroArch has advanced features like shaders, netplay, rewinding, next-frame response times,
 runahead, and more!

flathub:org.libvips.vipsdisp.name: Vipsdisp
flathub:org.libvips.vipsdisp.description:
Vipsdisp can display huge (many, many gigabyte) images quickly and without
using much memory.
As well as the usual PNG, JPG, TIF, PDF, SVG, WEBP, JP2, JXL, QOI and GIF,
it supports many scientific and technical image formats, including SVS,
MRXS, OpenEXR, FITS, Matlab, NIfTI, Analyze, and PFM. It supports and 
translates HDR metadata between JPG, PNG, AVIF and JXL, though there's no 
HDR display yet.
Vipsdisp supports pixel types from 1 bit mono to 128-bit double precision
complex, you can convert image formats, it support copy-paste and drag-drop,
and it has a range of useful visualisation tools and display modes.
vipsdisp includes a very simple "paintbox" you can use to annotate images.
It can paint on images in all these numeric formats.

flathub:zone.dos.Browser.name: DOS Browser
flathub:zone.dos.Browser.summary: Browser with built-in acceleration for DOS/Win9x games
flathub:zone.dos.Browser.description:
DOS Browser is a specialized, lightweight browser designed with retro computing enthusiasts in mind. 
 It features hardware acceleration specifically optimized for DOS/Win9x-based games, allowing them to run more 
 efficiently and at much higher speeds compared to standard browsers like Chrome. 
 Whether you’re exploring DOS applications, playing classic games, or navigating retro-themed websites, 
 DOS Browser ensures a smoother and more enjoyable experience.
 Install DOS Browser from Flathub today and rediscover the golden era of computing 
 with cutting-edge enhancements for your classic favorites!

fedora-packages:ghc-text-short/ghc-text-.description: This package provides the 'ShortText' type which is suitable for keeping many short strings in memory. This is similiar to how 'ShortByteString' relates to 'ByteString'. The main difference between 'Text' and 'ShortText' is that 'ShortText' uses UTF-8 instead of UTF-16 internally and also doesn't support zero-copy slicing (thereby saving 2 words). Consequently, the memory footprint of a (boxed) 'ShortText' value is 4 words (2 words when unboxed) plus the length of the UTF-8 encoded payload.

fedora-packages:cmocka/libcmocka.summary: Lightweight library to simplify and generalize unit tests for C
fedora-packages:cmocka/libcmocka.description: There are a variety of C unit testing frameworks available however many of them are fairly complex and require the latest compiler technology. Some development requires the use of old compilers which makes it difficult to use some unit testing frameworks. In addition many unit testing frameworks assume the code being tested is an application or module that is targeted to the same platform that will ultimately execute the test. Because of this assumption many frameworks require the inclusion of standard C library headers in the code module being tested which may collide with the custom or incomplete implementation of the C library utilized by the code under test. CMocka only requires a test application is linked with the standard C library which minimizes conflicts with standard C library headers. Also, CMocka tries to avoid the use of some of the newer features of C compilers. This results in CMocka being a relatively small library that can be used to test a variety of exotic code. If a developer wishes to simply test an application with the latest compiler then other unit testing frameworks may be preferable. This is the successor of Google's Cmockery.

firefox-addons:3021624.name: Idira Secure Web Sessions
firefox-addons:3021624.summary: Protect web-apps with Idira Secure Web Sessions. Offers step-recording, continuous authentication, session control and session protection.
firefox-addons:3021624.description:
Protect web-apps with Idira Secure Web Sessions. Offers step-recording, continuous authentication, and session protection.
Idira Identity Secure Web Sessions is a cloud-based service that gives you the ability to record and audit user activity within web applications accessible through Idira Identity. Web applications protected by Secure Web Sessions are protected from malicious processes originating on endpoints, and all actions performed by end-users can be searched down to a users' exact clicks. Further, with Secure Web Sessions, customers can enable continuous authentication that monitors user behavior patterns and enforces reauthentication when anomalous activity is detected.
Idira Identity Secure Web Sessions enables you to:
 Record every step: User actions inside web applications, including mouse clicks and 
 keystrokes, are captured using screenshots along with the relevant browser metadata.
 Create audit trail: The captured activity data is saved in a secure location to provide context 
 and auditable step-by-step breakdown of in-app events.
 Set up continuous authentication: User activity is continuously analyzed to ensure that the 
 person who initiated the web session is the person using the application. If anomalous activity 
 is detected, users are prompted for additional authentication.
 Protect sessions: High-risk web sessions are protected from malicious processes originating 
 on the endpoint using the browser extension.
 Create automatic remediation rules for any component within any application via simple "If-Then" rules.

 How it works:

firefox-addons:2991419.name: KEKW Blocker
firefox-addons:2991419.summary: Twitch ad blocker with self-healing config and playback recovery.
firefox-addons:2991419.description:
KEKW Blocker is a Twitch-focused ad blocker for Firefox.
It blocks Twitch ads primarily by intercepting Twitch's player worker, requesting backup player variants, and switching to a clean stream when ad markers appear. When Twitch playback becomes unstable around ad transitions, the extension also applies stream recovery logic to reduce stalls, loops, and commercial-break overlays.
Key features:
 backup player switching for pre-roll and mid-roll ads
 adaptive pre-warming to reduce recovery latency
 stitched ad-segment fallback handling
 buffering and commercial-break recovery
 optional ad-tracking blocking
 auto-claim for Twitch channel points
 signed remote configuration with runtime fallback logic to keep Twitch request constants current
This extension is intended only for Twitch pages and related Twitch media endpoints.

firefox-addons:2729491.description:
This extension identifies and highlights Amazon brands and exclusive products in orange as your shop online.
Amazon has registered more than 150 brands with the U.S. Trademark and Patent Office and sells hundreds of thousands of items under these names and in exclusive deals with other brands. But we found the company often doesn’t inform shoppers that an item is from an Amazon brand or exclusive. Few Americans can identify top-selling Amazon brands.
So we wanted to provide transparency for shoppers.
This extension works on Amazon.com and Amazon domains in Australia ( amazon.com.au ), Canada ( amazon.ca ), Germany ( amazon.de ), India ( amazon.in ), Italy ( amazon.it ), Japan ( amazon.co.jp ), Mexico ( amazon.com.mx ), Spain ( amazon.es ), and The United Kingdom ( amazon.co.uk ). The extension also works on Amazon Smile.
We don’t collect your data. We won’t know if you used this extension, what you shopped for or what you bought.
See something wrong? Let us know at amazon-extension@themarkup.org

firefox-addons:3052959.name: amasamya-accessibility-audit
firefox-addons:3052959.summary: Blind-first WCAG 2.2, GIGW 3.0, IS 17802 accessibility audit tool. VPAT export, site crawler, visual diffs. Alt Shift 1 to run.
firefox-addons:3052959.description:
AMASAMYA ACCESSIBILITY AUDIT, FIREFOX ADD-ON
USER GUIDE FOR SIGHTED AND SCREEN-READER USERS
What this add-on does?
AMASAMYA is an accessibility audit tool for the current web page. When you run an audit, the add-on scans the page against WCAG 2.2, GIGW 3.0, and IS 17802 rules, and shows the results in a Firefox sidebar. Every result row is keyboard operable, every state change is announced via a polite or assertive screen-reader live region, and the results table exposes the affected element in each row's aria-label so you hear which component failed without expanding the row.
HOW TO INSTALL
Open the add-on's page on addons.mozilla.org : https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/amasamya-accessibility-audit/ 
Activate the Add to Firefox button. Firefox will ask you to confirm the permissions. Confirm.
The AMASAMYA button appears in the Firefox toolbar. Your screen reader announces "AMASAMYA Audit Results, button" when it gets focus.
HOW TO RUN AN AUDIT, WITH THE KEYBOARD
Method one, the fastest, Alt plus Shift plus 1:
Press Alt plus Shift plus 1 on the page you want to audit. The sidebar opens and the audit runs on the current page.
If the shortcut does not work, Firefox may not have auto-assigned it. Go to about:addons, activate the Extensions tab, activate the tools menu next to Manage Your Extensions, and pick Manage Extension Shortcuts. Find AMASAMYA in the list, and set the shortcut for "Run AMASAMYA accessibility audit on the current page" to Alt plus Shift plus 1 (or any combination you prefer that Firefox accepts).
Method two, keyboard equivalent of activating the toolbar button:
Press F6 to move focus from the page to the browser chrome. Repeat F6 until your screen reader announces the extensions toolbar or the AMASAMYA button by name. Press Enter. The sidebar opens and the audit runs.
Method three, right-click on the AMASAMYA button:
Focus the AMASAMYA button in the toolbar. Press the Applications key (or Shift plus F10) to open the context menu. Choose Manage Extension to reach the settings page for the add-on.
HOW A SCREEN READER USES THE ADD-ON
Screen reader tested: NVDA and JAWS on Windows Firefox 128 ESR and later.
Sequence of what you hear when you press Alt plus Shift plus 1 on a web page:
Step one. Firefox opens the sidebar. Focus stays on the page's active element (Firefox behaviour, not something the add-on controls).
Step two. The audit runs. The sidebar's polite live region announces: "Audit running on [page title]. Please wait." within 1 second.
Step three. The audit completes. The polite live region announces: "Audit complete. N findings. M failures, K warnings." Typically 2 to 8 seconds after the audit starts.
Step four. Press F6 to move focus into the sidebar. Your screen reader announces the sidebar's landmark and the first heading, which is the summary card for Failures.
Step five. Use H (in browse mode) or arrow keys to navigate through the summary cards (Failures, Warnings, Passes, Info, Total) and then into the Findings table.
Step six. In the Findings table, use table-navigation shortcuts (Ctrl plus Alt plus arrow keys in NVDA and JAWS) to move cell by cell. Each row's aria-label includes the finding ID, engine, verdict, severity, issue, and affected element (a CSS selector). So arrowing down rows tells you which component failed without expanding the row.
Step seven. To expand a finding for full detail, land on the "More detail" button in the row and press Enter or Space. The screen reader announces "Finding detail expanded" and you can Tab into the expanded content to read Element, Criterion, Computed, Required, and How to Fix.
Step eight. To export the report, activate one of the Export buttons in the Export toolbar: JSON, HTML, Accessible PDF, CSV, or Text. The Accessible PDF opens a print-ready report in a new tab and auto-triggers the print dialog. Choose Save as PDF as the destination.
TABS AND LANDMARKS INSIDE THE SIDEBAR
The sidebar has four panels reachable via the tab strip at the top:
Panel one, WCAG. The default. Shows the findings table, filters, and export toolbar.
Panel two, Visual. Shows the Visual Layout Auditor results. Note that on Firefox this panel is limited compared to Chrome, because Firefox does not expose the debugger permission the way Chromium browsers do. Some visual checks are skipped.
Panel three, Settings. Contains the extension's configuration.
Panel four, Site Crawl. Shows the site-wide crawl results if you have run a crawl.
Landmarks inside the sidebar: main content, tab list, the export toolbar, the findings table region, and the polite and assertive live regions.
KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS SUMMARY
Alt plus Shift plus 1. Run the audit on the current page. Opens the sidebar and starts the scan.
F6. Move focus between the page and the browser chrome.
Tab and Shift plus Tab. Move between interactive elements inside the sidebar.
Ctrl plus Alt plus arrow keys (NVDA and JAWS). Move cell by cell inside the findings table.
Space or Enter on a finding row's More detail button. Expand or collapse the row's detail.
Alt plus PageUp and Alt plus PageDown inside the sidebar (Firefox default). Switch between the four panels.
Escape. Does not close the sidebar. To close the sidebar, activate the AMASAMYA toolbar button again (or press Alt plus Shift plus 1 again if that is your shortcut).
IF THE SHORTCUT DOES NOT WORK ON YOUR FIREFOX
Firefox may not automatically pick up the manifest's suggested shortcut if you installed the add-on before v5.3.3, or if another add-on already claims Alt plus Shift plus 1.
To assign the shortcut manually:
Open about:addons.
Activate the Extensions tab in the left navigation.
Activate the tools menu near the top (the gear icon on the sighted layout is labelled "Tools for all add-ons" for your screen reader).
Activate the Manage Extension Shortcuts item.
Find AMASAMYA in the list.
For the "Run AMASAMYA accessibility audit on the current page" command, activate the shortcut input.
Press Alt plus Shift plus 1. The input records the combination.
Close the Manage Extension Shortcuts page.
The shortcut now works.
IF THE ADD-ON DOES NOT RUN ON A PAGE
The add-on cannot audit pages served from Firefox internal URLs (about:, moz-extension:, resource:, view-source:, or the Firefox add-on store itself). If you try to run an audit on one of these, the polite live region announces the reason.
To audit an internal page, save the rendered HTML to a file, host it on a local server (or as a data URL), and audit that.
REPORT A BUG OR SEND FEEDBACK
Email akhilesh@amasamya.com . Include the page URL, the screen reader and Firefox version, and the exact keyboard step that produced the problem. Screenshots are optional; a text description of what the screen reader said (or did not say) is more useful.
CREDITS
Built by Akhilesh Malani, a blind accessibility architect. Every keyboard flow and every screen-reader announcement in this add-on was tested by the author using NVDA and JAWS on Windows Firefox before shipping.

bluejetty:00021372:android.description:
🏆 WicketScore is the ultimate app for cricket fans and bettors alike! 🏆
🏏 Experience the thrill of cricket anytime, anywhere with WicketScore! Stay up to date with instant updates, live cricket scores, engaging commentary, and valuable stats, ensuring you never miss a moment of the action.
----------
WICKETSCORE – HIGHLIGHTS & FEATURES
----------
• Super-fast updates, live scores and detailed scorecards
• Comprehensive domestic and international coverage
• Ball-by-ball commentary
• Dark mode
• In-depth analysis of individual matches
• Detailed stats – head-to-head comparisons, manhattan charts and worm charts
• Schedules for all upcoming series and tournaments
• User-friendly interface with dark mode feature
• Cricket predictions and polls
• Live odds for cricket matches
• Customisable notifications and alerts
• Personalised page with your favourite matches, teams, and competitions
FULL DOMESTIC & WORLDWIDE COVERAGE
Cricket is one of the most popular sports in England, and WicketScore understands that passion by providing you with the most comprehensive coverage of all cricket tournaments, including the County Championship, The Hundred, Vitality Blast, Royal London One-Day Cup, and other domestic leagues. With WicketScore, you'll never miss a match, score, or update related to your favourite English teams and players.
WicketScore also provides extensive coverage for international tournaments like World Cup, World Test Championship, and other domestic cricket tournaments like the Indian Premier League (IPL), Pakistan Super League (PSL), Big Bash League (CPL), Caribbean Premier League (CPL), Bangladesh Premier League (BPL) and more. 
HISTORICAL CRICKET SCORES & DATA
Explore a wealth of cricket history with WicketScore! Get access to years' worth of cricket scores, stats, and information with just a few taps. 
Whether you're curious about past matches, you’re researching bets or want to satisfy your historical cricket cravings, WicketScore has it all.
REALTIME UPDATES
Get lightning-fast updates and live cricket scores! Our app provides real-time statistics and information, so you can stay up-to-date and make informed decisions on your bets. 
We strive to deliver the fastest and most accurate updates to keep you in the loop and ahead of the game.

bluejetty:00170215:ios.description:
Love freebies? You're in the right place.
Influenster partners with leading brands to send you their newest products to try for free. From makeup and skincare to electronics and pet supplies, there’s something for everyone. We're talking full-size products, exclusive samples, and special offers on items you already love. All we ask in return is that you share your honest opinion.
How it works:
1. Download & Sign Up: Get the app and create your free account.
2. Complete Your Profile: Tell us about yourself and review products you've already tried.
3. Claim Free Products: Once you're eligible for a program, you'll receive a notification to claim your free product!
4. Complete Tasks: Once your product arrives, follow the simple instructions in the app. This could be writing a review, posting on social media, or taking a photo.
Frequently Asked Questions:
Is Influenster really free?
Yes! You'll never pay for the products we send you, and we'll never ask for your payment information.
What kind of products can I get?
Almost everything! We offer products for personal care, beauty, home, pets, tools and the latest tech.
Do I need to connect my social accounts?
It’s optional, but members who connect their social accounts are eligible for even more free products.
What are the benefits of joining?
Beyond getting free products, you join a global community of over 10 million members who share authentic reviews. Make informed shopping decisions and help others do the same!

bluejetty:00087539:ios.description:
CJ Dropshipping APP features:
1. Wholesale any products and get the factory price for your orders.
2. Direct sourcing from 1688 and Taobao.
3. Importing products to your stores by a few clicks.
4. Free product sourcing service, and thousands of POD (Print on Demand) products.
What can you do with CJ APP?
1. Bulk purchase the products and ship to your address with a lower price. After that, the delivery time and processing time are under your control. 
2. Easily list and source any products into your stores, and find thousands of POD products available for your customization.
3. Have your orders processed and shipped by CJ after a few clicks while order details are automatically synced to your stores, and you can also place order via CSV files.
4. Have products in the US warehouse: Delivery in 4-10 days for US customers.
5. Customized packaging and thorough quality inspection before dispatching.
6. Estimate the delivery time via updated tracking information.
7. Have 24/7 online customer support.
How does CJ Dropshipping APP work?
1. Wholesale orders:
Search the product by category, product name or SKU, you can add them to cart directly on new “Wholesale” page. Then confirm the order and pay. 
2. Boost dropshipping with Private Inventory and our overseas warehouses: 
Parcels can be dispatched on the same day if you place orders of stocked products, just so you know how important it is to keep a full inventory. You can order private inventory for trending products, hopefully on a more competitive price. In addition, products in the local warehouses can be delivered to domestic customers within a much shorter time frame.
3. Easily import dropshipping products:
Find your desired product on CJ? Just click LIST, change the price, and publish it in your store!
4. Connect existing products:
Connect products in your store to CJ APP. Orders in your store will be automatically synchronized when the products are connected to CJ.
5. Post a sourcing request:
You can post a sourcing request to us if you cannot find your desired items on CJ. After it, you can connect and list the product once sourcing succeeds.
6. Fulfill orders automatically:

bluejetty:00128933:ios.description:
The Best Magnifier app allows you to enlarge and see everything in great detail. 
Have you ever needed a magnifying glass and there was none at hand? Your problem is now solved! Netigen Tools presents the brand new magnifying glass that will produce the magnified image of everything you desire. 
The magnified image is detailed, but not blurry thanks to the autofocus. The app allows you to freeze the screen and read comfortably without hurry. If needed, you can also use a flashlight of your smartphone to illuminate a magnified image. What’s more, you can save the pictures you’ve taken and see them later. It is also possible to enable the fullscreen mode to enjoy your magnified images even more. Switch on the needed function by using round buttons at the left side of the screen. 
The Best Magnifier is dedicated to everybody who needs a detailed image of an object or text.
Features: 
- High magnification factor
- Zoom and Exposure controls
- Flashlight for low light situations
- Freeze, save or share images
- Awesome image visibility
- Really simple to use
What's more?
- Change skins 
- Launch the app on the full screen mode
- Keep screen on function
Disclaimer:
The quality of the image is directly related with the quality of the camera of your device. Also the functionality offered is subjected with the hardware capabilities of the camera. As for example some devices don’t have zoom, flash or auto focus.
If you need any help, please contact us: mobile@netigen.pl

bluejetty:00095323:ios.description:
Welcome to Farkle Cards – A Strategic Twist on Classic Farkle!
Love the excitement of Farkle but crave something fresh and more strategic? Farkle Cards takes the beloved dice game and gives it a unique twist—using a deck of cards instead of dice! Prepare to rethink your strategy and outsmart your opponents in this clever new spin on the classic game.
In Farkle Cards, luck meets memory and smart decision-making. Since only certain cards are in play, remembering what’s been drawn and what’s still in the deck can give you the edge. It's not just about taking risks—it's about planning your moves, predicting outcomes, and mastering the game like never before.
Why You’ll Love Farkle Cards:
A Fresh Take on a Classic:
- The card-based system brings new depth to Farkle gameplay.
- More Strategy, Less Guessing: Track discarded and drawn cards to anticipate what’s coming next.
- Intense PvP Matches: Challenge friends or players around the world in head-to-head duels.
- Tactical Depth: Knowing the odds isn’t luck—it’s skill. Outsmart, outplay, outscore.
Key Features:
- A unique card-based version of the classic Farkle dice game.
- Engaging PvP battles with a strategic edge.
- Easy to learn, hard to master—perfect for competitive minds.
- Sleek, modern design with smooth and intuitive gameplay.
- Great for fans of Farkle, Yahtzee, Balut, and strategic card games.
Do you remember what’s been played? Can you predict what’s coming next? Use your memory and tactics to beat your opponent and rise to the top!
Download Farkle Cards now and experience Farkle like never before—smarter, sharper, and more strategic than ever!

bluejetty:00079478:ios.description:
Meet the cutest match-3 ever stitched together.
Join our button-eyed rag doll through a handmade world where every tile is a colourful button. Swap, match and blast your way across hundreds of cosy puzzles.
NOT THE SAME OLD GEMS
Forget jewels and candies. You match vibrant handcrafted buttons — one of the most original boards on mobile.
A DOLL WORTH FOLLOWING
Our little rag doll guides you level by level with cheerful animations and warm moments.
HUNDREDS OF HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
From gentle openers to real brain-benders, every board is designed on purpose. New levels and seasonal events land every few weeks.
BOOSTERS AND CHAIN REACTIONS
Match four or five buttons to create powerful special buttons. Combine them to trigger spectacular chains and clear the toughest objectives.
COSY BY DESIGN
Soft music, warm visuals, zero time pressure. Play at your own pace, whenever suits you.
PLAYS FULLY OFFLINE
No connection needed. Take it on the bus, to the cafe or on a long trip.
PROGRESS THAT FOLLOWS YOU
Cloud saving keeps your levels and stars safe across every device.
HOW TO PLAY
- Swap two neighbouring buttons to line up three or more of a colour
- Match four or five to unlock special buttons
- Combine specials for chain reactions
- Hit each level's goal within the move limit to collect stars
A WORLD TO DISCOVER
Help the doll find lost button friends, repair cosy rooms and bring colour back to a soft, plush world.
We are a small independent team. If something breaks or you have an idea, reach us through the in-game support menu — we read everything.

bluejetty:00031932:ios.description:
We all want to be a better person, but maybe we haven't found a good way. Perhaps, you can make some changes through this app. From now on, become more focused, become more positive, have more stable emotions, discover yourself, etc. Start experiencing it now.
#Suitable for the crowd#
- People with poor sleep quality and frequent insomnia
- People who are prone to anxiety
- People who are constantly distracted and unable to stay focused
- People who want to be encouraged and stay positive
- People who want to discover themselves and become a better version of themselves
#Special function#
-Time Magic: See how time could transform your look with just one photo. Our algorithms let you imagine your future self or revisit a younger you.
-Future Baby: Curious about your future baby? Combine your photo with your partner’s or a favorite celebrity’s and let our algorithms imagine an adorable new face.
-Selected White Noise: Unwind with soothing sounds, from ocean waves and gentle rain to cozy cafés and city streets. Find the perfect atmosphere to relax, focus, or drift off to sleep.
-Daily Inspiration: Discover thoughtfully selected quotes each day to spark ideas, lift your spirits, and bring a little encouragement to everyday life.
Past-Life Portraits: Imagine who you might have been in another lifetime. Our algorithms transform your photo into a portrait inspired by a bygone era, bringing an imagined past to life.
-Face Reading Report: Explore the traditional art of face reading with a personalized report. Our algorithms interpret your facial features through traditional symbolism, offering a playful new perspective on your personality and charm.
-Soulmate Portrait: Wonder what your soulmate might look like? Our algorithms create a personalized portrait of your imagined match, adding a little mystery to your romantic daydreams.
-Palm Reading Report: Explore the stories in the lines of your palm. Our algorithms draw on traditional palmistry to create a personalized report with symbolic interpretations of life, love, and personality.
Subscription options:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of renewal.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: http://www.hellomymentor.com/web/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Service: http://www.hellomymentor.com/web/termsofservice.html
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us at nicelifetime@outlook.com.

bluejetty:00159645:ios.summary:
Pavilions Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Pavilions’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your s
bluejetty:00159645:ios.description:
Pavilions Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Pavilions’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Pavilions for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Pavilions locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
Download the Pavilions app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

bluejetty:00063201:ios.description:
"...a design masterpiece." 5/5 - TouchArcade
2016 Game of the Year - TouchArcade, Gamezebo
Time's Top 10 Games / Top 50 Apps of 2016
Craft, battle, and quest your way through Crashlands, an outlandish, story-driven Crafting RPG overflowing with sass!
Become Flux Dabes, a galactic trucker whose latest shipment gets derailed by a chin-strapped alien menace named Hewgodooko, leaving you stranded on an alien planet. As you hustle to retrieve your packages you’ll become enmeshed in a nefarious plot of world domination, which will require all of your wits and both of your glutes to overcome. Learn recipes from the local sentient life, make new friends, uncover ancient secrets and deadly bosses, tame everything and build yourself a home-away-from-home as you learn to thrive on planet Woanope.
▼▼ Key Features ▼▼
-● Expansive Crafting System ●-
Unlock over 500 craftable items as you explore the world and learn its secrets!
-● Self-managing, Infinite Inventory ●-
In Crashlands, your inventory is infinite, manages itself, and retrieves your tools when you need them, so you can focus on adventuring, questing, and building. You'll never have to dig through your bag or return to your base to free up inventory space!
-● RPG-Style Character Progression ●-
Become more powerful through creating ever-more-amazing items! As you grow in power, you can venture to new regions of the world, meet strange characters, discover new stories, and encounter new and interesting enemies.
-● Skill-Based Combat ●-
Learn the attacks of the enemies you encounter, and use your skill, agility, and wits to defeat them! You can even augment your fighting prowess with the power of the dozens of gadgets you can craft. Set your enemies on fire, stun them, slow down time, and more!
-● Intuitive Base Building ●-
Building a base in Crashlands is so simple it feels like fingerpainting. You can create beautiful, sprawling bases in minutes!
-● Tameable Creatures ●-
Every creature in Crashlands can become a trusty combat sidekick. Find an egg, incubate it, and hatch your very own adorable or hideous bundle of joy. You can even craft special items to grow and empower them!
-● Huge World... with Huge Problems ●-
Four sentient races, three continents, an epic bid for the future of the planet, and you - trapped in the middle, trying to deliver your freakin' packages. Take your time to dive into the side stories of the characters you meet or just rush headlong into making that special delivery. With hundreds upon hundreds of quests, there's a lot to do and discover on planet Woanope! 
-● Effortless Cloud Saving ●-
Just because your battery died or you accidentally dropped your device into a bottomless chasm, doesn't mean your save has to die with it. With Rumpus, you can easily store and retrieve your save from the cloud, and move it between your devices!
-● Controller Support ●-
Tired of rubbing your sweaty hands all over your beautiful touchscreen? No problem! We've got support for most mobile-compatible controllers, so you can rub your sweaty hands on some joysticks instead!

bluejetty:00176664:ios.description:
Hamisha qo‘lingiz ostidagi shaxsiy kabinetingiz. Raqamingizni va aloqa xizmatlarini boshqarish uchun “Ucell” bepul ilovasi. Barcha Ucell abonentlari uchun ilovadagi trafik bepul, hattoki barcha megabaytlar tugagan bo‘lsa ham.
- Sizning shaxsiy kabinetingiz
Istalgan joyda qoldiqlarni tekshiring, xizmatlarni faollashtiring va o‘chiring, tarifni almashtiring hamda o‘z mablag‘laringizni boshqaring.
- Hisobni qulay to‘ldirish 
Telefoningiz balansini bank kartangizdan komissiyasiz, bitta harakatda to‘ldiring. Shuningdek, boshqa Ucell raqamlari hisoblarini to‘ldiring. 
- Kartadan kartaga o‘tkazmalar
Humo va Uzcard bank kartalari orasida mablag‘lar o‘tkazing.
- Qo‘shimcha
Tafsilotlarni ilovaning o‘zida ko‘rib chiqing va xarajatlar tafsilotlarini elektron pochtangizga qabul qiling. Balansni hamda to‘plamlar bo‘yicha qoldiqlarni bevosita smartfon ekranida kuzatib boring.
Ilovani yuklab oling hamda barcha xizmatlarni o‘zingizga qulay joyda va vaqtda boshqaring!

bluejetty:00180684:ios.description:
Your journey with us starts when you open the KLM app.
With this pocket-sized travel assistant, you can book a ticket, customise your booking, check in and get real-time flight updates. Everything required for a smooth trip is at your fingertips!
BOOK A FLIGHT 
Select one of our many destinations and book your ticket. To save time on future bookings, add your contact information to your profile. Next time, we’ll pre-fill your details. 
MANAGE YOUR TRIP
View the pre-travel checklist and adjust your booking at any time until check-in. Lounge access or extra legroom? Enhance your travel experience yourself with just a few taps.
GET YOUR BOARDING PASS 
Travel with peace of mind – no need to print out your travel documents or wait in line at a check-in desk. Get your boarding pass directly in the app or add it to your Wallet. It’s so easy!
YOUR FLYING BLUE ACCOUNT
Check your Miles balance, book a reward ticket, modify your profile, or access your digital Flying Blue card in your personal dashboard.
STAY UP TO DATE
Turn on your notifications for real-time updates like gate changes and check-in times, and receive exclusive offers. Share your flight status to stay in touch with those on the ground. They’ll be happy to know you landed safely and sound.

bluejetty:00074372:ios.description:
Zigazoo is where trends are born.
Scroll a fast-moving feed, post videos, remix what’s trending from your favorite creators, and react in real time. From challenges and clips to stitches and duets, Zigazoo lets kids and teens jump into culture as it happens — and get seen for it.
It’s giving FYP energy, without the toxic side of social media.
Create. Remix. Go Viral.
Zigazoo makes it easy to plug into trends and put your own spin on them:
Post Short-Form Videos — Dance, react, PR Unboxings, GRWM, VLOGS
Jump on Trends & Challenges — New challenges drop all the time from creators, celebrities, brands, and partners
Remix Everything — Clip, stitch, duet, and add music, effects, stickers, and filters
Build Your Feed — Follow creators you vibe with and shape your timeline
Get Discovered — Videos can travel across the Zigazoo feed, helping creators reach new people and go viral as influencers.
Whether you’re serving aesthetic or main-character energy — Zigazoo is where it lands. That’s why we’re the world’s largest social network for kids!
A Social Feed That Feels Good
Unlike most platforms, Zigazoo is designed so trends don’t turn toxic.
No bullying. No hate. No cringe comment sections. 
No private text messaging
Positive reactions only — emojis, stickers, and supportive engagement
A community that boosts creativity instead of tearing it down
That’s how Zigazoo keeps the vibes high and the feed fun.
Safety Built In 
Zigazoo is the world’s largest safe, positive social network, created by parents and educators and trusted by millions.
100% moderated — every video is reviewed before it hits the feed
KidSAFE COPPA Certified
No explicit content or personal information
Safety works quietly in the background so creators can focus on posting, remixing, and getting seen.
Zigazoo has earned the highest safety ratings from Common Sense Media and has been featured by TechCrunch, Bark, and Moms.com.
Parent-Verified Accounts
To keep the community secure:
Accounts are created with parental consent
Parents verify via email or Apple / Google sign-on
Privacy and safety settings are built in from day one
All users must get verified before they're able to create.
Zigazoo Community Highlights
Global creator community
Music from major artists
Profile customization to match your vibe
Follow creators and get notified when they post
Positive interactions only — no negativity
Zigazoo Premium Plus
Unlock more creative power:
Videos up to 10 minutes
Create your own challenges
Advanced editing tools for transitions, collabs, and more
500 Zigabucks each month
Post first. Remix fast. Catch the trend.
It’s giving Zigazoo.
Zigazoo Safety Commitment: https://zigazoo.com/kids/parents/
Privacy Policy: https://www.zigazoo.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00015719:ios.name: Solar System Scope
bluejetty:00015719:ios.summary:
Solar System Scope is a fun way of Exploring, Discovering and Playing with the Solar System and Outer Space.
Solar System Scope (or just Solar) contains many views and celestial simulations, but most of all - it brings you closer to the fu
bluejetty:00015719:ios.description:
Solar System Scope is a fun way of Exploring, Discovering and Playing with the Solar System and Outer Space.
Solar System Scope (or just Solar) contains many views and celestial simulations, but most of all - it brings you closer to the furthest reaches of our world and lets you experience lots of fantastic space sceneries.
It aspires to be the most illustrative, easy to understand and simple to use space model.
- 3D Encyclopedia
In Solar’s unique encyclopedia you will find the most interesting facts about every planet, dwarf planet, every major moon and more – and everything is accompanied by realistic 3D visualizations.
Solar’s encyclopedia is available in 10 languages: English, Spanish, German, Russian, Italian, Korean and Slovak. More languages are coming soon!
- Nightsky Observatory
Enjoy Stars and constellation of the night sky as viewed from any given location on Earth. You can point your device at the sky to see all objects in their proper place, but you can also simulate Night sky in the past or in the future.
Now with advanced options that let you simulate ecliptic, equatorial and azimuthal line, or grid (among other things).
- Scientific Instrument
Solar System Scope calculations are based on up-to-date orbital parameters published by NASA and let you simulate celestial positions at any given time.
- For Everyone
Solar System Scope is well suited for all audiences and ages: It is enjoyed by space enthusiasts, teachers, scientists, but Solar is successfully used even by children of 4+ years of age!
- Unique Maps
We are proud to present a very unique set of planetary and moon maps, that let you experience a true-color space as never before.
These accurate maps are based on NASA elevation and imagery data. Colors and shades of the textures are tuned according to true-color photos made by Messenger, Viking, Cassini and New Horizon spacecrafts, and the Hubble Space Telescope.
Basic resolution of these maps is for free – but if you would like the best experience, you can check out the highest quality, which is available with In-App purchase.
- Join our vision
Our vision is to build the ultimate space model and bring you the deepest space experience.
And you can help - try Solar System Scope and if you like it, spread the word!
And don’t forget to join the community and vote for new features on our homepage.

bluejetty:00082288:ios.name: SAIB Mobile
bluejetty:00082288:ios.summary: Welcome to the future of banking with the Saudi Investment Bank‘s all-new Mobile Banking App! Designed with cutting-edge technology and a sleek intuitive user interface. Our app delivers an unparalleled banking experience at your fingertips
bluejetty:00082288:ios.description:
Welcome to the future of banking with the Saudi Investment Bank‘s all-new Mobile Banking App! Designed with cutting-edge technology and a sleek intuitive user interface. Our app delivers an unparalleled banking experience at your fingertips. Whether you are at home, at work, or on the go, the SAIB Mobile App is your reliable partner for seamless, secure, and swift financial management.
1. User Registration and Setup: 
New to SAIB? Easily register through the app’s seamless process. After registration, enable quick login options such as Face ID, Touch ID, or a secure passcode for future logins. You can also save your credentials to simplify future access without compromising security.
2. Login Options: 
Our app offers a range of secure login methods tailored to your preference. You can log in using a traditional username and password or opt for faster, more convenient methods like biometrics or PIN logins. 
3. Dashboard Overview: 
Manage all your finances at a glance with our dashboard. View account balances, monitor transactions, pay bills, and transfer money seamlessly to your favorate beneficiaries. With easy access to essential banking features, your financial management has never been more efficient.
4. Account and Profile Management: 
Manage profile settings, preferences and even customize the app theme effortlessly. You can open new additional accounts instantly within the app. Everything you need to personalize your banking experience is just a few taps away.
5. Transfers & Payments: 
Effortlessly transfer funds to your accounts or beneficiaries, both locally and internationally. The app supports a variety of payment options, including quick transfers and bill payments for utilities and government services. You can also manage recurring payments with a simple, streamlined process. All payments are handled securely and quickly for your convenience.
6. Card Management: 
From mada cards to travel and credit cards, SAIB Mobile banking allows you to manage all your cards in one place. View balances, transaction history, and activate or block cards as needed. Add cards to Apple Wallet for seamless, contactless payments. You can also control spending limits, manage PIN settings. With comprehensive tools, you’ll have complete control over your cards anytime, anywhere.
7. Finance Products: 
Stay on top of your finances with an integrated dashboard that provides an overview of your current loan, repayment schedules, and details. You can apply for new loans, including personal or home finance, and even refinance existing ones. Manage overdue payments, early settlements, or explore new financing options directly through the app, ensuring you have the financial flexibility you need.
8. Investment Services: 
Have an updated insight of your investment portfolio with ease. SAIB Mobile Banking offers comprehensive investment services including an overview of your investments, view market updates, IPO subscriptions and even subscribing to new funds with just a few taps.
9. Contact and Help Center: 
Need assistance? SAIB Mobile Banking provides instant support through live chat and a dedicated FAQ section covering accounts, transactions, and cards. For further support you can submit requests, complaints, or track the status of your previous interactions directly through the app.
10. Marketplace & Loyalty Program: 
Maximize your banking experience with SAIB’s exclusive loyalty program. Track your points, view rewards, and redeem them for a variety of benefits, including travel miles, cash, or exclusive offers. Explore gift vouchers, partner deals, and other special promotions designed just for you.
Revolutionize Your Banking Today!
With SAIB’s new Mobile Banking App, we’re transforming the way you manage your finances—putting you in control of your money in a more efficient, secure, and personalized way. Whether you’re paying bills, managing your accounts, or seeking financial advice, you’ll find everything you need in one place.

bluejetty:00178762:ios.description:
Speak, type, and translate instantly with Voicelator — your ultimate AI-powered translation assistant. Designed for seamless communication on the go, Voicelator bridges language barriers whether you are browsing the web, chatting in messengers, traveling, or practicing a new language.
Everything you need for effortless communication is right at your fingertips.
KEY FEATURES
100+ Languages Supported: Translate text and voice accurately to communicate freely anywhere in the world.
Keyboard Translator: Translate messages directly inside your favorite chat apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Twitter without switching screens.
Camera & Photo Translation: Point your camera at signboards, menus, or documents, or import photos from your library for instant text recognition.
Object Recognition: Point your camera at any object to learn its name and translation in real time.
Voice & Speech Controls: Enjoy high-quality voice playback with adjustable speeds and natural male or female voices.
Offline Mode: Access essential text translations anytime, anywhere — no internet connection required.
Automatic Language Detection: Just speak or type; Voicelator identifies the source language automatically.
Apple Watch Integration: Translate on the go right from your wrist.
Phrasebook & Favorites: Save essential expressions and frequently used translations for quick access.
Easy Sharing: Export and share your translations effortlessly via SMS, email, or social media.
SUPPORTED LANGUAGES & DIALECTS
Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic (Egypt, Saudi Arabia, UAE), Armenian, Azerbaijani, Basque, Belarusian, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Burmese, Catalan, Cebuano, Chinese (Cantonese, Mandarin, Taiwan), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English (Australia, UK, US), Esperanto, Estonian, Finnish, French (France, Canada), Frisian, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Hmong, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean, Kurdish, Kyrgyz, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Malagasy, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Maori, Marathi, Mongolian, Nepali, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil, Portugal), Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Samoan, Serbian, Sesotho, Shona, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish (Mexico, Spain, US), Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Tajik, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Welsh, Xhosa, Yiddish, Yoruba, Zulu.
VOICELATOR PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Unlock the full potential of Voicelator with unlimited access to premium features:
Unlimited voice, text, and camera translations
100% Ad-free translation experience
Full offline translation mode

Momiary: Pregnancy Tracker & Health Guide for Moms-to-Be
Take charge of your pregnancy journey with Momiary — a comprehensive app designed to support expecting moms with smart tracking tools, health insights, and expert-backed advice for every week of your pregnancy.
Whether you're planning, expecting, or already navigating symptoms, Momiary is your private, powerful companion.
Top Features of Momiary: Pregnancy & Period Tracker
1. Period & Ovulation Tracking
Stay in tune with your cycle: track periods, predict ovulation, and identify your fertile days.
View cycle patterns and get reminders tailored to hormonal changes.
Built-in ovulation calculator for accurate fertility prediction.
2. Pregnancy Health Monitoring
Log daily weight and symptoms like nausea, fatigue, or cravings.
Visualize your health trends with charts and analytics.
Receive daily advice based on your pregnancy stage and symptoms.
3. Week-by-Week Pregnancy Guide
Know what’s happening each week with a breakdown of baby’s development.
Fun comparisons like “baby’s size as a fruit” to track growth.
Countdown to your due date and access regular check-up tips.
4. Maternal Wellness & Lifestyle Tools
Get curated nutrition tips and mental wellness guidance.
Kegel exercise reminders to support pelvic health.
Browse name ideas and prepare for baby without stress.
Why Moms Love Momiary
Privacy-First Design: Your data stays on your device. No tracking, no third-party access.
Medical-Grade Content: Built on trusted health recommendations for moms and moms-to-be.
User-Focused: No overwhelming baby features – just smart tools for your well-being.

Momiary does not collect or store your personal health data. Everything stays on your phone. Your journey, your data — always private.

bluejetty:00093908:ios.description:
Com competência, credibilidade e inovação, oferecemos controle, harmonia, segurança, transparência e facilidade para a vida do seu condomínio, procurando sempre conhecer de perto o que é importante e adaptando nossos serviços às suas necessidades.
Tanto pelo site da Beelive quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com o APP Beelive, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. 
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para beeliveapp@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00087194:ios.name: Mt. Fuji - GPS Trail Map
bluejetty:00087194:ios.summary:
Mt. Fuji App is a hiking trail map application that can be used as a GPS for climbing, hiking, trekking, trail running, and other outdoor activities.
It utilizes data such as maps, routes, and place names that can be used for climbing Mt. F
bluejetty:00087194:ios.description:
Mt. Fuji App is a hiking trail map application that can be used as a GPS for climbing, hiking, trekking, trail running, and other outdoor activities.
It utilizes data such as maps, routes, and place names that can be used for climbing Mt. Fuji, and allows you to check your current location with GPS even in the mountains where the Internet connection is not available.
Features
(1) Offline trail map
Mt. Fuji trail maps can be used offline.
Even in the mountains where there is no internet connection, you can use the signal from GPS satellites to locate your current location and display the map.
(2) Easy preparation
You can start hiking by simply selecting your trail route from the four routes commonly used for climbing Mt. Fuji.
(3) Mountain hut/lodge information
You can also make reservations by phone or through the website for huts located along your planned route.
(4) Leave history of your hike
When you start climbing a mountain, you can store a GPS log of your hike using GPS.
Even if you are on airplane mode or out of range, if the sky is open, you can store a GPS log using satellite signals.
After you finished your hike, you can get your own Climbing Certificate of Mt. Fuji.
(5) Voice notification of wrong way
When you deviate from the planned route, you will be notified by voice.
You can also use the speech function that periodically notifies you of the current time and elevation after you start climbing.
(6) Easy to keep a record of your hike
You can easily create a record of your hike using the GPS logs and photos you took while climbing!
You can also export the GPS log or post it directly to Yamareco (in Japanese only).
(7) Latest Mt. Fuji conditions
By signing in YamaReco, you can check other people's Mt. Fuji records and check the current mountain conditions.
Knowing the current mountain conditions can help you prepare appropriately.
(8) Useful Information
The app includes information such as downhill bus timetable, mountain insurance, equipment, access, and related links useful for climbing Mt. Fuji.
Notes
When keeping a GPS log, the GPS function is used continuously in the background, which may drain the battery faster than apps that do not use GPS.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Please be sure to bring a paper map, compass, spare batteries, and power cable with you when climbing mountains.
To use some of the functions of this application, you will need to register as a user with YamaReco.
How to use the application
https://sites.google.com/view/fuji-ios-en/

bluejetty:00156449:ios.name: Speedtest by Open Nettest
bluejetty:00156449:ios.summary: Open Nettest is an independent and transparent tool for measurement of the Internet connection in fixed, cellular and WiFi networks. It has a strong focus on quality and reliability of the internet connection. Open Nettest measures several
bluejetty:00156449:ios.description:
Open Nettest is an independent and transparent tool for measurement of the Internet connection in fixed, cellular and WiFi networks. It has a strong focus on quality and reliability of the internet connection. Open Nettest measures several parameters: download and upload speed, ping (latency), jitter and packet loss.
There are already several speed test apps in the marketplace that can do this. What makes Open Nettest different is that it is based on an open, transparent methodology. The measurement servers are located outside of the operators’ networks in several Internet peering exchange point. There are no internet service providers who would sponsor the measurement ecosystem. The app follows industry standards and KPIs as defined by BEREC, ITU and others. You can find more information about the measurement methodology at https://nettest.com/en/methodology.
Another strong differentiator is the privacy. We do not collect any unnecessary personal data from the users and do not link the data collected to create user profiles. Moreover, we properly anonymise any sensitive data, such as location information and the IP address, before we use the data for statistical analysis and reports. To learn more, please visit https://nettest.com/en/privacy-policy.
Open Nettest supports a variety of devices and internet access technologies, including WiFi, Cellular 2G, 3G, 4G / LTE, 4G+ and 5G NR SA / NR NSA.
We would love to hear from you. If you like the app, please do not forget to rate it in the app store and please also consider to write a review.

Need real-time answers? Capture a video or just ask. Looking for the best coffee shop with a beach view? Lloyd’s Around Me mode finds the perfect spot instantly. Need help with homework, project planning, or breaking down complex tasks? Lloyd uses cutting-edge AI to assist with everything from solving math problems to organizing your next big project. Cooking a dish? Chef AI not only suggests creative ingredient substitutions but also guides you step by step and even reminds you to take the cake out of the oven. Exploring a new city? Lloyd maps out your day with top attractions, hidden gems, and the best local eats. Even in areas with low cell coverage, Lloyd keeps working when you need it most.
Lloyd is also the fastest live video messenger on the planet. Instantly share real moments with friends and family in one-on-one or group conversations—seamlessly combining text, voice, and video for a dynamic, real-time connection.

• Get expert assistance in the kitchen with Chef AI, providing step-by-step guidance and timely reminders so you never burn a dish.

bluejetty:00089505:ios.description:
Your on-demand emotional wellness companion. Suitable for people experiencing sadness, worry, depression, anxiety and other mood struggles.
Built on research. Made with compassion.
MoodLinks incorporates aspects of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy to boost your treatment and help you reach your goals.
Use for self-help or link with your treatment team’s MoodLinks app.
Easy to use: Launch the app and get started in seconds
Secure and reliable: All industry-standard security practices are met
What can MoodLinks help you do?
Link with your care team: 
- Easily share your progress
- Collaborate on identifying useful coping skills, celebrate in the little victories together
- Create an extra layer of support in between sessions
- Receive motivational messages and images from your team
Check-in’s: 
- Morning and evening check-ins help keep you aware of your motivation, progress and strengths of the day.
- Other check-in’s to guide you through reflecting anxiety episodes, feelings and thoughts.
- A check-in often takes less than 1 minute.
Self-Care Checklist:
- Get ideas for self-care activities
- Keep track of ways that you took care of yourself throughout the day
- A great way to remind yourself of your accomplishments
- Medication tracker that can send you reminders
Coping Skills & Goals:
- Included library of science-backed goals and skills to help you make progress
- Based on the process of change, with reminders in the app to work on your goals
- Share with your treatment team in the moment when you’ve achieved a goal
MoodLinks may ask for access to your step count data if you would like to track your steps and optionally share that with your care team. Collection of this data is completely optional. We integrate with Apple's Health App to achieve this. The data will be handled and used in accordance with MoodLinks' privacy policy and terms of service.
