bluejetty:00169629:ios.description:
Are you looking for fun and useful ways to engage your time? 
Scavenger Hunt is a hilarious mobile game that puts players on a virtual scavenger hunt to find hidden objects in the most ridiculous locations imaginable. The game combines elements of puzzle-solving and brain games with the absurdity of a treasure hunt, providing players with a unique and amusing gaming experience.
One of the standout features of Scavenger Hunt is the ability to create and customize your own scavenger hunts. Players can choose the locations, the objects to be found, and the clues and hints to be provided, allowing for a unique and personalized scavenger hunt experience. This customization feature is one of the reasons why Scavenger Hunt has become such a popular mobile game, as it offers players the ability to create their own scavenger hunt adventures that are tailored to their interests and preferences.
Visit the cute fictional town where life is in full swing! In this game, all you need to do is seek the hidden objects on a huge colorful map. However, some items are located in unexpected places. Will you find the hidden objects? Spot it!
Each new level reveals another part of the map. To find out what the whole city looks like, you need to complete all the levels. It’s quite a challenge! If something is well-hidden, the best way to find it is to search carefully, with no rush. When you seek the hidden objects, it improves your attentiveness and observation skills. You can explore a location for an hour and still fail to notice a small item you need. Just stay focused and sooner or later you’ll find it! Are your eyes sharp enough? Download the game now and enjoy playing it every day!
If you like to find the hidden objects, this new free game is something you will really enjoy. The thing that makes it so satisfying is the fact that the characters are always on the move. In the game, you’ll see a panel with a list of various objects from a butterfly to a hamburger, and your goal is to find out where they’re located. Explore the map and zoom in on specific areas to find it. The faster you find the hidden objects, the faster you’ll unlock new maps. Each map is a whole new world dedicated to a certain theme – endless fun! Spot it!
An item can be everywhere – on a rooftop, in someone's pool, or under the feet of a green-haired baseball player – waiting for you to find it. It’s way more entertaining than other games where you need to seek the hidden objects yet not too difficult.
If you've played Hidden Objects games before, you'll love this next level edition. What makes it so special? Let’s find out! Spot it!
- Fun TO PLAY! Find the hidden objects anytime and anywhere on your device.
- INTUITIVE GAMEPLAY. Seek the hidden objects on the map and tap on them once found. Can’t see an item? Use a hint and find out where the thing you’re looking for is.
- NO TIME LIMIT. Feel free to seek the hidden objects for as long as you need! 
- BEAUTIFUL MAPS. Bright colors and little details will make you fall in love with the map. You haven’t seen anything like this in other games!
- HOURS OF JOY. Each map is enormous and we constantly add new ones, so the game guarantees you hours of a meditative yet fun experience. Other games will seem boring once you try this one.
Find out what you’re capable of and explore the most addictive game you’ve ever played! Overall, Scavenger Hunt is a fantastic mobile game that offers endless hours of entertainment and laughter for players. With its unique combination of scavenger hunting, puzzle-solving, and brain games, Scavenger Hunt is sure to keep players engaged and entertained. So why not download the game today and start your own hilarious scavenger hunt adventure? Spot it!

- SPL Online: Providing a channel through which the user can perform many e-services easily and conveniently, such as viewing bills, subscribing to Alami and Awfar and many more. SPL Online will continuously serve you to ensure easy access to all Postal services.

bluejetty:00185835:ios.name: Bridge V+, bridge card game
bluejetty:00185835:ios.summary:
Welcome to the 2026 Edition of Bridge. With 3 modes of play, practically unlimited deals and the ability to search for hands this Bridge card game is sure to teach, challenge and entertain you for hours.
Bridge supports the following 3 mod
bluejetty:00185835:ios.description:
Welcome to the 2026 Edition of Bridge. With 3 modes of play, practically unlimited deals and the ability to search for hands this Bridge card game is sure to teach, challenge and entertain you for hours.
Bridge supports the following 3 modes of play:
In Rubber Bridge a rubber is played as the best of three games. A game is won by the first partnership to score 100 or more points in successful contracts.
In Chicago Bridge, also known as Four-Hand Bridge, you play exactly four hands of Bridge. The winner is the partnership that scores the most points.
In Tournament Bridge you play at your own pace against players from around the world in duplicate style Bridge tournaments. Each player in a tournament plays the same hands with the winner scoring the most points. Alternatively you can easily create your own online Bridge club, invite your family, friends or even some enemies then play in duplicate style Bridge tournaments against your own select set of players. 
What is Bridge?
Bridge is a trick taking card game played by four players who form two partnerships. Players within a partnership face each other across a table. Traditionally, the players are referred to by the points of the compass - North, East, South and West. The two partnerships are North/South and East/West. 
Designed for both beginners and more advanced players you can choose how you prefer to play. There are plenty of features if you are trying to learn Bridge including auto play and hints. Meanwhile the more advanced players can use the bid analysis or replay hand features to explore different lines of card play. 
GAME FEATURES:
* Unlimited hands built in (well approx 2 billion but....)
* Play game points or slams all day if thats what you want to do.
* Play in online Bridge tournaments
* Compare your bidding the Bridge V+ AI bidding.
* See how the computer would have played the hand.
* Replay from any bid or card for that 'what if' moment
* Get hints.
* Play any or all of the hands.
* Ask the computer how it has interpreted the bids made.
* Lots of display options to suit your individual and device preference.
DEVELOPED BY BRIDGE PLAYERS 
The small team behind Bridge have been producing Bridge games for over 40 years. One of our first products was Bridge Challenger released in the early 80s!
Do we get every bid correct or play every hand perfectly? absolutely not!. Often there is no one single correct answer making Bridge the game we love. Meanwhile we continue to develop and improve the game.
COMMENTS + SUGGESTIONS. 
Please feel free to contact us via our support email if you have comments and suggestions. Please, please include any Deal Id if you are commenting on specific deals as that is the only way we can reasonably play the hand in question here.

bluejetty:00132321:ios.description:
Keep your cribbage game score with just a single swipe! No more fumbling with tiny pegs or using a calculator - Cribtastic brings the iconic cribbage board design to your device while making keeping score effortless and more accurate than ever!
KEY FEATURES
• Score with a Swipe - Score any number of points in a single touch with the fine-tuned scoring slider.
• Score with a Tap - Last card? Tap the scoring peg to quickly add a point; keep tapping to add more.
• Mirrored Layout - Both players see their scores facing them - no need to flip the phone around or designate a scorekeeper.
• Match History - Completed games are saved automatically, making tracking rivalries easy.
• Minimalist Design - Beautifully polished interface and animations make scorekeeping a delight.
• See the Exact Score - Tap the board to toggle displaying the total scores numerically.
• Undo - Drag the scoring peg back one or more times to take away mis-counted points.
• Light and Dark Mode - Customizable appearance for your preferred aesthetic.

bluejetty:00123215:ios.description:
Does stock trading scare you? Try the Stock Exchange Game!
You will learn how to make money off financial quotes by playing it!
It's an easy, free game with no registration or demo accounts needed. It is not just some simple simulator — you’ll be immersed in the real trading game!
The Stock Exchange Game is the only Economic Strategy game in the world, based on thousands of world events. Analyze the financial news and its impact on quotes.
You won’t just guess when the price will fluctuate — you’ll know it precisely!
Millions of complex combinations make the game, where every step is unique. 
Buy and sell on the world’s stock market. Earn as much as your courage allows you.
Try yourself in the role of a real trader!
Competent investments are guaranteed to pay off. The Stock Exchange Game has a unique management and level up system, which allows you to effectively use your knowledge and skills. 
This is the game where you develop real-life knowledge. Here you can train your intelligence, memory and analytical processes. You will want to become a real trader!
This game will help you face stock trading without fear, learn about finances and investments, and prepare for real trading on Forex!
Game Features:
 - A unique gameplay experience based on the world’s complex economic model 
 - Every step is unique and diverse
 - Completely Free
 - No registration needed 
 - No Internet connection needed 
 - Records tables of thousands of players around the world
 - Offline 
 - Stocks game
“A speculator is a man who observes the future before it occurs.” – Bernard Baruch.

bluejetty:00129711:ios.description:
Proton Drive provides private and secure storage for your files and photos. With Proton Drive you can protect important documents, automatically back up cherished memories, and access your content across devices. All Proton Drive accounts come with 5 GB of free storage and you can upgrade to up to 1 TB of storage at any time.
Trusted by over 100 million users, Proton Drive gives you an end-to-end encrypted vault where only you—and the people you choose—can access your files and photos.
Proton Drive features:
- Secure storage
- Get 5 GB of free encrypted cloud storage with no file size limits.
- Share content using secure links with password and expiration settings.
- Keep your files and photos safe with PIN or biometric protection.
- Access important files and photos even if your device is lost or damaged.
Easy to use
- Automatically back up photos and videos in their original quality.
- Securely organize your cherished memories into albums. 
- Rename, move, and delete your personal files securely within the app.
- Create, edit and collaborate on docs.
- View your important files and memories – even when offline.
- Restore files with version history.
Advanced privacy
- Stay private with end-to-end encryption – even Proton can’t view your content.
- Secure your metadata, including filenames, sizes, and modification dates.
- Protect your content with Swiss privacy laws, the strongest in the world.
- Trust in our open-source code that is public and verified by experts.
Secure up to 5 GB of free storage for your personal files, photos, and videos with Proton Drive.

bluejetty:00150996:ios.description:
KS Bank Mobile gives you 24-hour access to your KS Bank, Inc. account(s) and allows you to quickly complete common tasks. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what you can do with KS Bank Mobile:
View account balances
Review and organize your transactions by adding tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you

bluejetty:00060913:ios.description:
Register your new bills with Betalingsservice. Manage your personal finances and avoid unpleasant reminder fees – our Betalingsservice app is a much better way to stay in control of your bills.
The Betalingsservice app is a one-stop app, allowing you to see all your payment agreements – anytime, anywhere. And it gives you a firm grip on your fixed expenses, such as rent, fitness, TV subscriptions, utilities, loans, donations, mobile subscription.
You don’t need to be a customer of a particular bank. You can use the Betalingsservice app if you have a Danish civil registration number (CPR), a Danish bank account with a Betalingsservice agreement and a MitID.
GET BETALINGSSERVICE – ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
• See which bills you have paid and which are still to be paid
• See all of your standing order payments – covers all your accounts
• Register your bills for automated payment – it’s fast and easy
• Receive push notifications regarding your payments and mandates
REGISTER YOUR BILLS FOR AUTOMATED PAYMENT – IT’S FAST AND EASY
• Scan the QR code on the bill – sign up in less than 2 minutes
• Receive push notifications when mandates have been approved
ONE-STOP APP FOR ALL YOUR PAYMENTS AND AGREEMENTS
• See all your previous payments, month by month, going back several years
• See current status and details on each individual payment
• See all of your standing order payments
GET AN INSTANT OVERVIEW OF ALL YOUR REGULAR EXPENSES
• You can list all your expenses during the year
• See how your expenses break down into your home, consumption, charity donations, utilities, insurance, unemployment insurance fees, transport, children, tuition, entertainment, media, health, loans, sports and membership fees
• Set up a budget and monitor your expenses, year by year
EXTRA SECURITY AND SECURITY CODE OF YOUR OWN CHOICE
MitID is required the first time you use the Betalingsservice app. After that, you can log on using a four-digit PIN of your own choice.
In order to use the app, you must have the following:
• A valid Danish civil registration number (CPR)
• A Danish bank account with a Betalingsservice agreement
• MitID
Use MitID to access your payment information. MitID is your assurance that you only have access to your own data. Any data you key into the app will be sent in encrypted form to Betalingsservice.
RESTRICTIONS FOR JOINT ACCOUNTS
If your Betalingsservice agreements are related to a bank account that you share with others, such as your spouse, you may not have full access to all payment data.
INFORMATION AND SETTINGS
The settings menu lets you see and edit your account, push notifications and your personal information. It also contains terms and conditions and frequently asked questions.
If you have any suggestions for improvements, we’d love to hear from you. Write to us at www.facebook.com/Betalingsservice.

bluejetty:00024080:ios.description:
School is out! Time to explore your Neighborhood and start your fun adventures!
Welcome to My Town: Neighborhood game! It's finally time to explore the neighborhood and enjoy fun on the streets! My Town Neighbourhood streets are full of fun and waiting for you to roleplay your own stories!
VISIT THE LIBRARY, DENTIST'S OFFICE & FASHION STORE
Visit your local library, get your favorite story or organize a book party with many fun costumes. Do you have a toothache? Visit the dentist as his office is just down the street. Yes, the famous dentist is your neighbor and his house is just around the corner.
EXPLORE 9 DOLLHOUSES AND LOCATIONS
My Town: Neighborhood game is a digital version of the classic dollhouse game and has 9 fantastic locations that you can discover! Play 2 interactive mini-games and have a lot of fun!
FIND OUT WHO LIVES ON YOUR STREET
Explore the neighborhood! There are many fun things to experience in this dollhouse game. Let your child create own stories, roleplay with favorite characters, and learn something new!
GAME FEATURES:
• Explore 9 locations: dentist home, library, street and more
• Play 2 mini-games
• Visit a dentist's office and dentist's home
• Explore a library and create your stories
• Enter the fashion store and get new costumes
• Order food in the local restaurant
• Choose the mood of your characters
• Roleplay on the street with friends
• Play with friends on the same device
Everything is possible in a My Town! Let your kids learn new things and create their own stories. Our goal is to improve kids creativity and imagination!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents or other family members are out of the room. 
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse games that promote creativity and open-ended play for your children worldwide. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines.
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/.

listings.description:
熊猫睡眠，提供个性化睡眠管理方案，专属你的健康睡眠管家。精准记录睡眠全程、分析睡眠行为，生成可视化睡眠报告，清晰呈现睡眠状态。助力改善睡眠质量，高效赋能学习与工作，平稳调节情绪，让每日状态更愉悦饱满。

=====适合以下人群=====

- 有睡眠症状困扰的人（难以入睡，频繁醒来，多梦，失眠）的人
- 想了解自己睡眠质量并改善睡眠质量的人
- 受压力和焦虑困扰的上班族
- 想要专注于工作或学习的人
- 喜欢冥想或想尝试冥想的人
- 睡眠时容易受环境噪声影响的人群
- 考试和课业压力大的学生
- 想要提高睡眠质量的人
- 想要记录自己的梦话和打鼾的人

=====特色功能=====

【助你夜夜好眠】
- 海量原创白噪音、睡眠故事、催眠曲、冥想音乐、助眠脑波和轻音乐，营造专业舒适入睡氛围
- 告别失眠多梦，告别气短乏力，放松自己，轻松入睡。

【记录梦话鼾声】
- 捕捉你在睡眠过程中的梦话以及鼾声，深层次的分析呼吸状况，记录你的磨牙声和宠物声，感受且分享你的睡眠乐趣。
- 睡得多≠睡得好，高质量的睡眠让你倍感轻松且充满活力，工作效率更高、精神状态更好

【追踪睡眠周期】
- 睡眠追踪器，科学追踪你的睡眠状态并重塑睡眠周期，入睡期&浅睡期&熟睡期&深睡期&快速眼动期，并了解这五个阶段不同的特征。
- 轻松了解睡眠趋势、睡眠质量和睡眠习惯模式，反映你的真实睡眠情况，

【智能闹钟&温柔唤醒】
- 通过麦克风与睡眠监测算法，智能识别睡眠状态，在浅睡眠阶段温柔唤醒你，告别突兀惊醒

【任务闹钟】
- 基于「睡眠惯性」和「生物节律」理论，依据行为心理学设计轻量叫醒任务，完成任务才能关闭闹钟，科学且温和地唤醒大脑，助你养成规律健康的晨起节奏。

【睡眠分析报告】
- 根据每周或每月的睡眠报告，科学分析睡眠数据，发现睡眠变化，以更好地改善睡眠。
- 结合科学评测体系、AI 监测系统，和专业的评测报告，针对不同的睡眠问题，提供定制化解决方案。

每一个热爱生活的人，都值得拥有好睡眠。熊猫睡眠全身心为您提供专业、全面和暖心的睡眠服务，让你的睡眠更有效率，改善睡眠健康，每天精力充沛！帮您睡得更好睡得更香！

本应用提供的“心率、血压测量”功能非医疗专业设备检测的结果仅供参考，请勿用作自行诊断或治疗的依据。

bluejetty:00144403:ios.description:
Η εφημερίδα «Καθημερινή» καταγράφει και αναλύει τα γεγονότα στην Ελλάδα και στον κόσμο, με ακρίβεια και νηφαλιότητα. Εξελίσσεται με οδηγό τις ίδιες αξίες και προσπαθεί καθημερινά να αποτελεί ένα δίαυλο ψύχραιμης και υπεύθυνης ενημέρωσης, χωρίς να ενδίδει στις σειρήνες του φανατισμού και του εντυπωσιασμού. Αποτελεί σημείο αναφοράς της πολιτικής, οικονομικής και πνευματικής κοινότητας της χώρας και διακρίνεται για τις αντικειμενικές απόψεις των συντακτών της, την έγκυρη αρθρογραφία της και την ευρύτατη κάλυψη της διεθνούς επικαιρότητας.
Kathimerini is a daily, political and financial newspaper whose operations are based in Athens, Greece. Its first edition was published in 1919. In its almost 100 years of existence, Kathimerini carries a legacy of reliability and prestige, and has consistently incorporated a polyphony of opinions and beliefs in its pages. Kathimerini is fully dedicated to its mission to provide consistent, detailed and broad coverage to its readers. Everyday on its print and digital editions, the newspaper publishes a meticulously curated mixture of breaking news, articles, analysis, and opinion pieces. The new mobile app offers free registration, profile creation, newsletters, personalized recommendations and a new subscription service with benefits such as unlimited access to content, extra content and exclusive newsletters, games and features like audio articles and commenting.

bluejetty:00180743:ios.summary: The 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna, Arabic: أسماء الله الحسنى) are the beautiful names by which Muslims know and remember God. They are described in the Qur'an and Sunnah. According to hadith there is a special group of 99 names, though n
bluejetty:00180743:ios.description:
The 99 Names of Allah (Asma ul Husna, Arabic: أسماء الله الحسنى) are the beautiful names by which Muslims know and remember God. They are described in the Qur'an and Sunnah. According to hadith there is a special group of 99 names, though no single list is agreed upon, and the names of Allah in the Qur'an and Sunnah exceed 99. A hadith narrated by Abdullah ibn Mas'ud tells that some of the names of Allah have been kept hidden from mankind.
99 Names of Allah & Sounds brings Asma ul Husna, the names of Prophet Muhammad and a complete Ibadah toolkit into one beautiful Islamic app: prayer times, Quran audio, daily Dua, Tasbih counter, Hijri calendar and Islamic baby names.
Features:
99 Names of Allah and Prophet Muhammad
• All 99 Names of Allah in Arabic and English with meanings and Qur'an references
• Names of Prophet Muhammad with meanings
• Beautiful Arabic audio recitation of every name, in spiritual style
• Autoplay all names in a loop, or repeat a single name
• Tasbih counter with your chosen name of Allah
• Easy-to-read Arabic font and swipe navigation through Asma ul Husna
• Share names with friends or copy the text to use later
Ibadah: your daily worship tools
• Accurate prayer times (Salah times) for your location, with Azan notifications for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha
• Next prayer countdown and monthly prayer timetable with Hijri dates
• Ramadan Sehri and Iftar timings for the whole month, with PDF sharing
• Holy Quran with verse-by-verse audio recitation, translation and transliteration, auto-scroll and resume where you left off
• Daily Dua and supplications (Hisnul Muslim) with Arabic, transliteration and meaning, in 21 languages
• Digital Tasbih and Dhikr counter with targets, rounds, ring styles and tap sounds
• Six Kalimas with audio
• Islamic Hijri calendar with Muslim holidays and countdowns: Ramadan, Eid ul Fitr, Eid ul Adha, Laylat al Qadr and more
• Qibla-friendly prayer settings: calculation method and Asr juristic method
Islamic baby names
• Over 15,000 Muslim baby names for boys and girls with meanings, in Arabic and English
• Search by name, meaning or number, and save favourites
More
• Available in 21 languages including Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Bengali, Indonesian, Malay, Turkish, French, German and Spanish
• Dark mode support
• Free to use: all names, sounds and prayer times are free
Usage:
• 99 Names of Allah and Prophet Muhammad collection
• Allah Names and Prophet Muhammad meaning guide
• Sound library of Allah and Prophet Muhammad names
• Daily Muslim prayer times, Quran, Dua and Tasbih companion
Terms of Use: https://www.islamicappz.com/apps/allahnames/terms.html

bluejetty:00167338:ios.name: Goods Puzzle: 3D Sorting Games
bluejetty:00167338:ios.summary:
Get ready for an exciting matching adventure like never before in Goods Puzzle: 3D Sorting Games! Sort multiple goods, organize the shelves, and enjoy your leisure time to become a 3D sorting game master!
Looking for relaxing sorting games
bluejetty:00167338:ios.description:
Get ready for an exciting matching adventure like never before in Goods Puzzle: 3D Sorting Games! Sort multiple goods, organize the shelves, and enjoy your leisure time to become a 3D sorting game master!
Looking for relaxing sorting games where you can sort, match, and explore? Curious about your skills in turning chaos into order within a time limit? Then this FREE and addictive triple sorting game is sure to provide you with a perfect experience. It combines triple-match gameplay, strategic sorting games, 3D matching, and engaging puzzle elements. It's time to match, solve challenging puzzles, and enjoy the fun of sorting goods!
In the classic triple match and sorting games, your task is to help sellers sort and classify a wide range of goods on the shelves. Match 3 identical goods to eliminate them and make room for new challenges. But remember, time is ticking! Perfectly organize everything before time runs out and win the sorting games for free. Sort goods, test your speed, and clear your mind now!
Cool Features of Goods Matching Games:
- FREE to play captivating sorting puzzle games
- Engaging 3D graphics and intuitive triple-match gameplay
- Tons of challenging levels with varied difficulty
- 300 types of 3D goods in visually appealing categories for sorting games
- Enjoy endless sorting fun with dozens of unique shelving arrangements
- Super boosters to help you overcome obstacles & clear levels
- Simple tap-and-drag controls for a smooth experience in match 3D sorting games
- Time-based sorting games that enhance quick-thinking skills
- Play Goods Puzzle: 3D Sorting Games anywhere, anytime
- Stress-relieving and mind-healing sorting games for adults
- A great way to improve your memory, attention, and problem-solving skills
How to Play Sorting Games:
- Drag and drop 3D items to several shelves for triple-match
- Collect 3 identical items to clear them
- Use powerful boosters strategically to manage more difficult sorting games or to freeze time
- Sort all goods before time expires to earn rewards and unlock new sorting games
Goods Puzzle: 3D Sorting Games offers countless levels with vivid 3D object designs, from delicious snacks and refreshing drinks to adorable figurines and everyday essentials. With intuitive 3D gameplay, simple but stunning graphics, and abundant rewards in match 3 games, you can not only experience the joy in the shopping mall but also step into a world of triple tile sorting games with brain challenges and mind relaxation.
Are you up for the fun and enjoyable match 3D and sorting games? Unlock a wide variety of goods and challenge your brainpower in this delightful mix of 3D matching and sorting games journey!
Privacy Policy: https://goods.gurugame.ai/policy.html
Terms of Service: https://goods.gurugame.ai/termsofservice.html

bluejetty:00095983:ios.description:
Experience seamless streaming with this smart player – your ultimate solution for watching live TV, movies, and on-demand content. Enjoy smooth playback, an intuitive interface, and high-quality streaming with support for various IPTV playlists.
Key Features:
- Supports M3U & XSPF Playlists – Easily upload and manage multiple IPTV playlists.
- High-Quality Streaming – Watch live TV and video-on-demand with crystal-clear playback.
- Fast & Simple Setup – Easily add channels and start streaming in seconds.
- Multi-Screen Support – Enjoy split-screen viewing and picture-in-picture mode.
- Electronic Program Guide (EPG) – View schedules for upcoming shows and events.
- Favorite Channels List – Quickly access your preferred channels.
- Parental Controls – Restrict access to certain channels for a safe viewing experience.
- Chromecast & AirPlay Support – Stream content directly to your TV.
Who Is This App For?
Live TV Enthusiasts – Access global channels from IPTV providers.
Sports & Movie Fans – Enjoy real-time matches, series, and films.
Cord Cutters – Replace traditional cable with IPTV streaming.
In-App Purchases and Subscriptions
This app offers optional premium subscriptions that unlock additional features, such as an ad-free experience, unlimited playlist management, and advanced EPG support. Subscriptions can be canceled at any time through your account settings.

Welcome to Battle Guys: Royale – the ultimate mobile shooter showdown!
Gear up for an adrenaline-pumping multiplayer battle royale experience where tactical decisions and chaotic brawls collide. Whether you thrive in fast-paced shootouts or master survival in ever-shrinking warzones, every second counts as you fight to be the last one standing.
Key Features: 
• Immerse yourself in intense PvP battles and conquer dynamic battlegrounds filled with nonstop action. 
• Experience a streamlined battle royale that's easy to pick up but challenging to master, built for mobile-first play. 
• Showcase your skills in exhilarating multiplayer warfare packed with thrilling close-quarters battles and strategic power-up hunts. 
• Dive solo into the fray or squad up with friends for even more intense showdowns on diverse battlegrounds. 
• Arm yourself with a wide arsenal of weapons and roguelike powerups to shift the tide of battle in your favor. 
• Brawl against other rising stars — no two matches are the same in this ever-evolving multiplayer experience! 
• Parachute into dynamic maps, collect game-changing upgrades, and battle your way through thrilling final duels for ultimate victory.
Join the Brawl!
Whether you're a sharpshooter from the frontlines or a survivor from chaotic arenas, Battle Guys: Royale delivers a dynamic and exciting experience for all players. Download now to answer the call and claim your place as the last one standing!
Get ready to brawl, survive, and emerge victorious in the most action-packed mobile shooter of 2025 — brought to you by the original creators of Stumble Guys.

You are a solar-powered craft. The sun is your death timer. Hurtle towards the sunset at breakneck speed in a futile race against time. bluejetty:00119782:ios.description:
Zoho Campaigns is your all-in-one mobile marketing platform with a Reimagined interface, Multi-channel Campaign Tracking, Workflow Automation, and Deeper Contact management, all from the palm of your hand.
Beyond email, Zoho Campaigns now brings your SMS Campaigns, WhatsApp Campaigns, Workflows, and audience together in one place - so you always know how your marketing is performing.
MULTI-CHANNEL CAMPAIGNS
- Track Email, SMS, and WhatsApp Campaigns from a single app.
- Pause, Resume, Reschedule, or Cancel Campaigns right from the app.
REPORTS AND ANALYTICS
- Monitor opens, clicks, bounces, and unsubscribes in real time.
- Understand your audience by location, device, and more.
- Drill down into recipient activity to see exactly who engaged.
- View rich, interactive charts that turn your numbers into insights.
WORKFLOW AUTOMATION
- Follow your workflows and see how contacts move through each stage.
- Track entries, exits, and goals with detailed workflow reports.
CONTACT MANAGEMENT
- Browse your Mailing lists, Segments, and Contacts on the go.
- View everything about a contact at a glance — profile, notes, associations, and CRM deal insights.
- Call, Email, or map a contact in a single tap.
BUILT FOR THE WAY YOU WORK
- Access all the portals and workspaces in your organization from one place.
- Switch effortlessly between Light and Dark modes.
- Enjoy a clean, intuitive design optimized for a fast mobile experience.
- Visualize more content on larger screens with a layout crafted for productivity.
- Accessibility Full screen reader support with audible descriptions 
With billions of campaigns sent and counting, Zoho Campaigns is your go-to tool for marketing - now more powerful, and more mobile, than ever.

bluejetty:00022217:ios.summary: The official MCN app is a must-have for motorbike enthusiasts. Read the latest motorbike news, road tests, top riding gear reviews, and expert advice. Get the full newspaper delivered to your phone or tablet, the same day it arrives in shop
bluejetty:00022217:ios.description:
The official MCN app is a must-have for motorbike enthusiasts. Read the latest motorbike news, road tests, top riding gear reviews, and expert advice. Get the full newspaper delivered to your phone or tablet, the same day it arrives in shops. 
Features we love:
- Enjoy exclusive content. 
- Quickly search for reviews on any bike, including much loved brands such as Honda, Yamaha, BMW, Ducati, Triumph. 
- Bookmark your favourite stories for later 
Every week, MCN’s team of expert test riders and reporters: 
* Review new and used motorcycles 
* Bring you the latest motorbike news 
* Help bikers make the very best buying decisions 
* Provide the latest MotoGP, World Superbikes, British Superbikes and road racing news 
With nearly half a billion papers sold and more than 1.5 billion readers entertained and informed over its history, MCN can lay claim to being the world’s leading source of biking news. 
The spirit of MCN then was as it is now: to bring you the stories and information you care most about, first. 
So, whether you’re after a new bike, a great insurance offer, or some cracking top gear at exclusive prices… MCN is the place to come! 
Please Note: This app is optimised for iOS 14 and higher. If you're using an iPad 1 or 2, iPad Mini 1 or iPhone 5 (or before) you may struggle to run this app smoothly.

You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings up until 24-hours before the end of the current period, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. OmniGraffle provides a thoughtful, professional interface for creating everything from basic wireframes to polished interface sketches, tools to construct SVG graphics for your next website, or designing the layout for your next hundred-server project.
A thoughtful sketch or professional diagram communicates far better than words. When you need a clear understanding of how information needs to be presented or how processes are carried out, OmniGraffle 3 for iOS is the tool to help you organize your thoughts visually, document them beautifully, and communicate them to the world. bluejetty:00060854:ios.description:
Using the Amazon Live Creator app, brands and influencers can livestream and reach customers on Amazon.com. Livestreaming allows you to showcase products and interact with shoppers in real time. Use the app to create your livestream, including adding products to feature, and then use the built in camera to shoot and produce the stream in minutes. Analyze your performance and improve your next livestream with our built-in analytics. As you use the Amazon Live Creator app, your performance is counted towards your creator level. Use the app to track your progress towards leveling up your creator level and unlock even more rewards and benefits by leveling up. 
Features:
• Streaming with the Amazon Live Creator app is free.
• Currently available to: Amazon Sellers that are enrolled in Amazon’s Brand Registry, Amazon Vendors that have created and published a store on Amazon’s Advertising Console (https://advertising.amazon.com) and influencers in the Amazon Influencer Program (https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/influencers).
• Getting started only takes a few taps; stream directly from your phone or stream with broadcasting software and a professional camera. 
• Products you choose to feature in your stream can be found next to the video player, making it easy for shoppers to add them to their cart.
• During your livestream, shoppers can chat with you and with other shoppers.
• Analyze your performance and improve your next livestream with our built-in analytics.
For feedback and assistance, please visit our support center: https://www.amazon.com/live/creator

bluejetty:00180864:ios.name: Mobile Lactation Consultant
bluejetty:00180864:ios.summary:
OVERVIEW : 
Mobile Lactation Consultant is the premier electronic charting and patient health records software for the iPad, iPhone and Mac. Lactation Consultants hand their iPad to the client and they fill out their entire health history a
bluejetty:00180864:ios.description:
OVERVIEW : 
Mobile Lactation Consultant is the premier electronic charting and patient health records software for the iPad, iPhone and Mac. Lactation Consultants hand their iPad to the client and they fill out their entire health history and sign all documents and consent forms. Clients can also use the web-based client portal to fill out their initial paperwork. Then the Lactation Consultant uses the iPad to record breastfeeding visits, maternal exams, infant exams, billing, create tasks, notes and anything you can possibly think a IBCLC, CLC, CBE or CLE would need to record. IT'S TIME TO GO PAPERLESS!!! 
Best of all, Mobile Lactation Consultant does not need to be connected to the internet to work like other web-based EHR solutions do. So if you need to attend a breastfeeding consultation at a home, NO WORRIES! If there is no internet connection the app will work just the same. Later, once an internet connection is detected all of your data will backup to the Mobile Lactation Consultant servers and other users in your practice with different iPads will automatically get updated with the new data you entered! 
TOP FEATURES : 
• Record all patient information including health history, prior pregnancies, financial information and so much more. 
• Record client visits, infant exams, maternal exams, breastfeeding exams, etc. 
• New Artificial Intelligence features to record visit audio and generate charting for you!
• Record plan of care and your assessment. 
• Record phone conversations, texts, emails
• Reminder system & Track customer billing. View all outstanding balances for all clients. 
• Create tasks and assign them to other staff members or yourself. 
• Schedule appointments from within Mobile Lactation Consultant on your iPad calendar
• Choose from a full set of built in CPT and ICD codes to help you bill insurance
• New insurance claims feature generates CMS 1500 and UB-04 forms so you can bill insurance directly or electronically
• Print, Fax, Email or export any part of the client record as a password protected PDF!
• NOW you can go PAPERLESS!! Import PDFs and create a document template by dropping text boxes, check boxes and signature boxes wherever needed on the PDF to make it fully interactive. Once you create your document templates your new clients will be guided to sign all of the documents as part of their sign up process after they complete their health history information using only their finger or a stylus.
• Use new sign off feature to lock records
• New Audit features show every single field change, who did it and from what device since the creation of any record
• Login with your finger print instead of typing a password overtime
• Messaging feature records all emails between patient and care provider under client record
• Use new Chat feature to instant message your clients. Message will not wake you at night unless client indicates it's urgent.
• Generate reports on your practice statistics, including number of clients delivered, outcomes and transfer rate.
• Export your data as an Excel spreadsheet so you can utilize it for your own purposes such as reporting to the state, creating your own statistical analysis or tracking any other metric such as average visit duration.
• Use our new Calendar feature to schedule appointments. Appointment reminders will go to your clients by email and text.
• You can now charge client cards or send a link to your clients that lets them make payments

bluejetty:00046240:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00046240:ios.description:
JOIN THE MAGICAL BATTLE IN NIGHT AT THE VALLEY!
Step into the enchanting world of Emerald Village, where Moo and Lulu need your help to defend their quaint town from an invasion of magical creatures! In this idle tower defense RPG, you’ll build, upgrade, and strategize to protect the valley from waves of whimsical yet dangerous foes. Ready for an idle game adventure packed with strategy and mystery? 
DEFEND WITH STRATEGY!
As a lone defender, you’ll command Moo and Lulu to fend off mystical enemies—from fiery Scorchmops to shadowy Draculas! Defend your tower, unleash powerful skills, and watch your defenses grow stronger with every wave.
UNCOVER EMERALD VILLAGE’S MYSTERIES!
Dive deeper into the swampy marshes, dark schools, and eerie cemeteries of Emerald Village. Each chapter unveils new challenges, quirky bosses, and secrets waiting to be discovered. Face off against the likes of Wicked Wailer in the forest or Dice Magus at the carnival—each with unique attacks that’ll test your strategy skills!
IDLE PROGRESSION & UPGRADES!
Grind for resources, earn idle gold (even offline!), and merge items to unlock powerful upgrades. From the Leather Jacket—“Tougher than a swamp snake’s hide, this jacket says ‘I’m cool’ while you’re getting bashed!”—to the Brass Knuckles—“Punch like a pro with these shiny knuckles—perfect for a locker room brawl!”—your gear will make Moo and Lulu unstoppable. Collect loot, level up, and become the ultimate defender!
EPIC CHALLENGES AWAIT!
Battle through thrilling chapters, each with unique settings and bosses. Defeat Ooga Booga in the swamp or face the Drillbot deep in the caves. With every victory, uncover more of Emerald Village’s mysteries and grow stronger. Can you protect the valley and become a legend?
WHY PLAY NIGHT AT THE VALLEY?
- Addictive idle tower defense gameplay with strategic depth
- Grind and merge to unlock powerful upgrades and gear
- Explore unique chapters, from forests to cemeteries
- Face quirky bosses like Bladeflower and Dracula Rex
- Earn idle gold online and offline to keep progressing
- Rate us 5 stars to support Moo and Lulu’s adventure! 
Download Night at the Valley now and defend Emerald Village in this magical tower defense adventure! Join the fight, uncover the mysteries, and become the hero the valley needs!

The best Truth or Dare app with the most exciting questions to guarantee the perfect night with your friends! Get ready for a night of unforgettable fun!

Choose from more than 1,000 truth or dare questions for a fun party that lasts all night long!

Which truth or dare difficulty will you choose?

- Launch the truth or dare app

- Enter your names
- Select your level
- ... Spin the wheel!

◉ Create Your Own Dares!
Want to customize your truth and dare game? This app makes it possible! Let your imagination run wild to create personalized truth and dare challenges for a night you will never forget. And thanks to our automatic synchronization feature, you won’t risk losing your truths and dares if you lose or change your phone!
Include your personalized truth and dare challenges with those in the app to guarantee an evening of endless possibilities! So, what are you waiting for?

Our test experts will be updating and revising the test content based on the latest syllabus published by the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board.
PTCB PTCE Test Prep 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully researched past exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have expertly categorized all exam subjects so that you can practice in a more focused manner.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test patterns;
* Subject categorization based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,300 high-quality test questions and answer explanations;
* Achievement tracking and analyzing system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for PTCB, PTCE or CPhT certification exams can be difficult. However, with the help of PTCB PTCE Test Prep 2026, if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we can help you achieve your goal!
Stop being confused or frustrated with PTCB, PTCE or CPhT exam preparation. Effective change takes time and effort. Follow in the footsteps of PTCB PTCE Test Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated!
Let's get started now!

Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms

bluejetty:00200180:ios.name: FoldTick
bluejetty:00200180:ios.summary:
For iPhone Duo only.
Give your Duo an odometer.
You know that satisfying feeling of folding your Duo closed? Now you can put a number on it. FoldTick turns your everyday folds into a beautifully crafted split-flap counter, widgets that fe
bluejetty:00200180:ios.description:
For iPhone Duo only.
Give your Duo an odometer.
You know that satisfying feeling of folding your Duo closed? Now you can put a number on it. FoldTick turns your everyday folds into a beautifully crafted split-flap counter, widgets that feel right at home, and a growing picture of how you use your Duo.
A COUNTER WITH CHARACTER
Watch your lifetime total grow on a graphite split-flap display inspired by mechanical counters. Collect milestones along the way, from your first fold to the next big number.
YOUR COUNT, WHERE YOU WANT IT
Bring FoldTick to your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Choose a compact counter, a medium widget with today and yesterday side by side, or a wide counter that gives the numbers center stage. Show today's folds or your all-time total. Home widgets follow light and dark appearance while their mechanical flaps stay dark.
A HEAD START FOR YOUR COUNTER
Already folded your Duo before installing FoldTick? Add your own estimate in Settings. It’s included in your lifetime total and milestone progress. Daily activity and personal insights stay based on recorded folds. Change the estimate or clear it any time.
SEE HOW YOUR DAY UNFOLDS
Explore your hourly activity, compare the last seven days, and browse a 30-day calendar with a count for every day. Personal insights reveal your daily average, busiest day and hour, and weekly change using up to 30 completed days. Recent activity puts your latest folds into neat time tiles.
SHARE A LITTLE OF YOUR RHYTHM
Turn your lifetime count, today’s folds, seven-day chart, 30-day calendar or personal insights into a beautifully styled image. Save it to Photos or choose where to share it using the iOS share sheet. Nothing is posted automatically.
SET IT UP. LET IT TICK.
New to Shortcuts? The illustrated guide walks you through creating one closing automation in a few simple steps. Once configured, its Record Fold action can keep count while FoldTick is off-screen, including while your Duo is locked after its first unlock.
JUST YOUR FOLDS
No account. No ads. No subscriptions. No analytics service. Your fold history stays on your device, and insights are calculated there too. Sharing is always your choice.
IMPORTANT COMPATIBILITY AND SETUP
FoldTick is designed exclusively for iPhone Duo. Automatic fold counting requires iPhone Duo with iOS 27.1 or later and one enabled closing automation in Apple's Shortcuts app. Other iPhone models do not support the required closing trigger.
Each closing action delivered by Shortcuts adds one fold cycle. Counting starts after setup; earlier folds and actions not delivered by Shortcuts cannot be recovered. Personal insights exclude today, the first recording day and your Earlier folds estimate; weekly comparisons need 14 completed days. Days without received folds count as zero, including when an automation did not run. iOS schedules automatic widget updates, so widgets may lag behind the saved count. Use the widget refresh control to request the latest saved value.
FoldTick is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. iPhone Duo is a trademark of Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00070199:ios.description:
Experience pure football – with the official Bundesliga app!
All results, goals, line-ups and highlights straight to your iPhone – in real time & personalised. Whether you're a fan of Bayern, Dortmund or Elversberg: with this app you're always right in the middle of the action.
Your Bundesliga season 26/27 at a glance:
NEW: Official Bundesliga Fantasy Manager – play for free
NEW: Captain – your AI matchday companion
NEW: Predicted line-ups on the Tuesday before the match
NEW: Now follow your favourite player in the app too
Fastest live ticker & goal alert for the Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2
DFB-Pokal and Champions League in the live ticker
All highlights free – no subscription
100% official from the Bundesliga
NEW: Bundesliga Fantasy Manager
The only official Fantasy Manager of the Bundesliga – right in the app, for free. Put together your team of real Bundesliga professionals, collect points on every matchday for real-life performances and compete in private leagues against your friends or in public leagues against the community (and win great prizes).
NEW: Captain – your AI match companion for matchday
Just ask. Captain answers your questions – about every team, every match and every player in the Bundesliga. How many goals has your striker scored since the winter break? Captain finds the answer in the official Bundesliga data – and the matching video clip to go with it.
NEW: Predicted line-ups
See the expected starting eleven of both teams as early as the Tuesday before the match – with formations and last-minute changes.
Real-time football experience
Follow every match in the Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 with the fastest live ticker. Stay up to date at all times with the goal alert and push notifications.
DFB-Pokal & Champions League
Not just the league: follow the DFB-Pokal too, with live ticker, results and fixtures. And when your Bundesliga clubs play internationally, you stay just as close with the Champions League live ticker, all results and the current table.
Man of the Match – your vote counts
Who was the best on the pitch? Vote for your player in the official Bundesliga Man of the Match voting and see in real time how fans across Germany are voting. The official voting – only in the Bundesliga app.
Fixtures & match reminders
The personalisable fixture list shows you all matches clearly arranged by matchday. Activate reminders for individual matches and never miss a game again.
News & exclusive content
All football news at a glance: transfers, injuries, tactics, interviews and more – tailored to your interests. Your feed is as individual as your club.
All goals & highlights – free
From Monday, 00:00: watch all Bundesliga highlights for free! Plus: Match Stories with previews and post-match reports, interviews, tactical analyses, Bundesliga Shorts and much more.
Statistics for real fans
Data that goes deeper: xGoals, pass completion rates, distance covered, duels – for every match, every player and every club. Stats nerds get their money's worth here – and anyone who doesn't fancy tables just asks Captain.
Push & goal alert in real time
Set your favourite club and receive targeted push notifications about goals, line-ups, kick-off and special moments. With the goal alert you won't miss a thing – wherever you are.
Your benefits at a glance:
Official Bundesliga Fantasy Manager – free
Captain: ask questions, get answers and videos instantly
Predicted line-ups & live ticker for all matches
Bundesliga, Bundesliga 2, DFB-Pokal & Champions League
Official Man of the Match voting
Personal fixture list & goal alert
Statistics, news & exclusive content
Video highlights & Match Stories
100% official Bundesliga app
Download now for free and experience the football world of the Bundesliga – with all the goals, data, news and videos you need. Straight to your iPhone!

bluejetty:00146280:ios.description:

- High-Precision AI: Proprietary technology to generate subtitles in Portuguese, English, and Spanish that truly understand what you say.

- Focus on Engagement: More than 80% of videos are watched on mute. Do not lose your audience and make your content accessible to everyone.

1. Upload your video: Import the video from your gallery (supports videos of up to 10 minutes)
2. Generate the subtitle: Our AI does the heavy lifting in seconds.
3. Customize and Export: Adjust the style and positioning, and you're done!
OBSERVATIONS
For best results, use videos with clear speech, good diction, and no background noise.
We currently do not generate subtitles for music.
TRY FOR FREE NOW
Try all the premium tools in up to 5 videos for free after logging in. Then, choose the plan that best suits your production: weekly, monthly, or annual.

bluejetty:00163407:ios.description:
Easily manage your healthcare in one place with the Healthengine app.
We’re here to make healthcare easier to access, helping you find the right care and book it fast. 
MANAGE YOUR HEALTHCARE IN ONE APP 
• Find, book and manage appointments 24/7 with GPs, dentists, physios and more near you 
• Choose from 10,000+ practices and 30,000+ practitioners across Australia, including bulk billing, urgent and after-hours appointments 
• Search by suburb, specialty and availability to find the right provider 
• See pricing from participating providers before you book 
• Filter by health fund (where available) 
• Book same-day and after-hours GP appointments when you need care fast 
• Access telehealth with online GPs for things like medical certificates, general consults, referrals and advice
• Save favourites in My Care Team™ and book again in a few taps 
• View your appointment history and rebook in seconds 
• Get smart reminders and calendar sync, so you don’t miss an appointment 
• View prescriptions securely and request repeats online (where available) 
• Book with confidence, your health information is protected 
FIND AND BOOK HEALTHCARE PROVIDERS
Healthengine helps you connect with:
• GPs 
• Dentists 
• Physiotherapists
• Chiropractors 
• Podiatrists 
• Psychologists
• Medical specialists 
• Pharmacy services
• Urgent appointments (where available) 
…and more. 
WHY MILLIONS OF AUSTRALIANS CHOOSE HEALTHENGINE 
• One of Australia’s largest healthcare booking platforms 
• 10,000+ practices and 30,000+ practitioners nationwide 
• Book care across GP, dental, allied health, specialist and more
Healthcare should be easy to access. 
Whether it’s preventive care or urgent help, Healthengine is here to help you find the care you need, when you need it.

bluejetty:00185786:ios.description:
Castle Solitaire is a free and fun new card game from MobilityWare, the maker of all your favorite solitaire games. In this fast and easy to learn game, you can build your castles and fly your banner high!
== How to Play ==
To win at Castle Solitaire, fill the four castles from Ace to King. Tap to arrange cards of the same suit in descending order below the castles. If you get stuck, just tap the stockpile to reveal more cards to use. Castle Solitaire is similar to Vanishing Cross or King’s Corner, but with it’s own special twist.
== Features ==
- Customize your experience with different backgrounds and cards. You can even use one of your own photos as the background!
- Progress through the levels and earn new titles from Serf up to Town Crier and beyond!
- Celebrate your wins with exciting winning animations!
== More Fun Card Games from MobilityWare ==
- Solitaire, also known as Klondike or Patience
- Spider Solitaire
- Freecell
- Pyramid Solitaire
- Crown Solitaire
- Tripeaks Solitaire
- Spider Go Solitaire
- Destination Solitaire
- Blackjack casino game
LIKE US on Facebook
http://www.facebook.com/mobilitywaresolitaire
Questions? Comments? Concerns? We would love to hear from you! Reach us at 
http://www.mobilityware.com/support.php
Castle Solitaire is created and supported by MobilityWare.
EXCLUSIVE FEATURES WITH SUBSCRIPTION SERVICE
- NO Ad interruptions or Banners!
- Ability to play future Daily Challenges!
- Four Exclusive Themes with Four Gorgeous Card Sets!
About Castle Solitaire Subscription
Castle Solitaire Subscription is an optional subscription that gives you access to seamless play without any ads, the ability to play future Daily Challenges and exclusive themes.
You can subscribe to Castle Solitaire for a term of one month, three months or for one year. New subscribers can choose a one-week trial subscription at no cost. The monthly term costs US$1.99. The three-month term costs US$4.99. The yearly term costs US$9.99. The subscriber's iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Any unused portion of a free trial period is forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. Renewal prices are US$1.99 per month, US$4.99 per every three months, or US$9.99 per year. The subscriber's iTunes Account will be charged for a renewal in the last 24 hours of the current period. Purchasers can manage their subscription and turn off automatic renewal in their Account Settings.
Subscriptions may be stopped by turning off automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. A subscription cannot be cancelled in the middle of its term.
Please see our privacy policy at http://mobilityware.com/privacy-policy.php

Can you easily spot the difference between two pictures? Try Spot the Difference: Brain Puzzle, a free brain puzzle game, created only for observant minds like yours! Challenge your observation skills and improve your focus by playing this new find the difference game for free! Can you handle this brain teaser game like a PRO? Find out NOW! 
Games like Find Differences: Brain Puzzle game are a great way to challenge your mind. It’s been proven that spotting the difference between pictures is quite an effective brain activity that can make you more observant and precise! You can even develop attention to details by playing find the difference game, which is AWESOME! Other than that, spot the difference games are a cool way to RELAX since this brain puzzle game engages your mind more subtly, so you’ll never feel tired!
FIND DIFFERENCES: BRAIN PUZZLE GAME FEATURES:
- Available in 29 languages
- Choose from a variety of IMAGE CATEGORIES like nature, people, animals, cars, food, interior design, and more!
- All images unlocked
- Use HINTS to see the difference you’re missing
- REFILL LIVES so you can continue playing
- No timer, no pressure
- Collect REWARDS and keep track of your ACHIEVEMENTS
- Find your place in the LEADERBOARD
- RELAX with soothing music and sound effects while you play
- Clean design and lots of images to choose from
- ZOOM in and out easily
- Designed for both phone and tablet
Find Differences: Brain Puzzle is more than a free BRAIN puzzle game that helps you stimulate your mind. It’s a brain teaser game that can enhance your focus, so no matter how you’ve started, you can finish this find the difference game like a PRO! Enjoy!

bluejetty:00079679:ios.description:
Introducing PreMomBot: Your AI-Powered Pregnancy Companion
Are you an expectant mother navigating your way through pregnancy and in search of reliable information, guidance, and support? Look no further than PreMomBot! This innovative mobile application is specifically designed for pregnant women and offers an AI-powered chatbot to provide personalized assistance during every stage of your pregnancy journey. PreMomBot is here to be your knowledgeable, trustworthy, and compassionate partner, with features to help you take care of yourself and prepare for your new arrival.
Key Features of PreMomBot:
1. AI-Powered Chatbot: The heart of PreMomBot lies in its cutting-edge AI chatbot technology, which is capable of understanding and processing natural language queries. This allows the chatbot to provide precise, useful, and timely information on a wide range of pregnancy-related topics. Moreover, the chatbot actively learns from each interaction, continuously improving its responses and tailoring the experience to each individual user.
With PreMomBot's chatbot, users can explore various categories, including:
 - Prenatal care
 - Nutrition and diet
 - Exercise during pregnancy
 - Health concerns and complications
 - Signs and symptoms
 - Labor and delivery
 - Postpartum care
 - Mental health during and after pregnancy
 - Maternity products and tools
 - Resources (books, videos, courses, etc.)
2. Comprehensive Resource Library: PreMomBot boasts an extensive library of resources, including books, videos, courses, and tools, covering a wide array of pregnancy-related subjects. Expand your knowledge and gain actionable insights to ensure a healthy, happy pregnancy experience.
Unlock the Support and Guidance You Need with PreMomBot
PreMomBot is the comprehensive and unique solution for expectant mothers who want to make informed decisions throughout their pregnancy journey. Know that you are not alone - PreMomBot is right by your side, providing valuable insights, guidance, and resources when you need them most. Start your journey today and embrace the empowerment, comfort, and companionship that PreMomBot brings.
Download PreMomBot now and get ready to experience a seamless and stress-free pregnancy journey!
"Disclaimer: This mobile app is designed to provide helpful advice for pregnant women, but it is not intended to replace professional medical consultation. Please consult with a doctor before making any medical decisions based on the information or advice provided by the app. Use this app as a supplementary tool alongside professional medical guidance."
To use PreMomBot and be able to communicate with the AI and receive recommendations, you can purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an in-app purchase.
- Auto-renewable subscription
-1 week ($4.99), 1 month ($14.99) and one year ($99.99) durations
- Payment will be charged to your App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. 
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto- renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription. 
- Manage or cancel your subscription from your user settings in the App Store at any time after purchasing.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.

Terms And Conditions: https://sunteame.com/premombot-terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00063850:ios.description:
Have hours of fun playing the best online multiplayer parcheesi and ludo! The board game that defined your childhood now for free! Play and compete with our community, invite your friends and family to join you and beat the highest scores of this awesome dice game!
Parcheesi or Ludo is an adaptation of Pachisi, a board game originated in India around the 6th century -at the same time as chess. The concept of this funny board game is clear: There are four players with four tokens of the same colour with a goal... Play and beat the opponents by moving all of your tokens to your goal box before everyone else! The parcheesi board has 68 boxes with numbers: Start in your corresponding nest and move forward by rolling your dices with the help of a dice cup until you arrive with your token to the goal box. You will need a strategy to win and beat the opponents. Do not get upset if you lose! This board game -with its variants- is easy to play but hard to master! Learn your own player tactics and achieve the necessary skills to be at the top of our parcheesi ranking!
Enjoy your childhood favourite board game now online and multiplayer! Chat with your friends while you challenge them or one of the other thousands of players who make up our Ludo community! Become the best Parcheesi online player and progress in this game learning new tactics!

- Have fun playing this free game! Upgrade your tokens with amazing emoticons and emojis!
- Multiplayer game: Chat, compete and invite and play with your family and friends!
- Easy rules and intuitive gameplay
- Play special games: Choose between playing making teams with a partner, turbo mode or private
- Compete to be the best player in our Parcheesi game ranking: Every match counts!
- Get double coins when you win your games with the "Double or Nothing"
- Unlock achievements and progress through this classic board game getting gifts and coins
- Appropriate for kids of all ages! Make teams with your family members!
Recall your childhood memories in this ludo game and join our great parcheesi online community!
Enjoy the best free Parcheesi online in Playspace! Roll your dice and start playing a match now! But, above all, have fun with this popular board game!

bluejetty:00032504:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00032504:ios.description:
== Featured in the App Store in 160 countries and regions. ==
== Repeatedly recommended as Game of the Day in the App Store. ==
A shattered alien world. A squad of 3 Hunters. Real-time combat where every element counts.
Will you be the hunter—or the hunted? Your battles decide the fate of the planet!
When the planet broke apart, the survivors fled to the orbital "Ring," longing for the Home they lost. Now the Hunters return to the world below—fighting across its ruined continents for survival, for hope, and for a future worth saving.
GAME FEATURES
- Real-time squad action — Control 3 Hunters at once for fast, exhilarating combat.
- Elemental combos — Burn with Fire, Freeze with Ice, or fuse "Fire + Ice" into "Water" to drench your prey. The tactics are yours.
- No limits, ever — No "Energy," no "Stamina." Explore and gather resources for as long as you like.
- Bizarre prey & giant bosses — Hunt notorious Hooligans, low-flying octopuses and twist-dancing sandworms… and pray you never meet the legendary "Giant Hand."
- 8+ Hunters, each with a story — Build a crew of unforgettable misfits and gear them up your way.
- Gear & set builds — Mix equipment, trigger set bonuses, and craft your perfect team combo. A great Hunter always has more than one trick.
- Refined retro pixel art — A gorgeous, hand-crafted alien world in classic pixel style.
The whole planet is your hunting ground. Grab your squad and move out, Hunter!
------ A Word from the Developers ------
It's been 5 years since our last game, "Brutal Street 2." Creating something new—while staying true to what came before—was anything but easy. "Home, Planet & Hunters" is a labor of love from all of us, and we truly hope you enjoy it.
— The 12 friends at Black Pearl Games

X (Twitter): twitter.com/bpgames321
Instagram: www.instagram.com/blackpearlgames
Threads: www.threads.net/@blackpearlgames

bluejetty:00063435:ios.description:

Send a digital gift card instantly using On Me. Shop online or in-store with curated, multi-brand Mastercard® gift cards. Create customizable virtual gifts for any occasion, and deliver them instantly or schedule them for another day. The choice is yours to send, and theirs to spend.

Add gift cards to your Apple Wallet for Apple Pay®, and never lose or forget about a gift card again. Received the same gift? Easily combine the value. Gifting just became more magical.

- Personalized Digital Gifts: Stand out by customizing your gift cards. Add photos, videos, and GIFs to make every gift memorable and loved.
- 70+ Multi-Store Gift Cards: Choose from a wide variety of gift cards that can be used at top retailers, brands, and stores online and in-store across categories like Sports, Fashion, Dining, Fitness, Travel, and more.
- Instant Digital Delivery: Send gifts instantly via email or text—or schedule them for the perfect moment.
- View & Manage: Never lose or forget a gift card again. View and spend your On Me gift cards through the app, so it's always with you.
- Mobile Wallet Integration: Easily check out in-store with your gift card when you add it to Google Pay. No numbers, no hassle.
- Secure & Reliable: Advanced two-factor authentication ensures your gift cards are safe, secure, and accessible.
- Customer Support: Questions? Chat with us through the app, and we can assist you in creating, designing, sending, or redeeming your gifts.

On Me is perfect for birthday gifts, holiday gifts, new year gifts, anniversary gifts, or for a simple thank you gift of appreciation. Whether for friends, family, or coworkers, there's something for everyone. Choose from gift card categories like Climbing, Yoga, Lunch, Basketball, Baking, Coffee, and more. It's all On Me.

Download On Me now and instantly start creating, designing, making, sending, and spending your customized gifts.

Learn more at https://onme.com

bluejetty:00097818:ios.description:
ARTS & CRAFTS WITHOUT THE CLEAN-UP!
Spark creativity with the most playful coloring app for ages 2-6! Safe, ad-free, and easy to use, Crayon Club brings the magic of arts and crafts to your child’s fingertips. Choose from hundreds of coloring pages, including PAW Patrol, Gabby’s Dollhouse, best-selling children's author Mo Willems' characters The Pigeon & Duckling, Sago Mini, holiday favorites, and more!
**Crayon Club is part of the Piknik bundle – one subscription, endless ways to play and learn! Get full access to the world's best apps for kids from Toca Boca, Sago Mini, and Originator with an Unlimited Plan.**
TONS OF FUN & CREATIVE TOOLS 
Digital crayons, paints, stamps, stickers, and silly surprises make every coloring page one of a kind! From color by numbers to blank canvases, kids explore colors, textures, and shapes with dozens of playful and inspiring tools. Make a rainbow with the magic wand, make it shimmer with glitter, or stick on some patterned washi tape! 
CALMING & FRUSTRATION-FREE PLAYTIME 
Designed for little hands and big imaginations, Crayon Club is perfect for creative quiet time. With intuitive navigation, kids can wind down with mindful coloring activities and explore self-expression. 
FAN-FAVORITE CHARACTERS 
Coloring is even better with friends! Kids can pick coloring packs with their favorite characters from PAW Patrol, including Chase, Rubble, Skye, and more. They’ll make cat-tastic creations with friends from Gabby’s Dollhouse, get creative with Harvey and his Sago Mini pals, and bring some color to The Pigeon & Duckling’s Bird-Day celebration.
FEATURES 
Unlimited access to 1000+ coloring pages in 75+ topics 
Tons of unique and inspiring tools
Share one subscription across multiple devices
New content added every month
Play offline for on-the-go fun
COPPA and kidSAFE-certified
No third-party advertising or in-app purchases
PRIVACY POLICY
Sago Mini is committed to protecting your privacy and the privacy of your children. We adhere to the strict guidelines set forth by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) & KidSAFE, which ensure the protection of your child’s information.
Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://playpiknik.link/terms-of-use/
ABOUT SAGO MINI 
Sago Mini is an award-winning company devoted to play. We make apps, games and toys for preschoolers worldwide. Toys that seed imagination and grow wonder. We bring thoughtful design to life. For kids. For parents. For giggles.
Find us on Instagram, X, and TikTok at @playpiknik.
Have questions, or want to say hello? Give the Crayon Club team a shout at support@playpiknik.com.

Cleaner Master Pro 
Here to rescue your iPhone and wallet!

Too many photos? Easily organize albums in seconds! 
Your photo library is packed with thousands of photos, and you don't know how to sort them? 
Use Cleaner Master Pro to make album cleanup quick and easy! 
Swipe left – Delete unwanted or duplicate photos 
Swipe right – Keep truly important memories 
You'll be amazed at how simple photo cleanup can be! 
Smart Selection – Keep Only the Best Photos 
Took many similar photos but can't decide which to keep? Cleaner Master Pro makes choosing easy! 
Our AI smart recommendations filter the best photos based on: 
• Your best smiles 
• Photos where you're facing the camera 
• The clearest, highest-quality images 
Of course, the final decision is always yours – we never delete any photos without your permission! 
You Have Full Control! 
Cleaner Master Pro features a Recycle Bin – deleted photos require secondary confirmation before permanent removal, preventing accidental deletion of important photos! 
Efficient Album Organization Lets You Focus on Life! 
Manual photo sorting is time-consuming and distracting. Before you know it, you're reminiscing and wasting hours without deleting a single photo. 
Cleaner Master Pro makes cleanup faster and more efficient, helping you create neat, organized albums without regretting wasted time! 
The Safest Personal Data Management Tool 
Unlike other apps, Cleaner Master Pro runs 100% locally – no internet connection needed. This ensures complete privacy for your photos and personal data. 
All operations happen directly on your iPhone – no privacy leaks or data collection! 
Smart Email Cleanup – Say Goodbye to Inbox Anxiety 
• Smart categorization: Automatically identifies important emails like work messages, subscription notices, and bill reminders 
• Batch cleanup: Delete emails with one tap to free up valuable storage space 
File Vault – Privacy Protection Expert 
New encrypted space providing ultimate protection for sensitive files: 
• Advanced encryption: Protects ID photos, private videos, and other sensitive files 
• Quick access: Unlock encrypted zone instantly with Touch ID/Face ID – 3x faster than traditional vaults 
Bulk Management & Video Compression 
Easily manage all your videos! Cleaner Master Pro offers: 
• Sort videos by size or date 
• One-tap bulk deletion of multiple videos 
• Compress videos while maintaining quality 
Free up iPhone storage now – download Cleaner Master Pro to experience it! 
Payment & Subscription Terms 
Cleaner Master Pro offers two subscription models to meet your needs: 
Weekly Subscription – Pay weekly to unlock all premium cleaning and optimization features 
Annual Subscription – Subscribe for one year at better value, keeping your iPhone running smoothly 
Free Trial & Auto-Renewal Rules 
Enjoy a 3-day free trial before subscribing to access all features of Cleaner Master Pro. 
After the trial ends, the system will automatically charge your iTunes account based on your chosen subscription plan. 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends. 
Renewal fees will be automatically deducted within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. 
You can manage or cancel subscriptions anytime via iPhone Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

bluejetty:00177572:ios.summary: براعم العاب تعليمية قصص أطفال — تعلّم ممتع بالعربية يجمع الحروف والأرقام مع قصص شيّقة وتلوين تفاعلي. صُمّم للأطفال في مراحل الروضة والمبتدئين ليبني المهارات الأساسية: القراءة والكتابة والعدّ والألوان — ويعمل بدون إنترنت ليتناسب مع كل الأوقا
bluejetty:00177572:ios.description:
براعم العاب تعليمية قصص أطفال — تعلّم ممتع بالعربية يجمع الحروف والأرقام مع قصص شيّقة وتلوين تفاعلي. صُمّم للأطفال في مراحل الروضة والمبتدئين ليبني المهارات الأساسية: القراءة والكتابة والعدّ والألوان — ويعمل بدون إنترنت ليتناسب مع كل الأوقات.
ماذا سيتعلّم طفلك؟
الحروف الهجائية العربية: عرض الحرف، صوته، وكلمات مصوّرة مرتبطة به.
الأرقام والعدّ: تمارين بسيطة للعدّ والتمييز بين الأرقام.
قصص عربية: حكايات قصيرة ممتعة تعزّز المفردات والفهم القرائي.
تلوين ورسومات: صفحات تلوين لتنمية الإبداع وتمييز الألوان.
حيوانات وفواكه وخضراوات: صور وأسماء وأصوات للتعرّف على العالم من حولهم.
لماذا براعم؟
تعلّم باللعب: أنشطة قصيرة تفاعلية تُشجّع الطفل على التقدّم خطوة بخطوة.
واجهة سهلة: تصميم واضح للأطفال وللوالدين.
استخدام بلا اتصال: حمل المحتوى واستمتع بالتعلّم في أي مكان بدون إنترنت.
تحديثات مستمرة: إضافة محتوى وتمارين جديدة بانتظام.
مناسب للفئة العمرية
محتوى ملائم للأطفال في الروضة والمراحل الأولى، مع تمارين تمهّد لـ القراءة والكتابة والرياضيات.
ابدأوا رحلة التعلّم بالعربية مع براعم: حروف، أرقام، قصص، تلوين — كل ما يحتاجه طفلك في تطبيق واحد سهل وآمن.

bluejetty:00183882:ios.description:
With Members First Credit Union's Mobile Banking iPhone App, you'll have the ability to take Members First and your accounts with you wherever you go! 
Our Features –
• Deposit checks 
• Use your fingerprint to log in
• View your balances quickly from the log in screen - just swipe up
• Send money securely to just about anyone with an email or mobile number
• Transfer funds between eligible accounts
• Locate one of our ATMs
Our Security – 
Banking with your Members First app is safe and secure, and is backed by our commitment to privacy and online security. Your personal information is protected by the same level of security as our Online Banking, which includes advanced encryption technology. 
•128 bit encryption
•Secure login information is not stored on your device
•There is an automatic inactivity logout if the application is inactive for 10 minutes
•Account masking – account numbers are truncated to only display the last 4 digits
*To use our Mobile Banking App, simply enter your online banking username and password. If you’re not already enrolled, contact us at 603-622-8781 to register.
Please check with your phone carrier for any standard text messaging fees that may apply.
To learn how we protect your privacy, please visit https://www.membersfirstnh.org/privacy-policy.html

Welcome to Manatee County’s Explore and Play App. Your go-to destination for discovering outdoor adventures, sports, community events, wildlife education, and a variety of programs for both youth and adults. Download now and make the most of your leisure time!
___________________________________________________________________________________________________
Sports and Leisure Services Club App
Explore: Discover the natural beauty of Manatee County's parks and easily reserve pavilions for your special gatherings directly through the app.
Get Active: Stay fit and have fun! Register for group fitness classes, youth sports programs, camps, racquet sports, and special event races with just a few taps.
Access with Ease: Recreation members can now use their digital key card within the app, no need to carry a physical key tag anymore.
Stay Informed: Get instant notifications about community events, activities, and recreational resources in Manatee County to stay connected and never miss out.
____________________________________________________________________________________________________
Natural Resources Club App
Explore: Immerse yourself in the beauty of Manatee County’s preserves. Easily reserve pavilions for gatherings and picnics right from the app.
Learn & Engage: Expand your knowledge of local wildlife and ecosystems by registering for educational programs and camps.
Camp: Book campsites with ease and experience the great outdoors, whether you're planning a weekend getaway or a night under the stars.
Stay Informed: Receive real-time updates on preserve programs, seasonal events, and important Natural Resources news to stay connected.
APPLE HEALTHKIT
We also use HealthKit to allow users to share their activity and workout data with the app. This data is used to incentivise users to stay active.
