Tanto pelo site da BERSI quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a BERSI Administradora, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente e tranquila. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para bersi@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00186126:ios.description:
Learn 3500 Turkish nouns, adjectives and verbs to enrich your vocabulary. Memorize most common Turkish words. Listen pronunciation of the words. Learn with word games, phrases and word lists. Best flash card app to learn Turkish most common vocabulary and words! 
Build a daily habit of learning 5 words a day to see long term progress.
- Flip the flashcards to find out the meaning of the Turkish words. 
- Swipe right if you learned the word.
- Swipe left if you want the card to be shown again in the future.
Features:
- Listen pronunciation of the Turkish words, verbs, phrases and adjectives.
- Track your progress in each level.
- Images provided in the back of the card to help you remember the words naturally. New images are being added.
- Review learned words.
- Play word games to practice in an entertaining way.
- Earn points by learning and practicing. Then unlock phrases and word lists.

bluejetty:00060739:ios.description:
Santa Biblia TLA – Traducción en Lenguaje Actual
Descubre una forma clara y moderna de leer la Palabra de Dios desde tu móvil. Santa Biblia TLA te permite acceder fácilmente a las Escrituras con una traducción pensada para el lenguaje actual, ideal para estudiar, reflexionar y fortalecer tu vida espiritual cada día.
La Traducción en Lenguaje Actual (TLA) fue realizada directamente desde los textos bíblicos originales en hebreo, arameo y griego. No es una adaptación de otras versiones existentes, sino una traducción oficial basada en fuentes reconocidas internacionalmente por las Sociedades Bíblicas Unidas.
Con una interfaz elegante, rápida y fácil de usar, podrás leer la Biblia en cualquier momento y lugar, incluso sin conexión a internet.
Características principales:
• Acceso completo a todos los libros y capítulos de la Santa Biblia TLA 
• Funciona sin conexión a internet 
• Diseño moderno y fácil de usar 
• Búsqueda rápida de libros, capítulos y versículos 
• Ajuste de tamaño de letra para una lectura más cómoda 
• Comparte versículos fácilmente con familiares y amigos 
• Guarda tus versículos favoritos 
• Estudios bíblicos integrados 
• Versículo del día 
• Modo oscuro para lectura nocturna 
• Navegación rápida entre capítulos y libros 
Santa Biblia TLA es una herramienta ideal para estudiar la Palabra de Dios, meditar diariamente y acercarte más al Señor desde cualquier lugar.
Descarga ahora Santa Biblia TLA y lleva la Biblia contigo todos los días.

bluejetty:00062664:ios.summary:
ScoreSkills is an innovative app that helps you to learn music and enhance your musical skills in a fun & interesting way. The App is designed for beginners and doesn’t require a musical instrument to enjoy.
ScoreSkills offers you (or you
bluejetty:00062664:ios.description:
ScoreSkills is an innovative app that helps you to learn music and enhance your musical skills in a fun & interesting way. The App is designed for beginners and doesn’t require a musical instrument to enjoy.
ScoreSkills offers you (or your kids) "learning by experience" fun exercises that teach you as you go to read, write and play music at your own pace, whenever and wherever you want.
“By far, it’s my favorite app, and it really helps me learn music theory while making it fun and interesting.”
With our proven techniques, developed by music experts and educators, you'll gain everything you need to master music and become a pro (music theory, ear-training, sight-reading, music writing, etc.). Not only that, it is proved that our learning methods improve other life & brain skills such as; creativity, focus, memory abilities, analytical skills, etc.
We introduce new skills by using step by step rewarding games and challenges that suit your playing level and give you instant feedback on your performance. 
WRITE YOUR OWN MUSIC!
ScoreSkills is the only music education app that trains your music-writing skills as a core part of learning. You'll be composing your own music in no time. Download now to practice reading, writing, singing, and listening to music and join our global community of music makers.
WHO IS THIS APP FOR?
Basically, anyone who can read and wants to improve his music and personal skills. It is perfectly suited for self-learning or as a supplement to learning with a teacher. 
WHAT WILL YOU LEARN?
The app contains thousands of levels, and we keep releasing hundreds more every few weeks that will teach you everything you need in a simplified way. 
Aural Foundations, Pitch Matching, Directional Audiation, Note reading up to an octave, Rhythms including Whole, Half, and Quarter Notes, Notes up to staff edges, Rhythms including eighth and 16th notes, Accidentals, Tonic and Dominant Functions, Notes up to 3 Ledger Lines, Rhythms with Ties, 4 More Major Scales, Chord Inversions, Add Subdominant Chords, Whole and Half Steps, 4 More Major Scales, Interval Quality, Simple Chord Progressions, Rhythms in 2/4, 4/4, and 6/8, Complex Rhythms in Duple/Triplets, All 12 Major keys and scales, Chord Progressions, and more subjects are arriving soon.
HOW DOES THE SUBSCRIPTION WORK?
Get a 7-day free trial! 
Subscribers will receive unlimited access to all of the chapters and levels. If you enjoy your ScoreSkills trial, do nothing, and your subscription will automatically continue.
You can choose the plan that suits you the most between our 3 plans. 
Prices may vary in different countries, and payment will be charged to iTunes Account.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
CONTACT 
We'd love to hear your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions while we strive to make music education fun and easy and enable anyone to become a composer.
Reach us at ScoreSkillsTeam@compoze.co
Have fun!
privacy policy: https://www.scoreskills.com/privacy.htm
terms of use: https://www.scoreskills.com/terms.htm

bluejetty:00072952:ios.summary:
Quran 360 is a comprehensive Al Quran app that offers a complete Quranic experience in the palm of your hand.
With features like

- The Quran Teacher
- reading the Quran with Tajweed,
- word-by-word tafsir
bluejetty:00072952:ios.description:
Quran 360 is a comprehensive Al Quran app that offers a complete Quranic experience in the palm of your hand.
With features like
- Tarteel Mistake Detection (NEW)
- The Quran Teacher
- reading the Quran with Tajweed,
- word-by-word tafsir and translation (Quran English),
- listening to famous reciters (Quran Audio),
- creating Quran playlists,
- bookmarking and searching,
- Quran offline mode, and more,
equips you to learn, comprehend, recite, and memorize the Al Quran with ease. Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced learner of the Holy Quran, this app is perfect for you.
Perfect your Quranic Recitation with Tarteel Mistake Detection (NEW)
Our newly introduced Tarteel Mistake Detection feature acts as your personal Quran teacher, alerting you instantly to any missed or incorrect words in your recitation. This powerful tool helps you learn the correct recitation precisely, enhancing your Quranic study and practice.
Your Quran Teacher
With the Quran Teacher, you can ask anything about the Quran and Islam and get answers tailored to your needs, in seconds. This is a great way to strengthen your knowledge and understanding of the Quran and Islam.
Read Al Quran with Tajweed & Offline
Quran 360 is getting ready to take its place in the stores to eliminate difficulties such as the inability to adjust the font sizes, eye-catching designs, and other details that negatively affect the reading experience. It promises a more fluid reading experience.
If you learn the Holy Quran with Tajweed, you will be able to pronounce the Quranic verses correctly, reciting them in Tarteel and your recitation will sound more beautiful.
With Quran 360 app, you will always be able to read Allah's words without making any mistakes. Enjoy the serene recitations and enlightening insights of the Holy Quran even without an internet connection.
Al Quran Audio Mode with Famous Reciters
The most famous aspect of Quran 360’s listening feature is that it includes different reciters. You can listen to every ayah you want from the voices of famous reciters in Quran 360.
You can listen to surahs with recordings of well-known reciters such as Akram Al-Alaqmi (Gapless), Abdul Rashid Sufi, Abdul Muhsin al Qasim, Abdullah Mahrood, and more.
Memorize Quran Fast and Easily
With the ability to enhance the reading speed of the Holy Quran, you have the opportunity to recite the complete book swiftly. This feature proves valuable whether you wish to bypass memorized verses.
The Search in Al Quran Kareem functionality empowers efficient Quran memorization through its user-friendly strategy, effectively recognizing analogous verses (Mutashābihāt) for rapid comprehension.
Bookmarks and Playlists
It is very easy to bookmark surahs, verses, and Tilawat e Quran Kareem wherever you like.
With our playlist feature, you can listen to beautiful Quran playlists directly from the home page and create your own playlist.
Quran Tafsir - Guided Interpretations
Tafsir books demonstrate the real meanings and other details of the Ayah when they are read together with the Quran. You can see why that verse was revealed or after which event it was conveyed to the Prophet Muhammad (SAW).
Use Quran 360 to read different tafsirs and gain a deeper understanding.
Verified Al Quran Translations - Quran English, قران كريم, Coran, Koran, Al Quran Bangla
It contains 40+ Al Quran Kareem translations, transliterations, and tafsir/commentary.
The application includes translations of many languages such as English, Turkish, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Malay, Indonesian, Hindi, Urdu, Bangla, Persian, Bulgarian, Swedish, Italian, and more.
Privacy & Terms : https://www.muslimassistant.com/privacy-terms.html

bluejetty:00082823:ios.description:
Unlock the World Around You with Image Translator AI!
Whether traveling, studying, or exploring, reading in a new language just got easier. With Image Translator AI, translating text from photos or gallery images is fast, accurate, and incredibly simple. Take a picture of any sign, menu, document, or handwritten note, and let our app convert it to the language of your choice. From Arabic to Zulu, 120+ languages are just a tap away.
Key Features:
1. Camera & Gallery Translation
 • Capture and translate any text with your camera—no typing required!
 • Already snapped a photo? Just upload it from your gallery, and let our advanced AI do the rest.
2. 120+ Language Options
 • From popular languages like Spanish, French, and Chinese to rarer ones like Icelandic and Zulu, enjoy multilingual support that’s perfect for travel, study, and more.
3. Instant Text Recognition
 • The latest AI technology means fast, accurate text recognition. Translate even complex or stylized text in seconds!
4. Sleek, Intuitive Interface
 • Easy-to-use design lets you access translations in just a few taps. Effortlessly switch languages and get clear, precise results without hassle.
Who Is Image Translator AI For?
 • Travelers: Don’t let language barriers hold you back. Translate signs, menus, and guides instantly.
 • Students and Researchers: Study foreign documents and textbooks without missing a beat.
 • Professionals and Expats: Get work done efficiently, wherever you are, with multilingual document support.
Why Choose Image Translator AI?
Unlike other translation apps, we focus on accuracy and ease of use. Our app recognizes and translates even tricky fonts and stylized text, letting you interact with the world without language limitations. Image Translator AI isn’t just a tool—it’s your companion for a connected world.
Download Image Translator AI Today and Start Exploring!

- You may cancel a subscription or free-trial anytime via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the free-trial or subscription period to avoid being charged.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases a Image Translator Premium Subscription.

bluejetty:00176463:ios.summary:
Explore the World on Two Wheels!
Have you ever dreamed of exploring the world on your bike? Imagine the freedom of riding your own bike all the way from the southernmost tip of South America in Argentina to the northwest extremity of North
bluejetty:00176463:ios.description:
Explore the World on Two Wheels!
Have you ever dreamed of exploring the world on your bike? Imagine the freedom of riding your own bike all the way from the southernmost tip of South America in Argentina to the northwest extremity of North America in ALASKA, USA. You can even think of riding between glittering streets of LAS VEGAS to the scenic landscapes of IDAHO. 'MOTO WORLD TOUR: Bike Racing Game' turns this dream into reality.
Get ready for an awesome experience where you can pick routes between your favorite cities in any country—be it the USA, UK, India, or elsewhere. Just choose a route, rev up your bike, and go on an epic ride with ‘Moto World Tour’!"
And here's the best part: Moto World Tour is an ongoing adventure, with more countries and routes set to be added in future updates! Stay tuned for even more thrilling destinations to explore on your two-wheeled journey!
Couldn't find the country or city route you were looking for? No worries! Let us know, and we'll make sure to add it in the upcoming version. Your dream route could be the next addition!
MOTO WORLD TOUR | MODES
[ENDLESS]: Master in race, earn points, and dominate with unique sounds for each bike.
[CHALLENGE]: Conquer each challenge, race against the clock, and experience various environments.
[TIME TRIAL]: Cover check-points on given time and continue your bike riding experience.
[RACING]: Beat not only the traffic but the competing bikes around you. Be the No.1 in ‘Bike Race Championship’.
So ready to be a master in race? ‘Moto World Tour’ awaits! Race to visit the GLOBE on two wheels.
MOTO WORLD TOUR | KEY FEATURES
► Rewards on 100+ Achievements
► 1st Person Bike Racing View
► Go Against the traffic in two-way
► Straight as well as Zigzag Roads
► Ambient Sounds: Airplane, Heli, Ship Horn, Waterfall, Train
► Environments bike games: Highway, Industrial, Countryside, Island
► Experience the weather like snow, rain in day, night, morning or evening
► 30 Types of Competing On-Road Vehicles
MOTO WORLD TOUR | BIKE COLLECTION
We’ve made your world journey wonderful and full of biking experience through 11 different bikes;
► Start your journey on KNIGHTS NINJA
► Speed up to increase the thrill with KNIGHTS Z75
► KNIGHTS PULSER is here to give you experience of HEAVY BIKE
► Ride on Chopper Bikes i.e HERALDSON & KNIGHTS T6
► The Champion Racer Bikes i.e HAYEBUSA & YANANA RRO
► Go on Island ramps with your TRAIL TT
We’re yet open to have any feedback on bike addition or customization
MOTO WORLD TOUR | TIPS TO FOLLOW
[BOOSTER]: The faster you ride, the higher your scores will rise up!
[OVERTAKE PRECISELY]: Speed over 100 km/h? Overtake traffic cars closely for bonus scores and extra cash.
[TWO-WAY THRILL]: Drive in the opposite direction for bonus scores and additional cash in two-way traffic.
[ONE-WHEELING]: Ride on a single wheel and master the art to earn bonus cash!
Have what it takes to visit the world with the best? Download ‘MOTO WORLD TOUR’ now!

listings.name: Chromatic Vision Simulator
listings.description:
"Chromatic Vision Simulator" is a color vision simulation tool which simulates the color vision of color vision deficiencies. This software is developed by Kazunori Asada (Ph.D. medical science and Ph.D. media design), based on the research in color science.

About 5% of men have difficulty distinguishing red and green, or recognizing dark red. Such color deficiency can be classified into three major categories: protanope / Protanomal, Deuteranope / Deuteranomal and Tritanope / Tritanomal.

Color deficiencies are the inability to tell differences between some colors other people can easily distinguish. People with different types of color vision deficiency perceive colors differently. For example, individuals diagnosed as Protan or Deutan cannot perceive differences between red and green, and pink and cyan.

These color visions are predictable by calculating working of the cone cells that perceives the color to some degree.

"Chromatic Vision Simulator" makes simulated images of each color vision type from built-in Camera or Photos and shows you how people with specific types of color vision sees the world in real-time.

- Compare how "Normal Color Vision," "Protanope," "Deuteranope" and "Tritanope" see the same scene, side by side. The screen can be divided into up to four.
- Change the simulation strength from 0 to 100%. You can also check the appearance between normal color vision and dichromacy.
- Switch between Appearance mode and Difference mode. Difference mode shows the difference between the original image and the simulated colors as brightness (the upper limit of the difference is set with the slider). Switch with a one-finger swipe on the toolbar, a two-finger swipe on the screen, or in Settings.
- Turn on "Show Color Name" and the color cursor shows the name of the color at the point you choose ("Systematic Color Name (ISCC-NBS)", "Traditional Color Name (TCCA)", "Systematic Color Name (JIS)" and "Traditional Color Name (JIS)"), together with values such as the Munsell value and CIELAB.
- Works with the rear and front cameras, and with photo files. Pinch to magnify up to 500%.
- Save the screen you are looking at as a photo. You can write the type and strength on the saved image (switch in Settings). You can also save with the volume button.
- On devices with a wide color gamut (Display P3), images are shown and saved in the wide color gamut.
- Works with VoiceOver.
- Works on both the outer and the inner screen of the foldable iPhone (iPhone Duo).
- Available in Japanese and English.
- No network access. Camera images are used only for display on the screen and for saving on your device.
- The theory behind the simulation is published on the website.
  https://asada.website/cvsimulator/e/theory.html

bluejetty:00069698:ios.description:
Through the HonySmart app, you can easily unlock the following advanced features:
[Map Save](Only applicable to some devices) Turn on the map save mode, and after operating according to regulations, advanced functions such as room zoning, merging and segmentation can be achieved, while improving cleaning efficiency. 
[Virtual Walls and Restricted Areas] Set up virtual walls and restricted areas, ready to use and set, so that the robot will not cross the virtual wall or enter the restricted area during cleaning.
[Timing Cleaning] If you make an appointment a scheduled cleaning task, and the robot will start the cleaning task at the designated time. After completion, it will automatically return to the charging station.
[Selected Area Cleaning] (Only applicable to some devices) You can choose to specify a room for cleaning. After selection, only the selected room will be cleaned, and you can clean wherever you want.
[Spot Cleaning] Click on the location to be cleaned on the map, and after clicking Start, the robot will automatically plan the path to the target point and perform local cleaning.
[Resume Cleaning] When the battery level is below 20%, the robot automatically plans the shortest path to return to the charging station for charging: after fully charging, return to the unfinished area and continue cleaning.

bluejetty:00066434:android:1.description:
Join Talking Tom, Angela, Hank, Ginger, Ben, and Becca in the most exciting virtual pet adventure! Dive into a world of cool animals and endless fun! Visit their house and see why they are the ultimate pet friends!
Here's why you'll love playing with them:
- Take Care of All Six Friends: Interact with your favorite characters in one house! Feed, bathe, dress, and put them to sleep. Talk, play, and engage with Tom, Angela, Hank, Ginger, Ben, and Becca. Each character has their unique personality and needs.
- Design and Create Stories: Bring all your characters together to create and share fun stories. Your imagination is the limit!
- Creative and Sporty Activities: From gardening to chilling in the pool and playing musical instruments, there's always something fun to do.
- Closet Full of Fun Fashions: Dress up your friends in the latest styles. Unlock new outfits daily and show off your fashion sense!
- House Customization: Decorate and upgrade their house to make it the coolest home in town. Collect tokens and rewards to enhance your living space.
- Mini Games: Enjoy a variety of mini-games, from puzzles to action-packed challenges. There's something for everyone!
- Collect Stickers and Rewards: Complete your sticker album to earn special rewards and unlock whacky food items. Feed your virtual friends and watch their hilarious reactions.
- Daily Trips to Town: Travel to different locations to shop for exciting new items and bring back surprises.
From Outfit7, creators of My Talking Tom, My Talking Tom 2 and My Talking Angela 2.
This app contains:
- Promotion of Outfit7's products and advertising;
- Links that direct customers to Outfit7’s websites and other apps;
- Personalization of content to encourage users to play the app again;
- YouTube integration to allow users to watch videos of Outfit7's animated characters;
- The option to make in-app purchases;
- Subscriptions which automatically renew unless they are cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of a subscription period. You can manage and cancel your subscription via Settings in your App Store account;
- Items to purchase (available in different prices) using virtual currency, depending on the player’s progress;
- Alternative options to access all functionalities of the app without making any in-app purchases using real money.
Please note, we do not process all the data disclosed on the label for users under the age of digital consent. For more information, please check our Privacy Policy.
Terms of use: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/eula/en/
Privacy policy for games: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/privacy-policy-games/en
Customer support: support@outfit7.com

Everyday banking in the palm of your hand, no matter where you are.

TRANSFERS
INTERAC® e-Transfer

Your privacy is important to us. We never use your information for any other purpose other than delivering financial services to you. For information on our Privacy Policies, and how we keep your information safe, please see our privacy section on our website.

By downloading the credit union mobile banking application, you consent to the installation of this app, its future updates and upgrades. You can withdraw you consent at any time by deleting the app.

bluejetty:00068766:ios.summary: Ever wanted to have your own special pet that animates on you phone? Meet Pixel Pets! You’ll be able take care of your own animal pet by feeding and interacting with your new best friend. You can find your pet displayed on your Lock Screen,
bluejetty:00068766:ios.description:
Ever wanted to have your own special pet that animates on you phone? Meet Pixel Pets! You’ll be able take care of your own animal pet by feeding and interacting with your new best friend. You can find your pet displayed on your Lock Screen, Dynamic Island and even Live Notifications.   There really is no better way to have more fun on your iPhone than this new cool app. 
 There are now eight adorable pets that are live inside the app. They can't wait for you to add them to your widgets and start playing with them! 
Keep an eye out on your pet and see it change emotions and expressions throughout the day. You’ll need to feed your pet and also take them to exercise daily. Good friends look out for each other. Your pet will send you kisses when they’re happy!   We also support transparent widgets. You can see them floating on your home screen. 
Some of our first Pixel Pets include:  
—“Dog” = Spot is your loving companion! He loves adventuring through the wilderness and following you.
—“Cat” = Willow is your forever companion. She will follow you everywhere you go! Her favorite thing to do is sleep. But when you are near, she couldn't be more lively! 
—“Turtle” = Tyler-the-turtle is the wisest of them all. He is a young, smart turtle who can't wait to get to know you! 
—“Pig” = Jellybean is your partner. He will always be there for you, he loves exploring, adventuring, and of course... food! 
—“Frog” = Hopscotch is the fastest frog in the entire world. Catch him leaping all over as he follows you around! 
—“Duck” = Waddles is the cutest duck ever. She loves cuddling and following you around. Her soft feathers are super comfy!
—“Wolf” = Fierce has the strongest will out of every companion. She is a strong mother wolf who won't let anyone hurt the ones she cares for. 
—“Bear” = Polly is scary at first, but once you get to know her, you realize she is the grizzliest teddy bear!    
Pay-once and unlock all pets and features. 
- Get access to exclusive pets and pet food + games by upgrading to our one-time lifetime upgrade fee of $9.99USD. Seriously, this is a great offer. What are you waiting for?!
Subscription options:
- You can subscribe to unlimited access for pro features including exclusive pets and pet food + games exclusive icons.  Pixel Pets+ offers unlimited usage and unlocks all features for $4.99* monthly, with a yearly subscription option too.  Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that content. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.   
*This price is for United States customers. Pricing may differ depending on your country and actual charges may be converted to your local currency of residence. The prices are equal to “Apple’s App Store Matrix” which determines the equivalent subscription price in USD.

tiktok.com/@pixelpetsapp
info.pixelpets@gmail.com

Privacy: https://twinstarcreatives.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00040889:ios.summary: The Alterna Savings mobile app gives you easy and secure banking access anywhere, anytime. You can pay bills, transfer funds, check your balances and more. Simple, convenient and secure – it’s the ideal app for your everyday banking needs.
bluejetty:00040889:ios.description:
The Alterna Savings mobile app gives you easy and secure banking access anywhere, anytime. You can pay bills, transfer funds, check your balances and more. Simple, convenient and secure – it’s the ideal app for your everyday banking needs.
Features:
LOG IN
• Securely access your accounts Touch ID, Face ID or password.
PAY BILLS
• Set-up instant, future-dated or recurring payments.
• View and edit upcoming scheduled bill payments.
TRANSFERS
• Send money instantly with Interac eTransfer®. 
• Autodeposit and Request Money with Interac eTransfer®.
• Transfer money between your Alterna Savings accounts.
• Transfer funds to and from your accounts in another financial institution.
• Interac e-Transfer® for Business to allow you to receive payments in real-time from participating financial institutions with rich remittance data for reconciling transactions with less reliance on paperwork to streamline your records.
DEPOSIT
• Quickly and securely deposit cheques – all you need to do is take a picture with your phone or tablet.
LOCATE BRANCHES/ATMs
• Search or use your current location to find nearby branches and ATMs.
SECURITY
• Your security is our top priority, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full Online Banking. 
• Set-up security notifications to your cell phone or email.
LANGUAGES
• Supports English and French.
To take full advantage of the Alterna Saving's app, you must be an Alterna Savings member, plus already be registered for and have logged into Online Banking. If you’re not an Online Banking user, you can still use the locator feature to find the closest ATM, including THE EXCHANGE® Network ATMs, check our rates or quickly find our contact information.
There’s no charge for the Alterna Savings app, but mobile data and/or internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.
PRIVACY
Your privacy and security is important to us.
LEGAL
By downloading the Alterna Savings Mobile Banking App you consent to the installation of this App and to any future updates or upgrades which may be automatically installed depending upon your device or operating system’s default setting or the settings you have selected. You can withdraw your consent at any time by uninstalling this App.
Alterna Savings is a registered trademark of Alterna.
Touch ID and Face ID are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.
Interac e-Transfer is a registered trade-mark of Interac Inc. Used under license.

bluejetty:00086698:ios.description:
Seja bem-vindo ao WizMe! 
Aqui você pratica as quatro habilidades comunicativas na língua inglesa: fala, compreensão auditiva, produção escrita e leitura. O WizMe vem com grandes novidades:
Nova interface e design: mais dinâmico, e mais moderno.
Novo onboarding: use seu email das redes sociais para acessar o WizMe.
Personalização de perfil: Escolha seu avatar e seu nome social.
Acessibilidade: suporte a esquema de cores específico e fonte adequada à dislexia.
Gamificação: conquiste medalhas e compartilhe em suas redes sociais.
Home screen: uma nova página inicial onde você encontra o dashboard de seu progresso e muito mais!
Nova ferramenta de reconhecimento de voz: calibrada de acordo com o nível de livro, te dá feedback de cada palavra dita.
Além disso, no WizMe você encontra: 
Notification center: o WizMe conta com uma área de notificação que te mostra suas conquistas.
Zero Class: aula introdutória que te prepara para aproveitar ao máximo a experiência de ensino Wizard by Pearson.
Diagnosis: questionário diagnóstico para entendermos melhor as especificidades de cada um de nossos alunos.
Diagnosis Pre and Diagnosis Post: teste de inglês que mede seu progresso de proficiência após concluir seus níveis na Wizard. Acompanhe sua progressão de aprendizagem!
Speaking Practice: atividades com voice recognition para você praticar sua pronúncia e fluência.
Pictionary: conjunto de imagens para te ajudar a fixar novas palavras e enriquecer seu vocabulário.
Audio Pack: No Audio Pack você encontra todo conteúdo de áudio do seu curso.
Class Prep: atividades que você faz antes de começar a lição do dia para se preparar e potencializar sua aprendizagem.
Homework: exercícios para casa com foco nas habilidades de compreensão auditiva e produção escrita que vão te ajudar a consolidar o conteúdo ensinado durante a aula.
Extra Activities: seleção de exercícios variados para serem trabalhados antes e depois das aulas, auxiliando no processo de aprendizagem.
Videos: seções There and Around e Dubbing com vídeos de situações cotidianasconectadas aos temas abordados no material.
Recording: grave um diálogo, ouça sua gravação e pratique as habilidades de fala e compreensão auditiva de forma interativa e divertida.
Self-Assessment: sente-se confortável com o que você estudou ou sentiu que faltou mais um pouco? Preencha o Self-assessment para entendemos como você se sente.
Memory: com um click de um botão, volte direto para a lição que havia aberto na última vez que acessou o aplicativo.
What’s next?: notificação para te deixar informado sobre o que será tratado no próximo bloco de lições.
Adaptive Notifications: notificações que te guiam ao que deve ser feito após concluir cada etapa dentro do WizMe.

bluejetty:00187950:ios.description:
CalArk Driven Mobile provides two-way messaging, load dispatch and updates, and the ability to submit paperwork and photos for accidents and claims to the back office. We walk you through the process with necessary data input and allow you to take photos or upload saved photos for your accident or claim submission.
Upon submitting documents, and accident and/or claim information you will receive a unique confirmation number and email notification enabling you to view your images for up to 14 days.
Image optimization will improve legibility even for carbon-copied documents and documents with light gray text on a color background (blue, yellow, green, pink, etc.)
Features & Functionality:
* Accept or reject loads
* One-swipe load status updates
* Two-way communication directly with dispatch and Safety
* Scan and doc type images
* Optimized image quality - Crop, rotate, lighten or darken an image for better image quality
* Quality check – automatically evaluates, scores and validates image quality before submission.
* Handle accident and claim submissions from your device
* View your settlements
* Compresses document image(s) for fast transmission and minimal data plan usage
* Allow multiple documents to be scanned & sent together
* No-hassle automatic app updates
**Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Locate X Find Location - Real-Time Location Tracking for Families
Locate X is a powerful location tracking app that lets you safely monitor the whereabouts of your loved ones. Ideal for *Family Location Tracking, this app simplifies your daily life while keeping the safety of your family and friends a top priority. Locate X Find Location keeps you connected to your family and close ones at all times.
Key Features:
- Real-Time Location Tracking: Easily track the real-time location of your family and loved ones. With Locate X, you can know where they are at any moment.
- Family Location Sharing: View the location of each member of your family in real-time. Always know if your loved ones are safe and secure.
- Geofence (Geo-fencing): Receive instant notifications when family members enter or leave designated areas. This feature ensures that your loved ones remain safe and within safe zones.
- Emergency Alerts: Receive fast and effective alerts if your loved ones are in an emergency situation.
- Trip History: Review the travel history of your family members with the location history feature.
- Location Tracking via Phone Number: Locate X allows you to track locations using phone numbers. Quickly learn where your loved ones are with just their phone number.
Child Location Tracking: 
Ensure that your children are safe when they go to school or visit other places. *Locate X* provides the safest way to track your children's movements. Additionally, you can track your children's location using their phone number, giving you peace of mind about their whereabouts at any time.
Start with a Free Trial!
Locate X Find Location offers a free trial, allowing users to explore all features and experience the security the app offers. Start with the free version and track your loved ones at all times!
Locate X Find Location helps you make your life safer and more organized. Not only can you track locations, but you can also ensure the safety of your loved ones at all times. With phone number-based location tracking, you will always be aware of the safety of your family members. Download now and discover the experience of a secure life!

Free music streaming is possible based on the videos provided by YouTube. However, the

bluejetty:00026995:ios.description:
The world’s most complete training platform for coaches and athletes to plan, lift, and train.
Use TrainingPeaks to maximize your potential. Connect the ability to plan, lift, and train for your endurance events and adventures.
Whether you are training to run a half marathon, finish a Gran Fondo, or complete a full-distance triathlon, TrainingPeaks provides the ultimate tools you need for your journey. Simply connect with your coach or load a training plan to fill your schedule and get started.
TrainingPeaks for Athletes
 • Flexible planning to fit your life: Easily adjust your schedule and sync your training with your daily routine.
 • Actionable Insights to keep you on track: Data-driven feedback that helps you understand your progress and stay motivated.
 • Build strength to be unbreakable: Integrated strength training plans designed to improve durability and performance.
 • Ride inside on TrainingPeaks Virtual: Experience world-class indoor training and ride with a global community.
 • Any sport, any device, any time: Seamlessly sync with your favorite wearable or head unit, ensuring your data is always where you need it.
TrainingPeaks for Coaches
 • Advanced tools for planning: Annual season planning and individual workout creation tools to make planning clear and quick.
 • Time-Saving Tools to Streamline Your Coaching: Keep your athletes on track with powerful performance dashboards, easy-to-understand compliance scores, notifications, and in-workout commenting.
 • Look pro. Feel pro. Manage payment, athlete groups, schedules and communication all in one streamlined tool.
 • Any sport, any device, any time: Athletes seamlessly sync with your favorite wearable or head unit, ensuring data is always where you need it.
Build community and engagement on TrainingPeaks Virtual: Keep athletes engaged year-round with the only indoor cycling platform designed for coaching.
Go to trainingpeaks.com to sign up for your coach account.
Trusted Partner of: 
USA Cycling, USA Triathlon, British Cycling, British Triathlon, AusTriathlon, Road Runners Club of America, INEOS Grenadiers Cycling Team and more
Privacy Policy: https://home.trainingpeaks.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00082429:ios.summary: Find up-to-date live soccer AI score, easy stats about matches and other metrics that allow for a much deeper understanding of soccer games in the AIstats sports app! This AI scorer provides soccer stats and results in more than 2,000 leagu
bluejetty:00082429:ios.description:
Find up-to-date live soccer AI score, easy stats about matches and other metrics that allow for a much deeper understanding of soccer games in the AIstats sports app! This AI scorer provides soccer stats and results in more than 2,000 leagues worldwide in real time.
This live soccer tracker app goes beyond soccer stats and scores, offering an entire ecosystem of unique metrics for a deeper analysis of the game. With the AIstats sports app, every fan can quickly assess any score match, from Major League Soccer live scores to international leagues.
AIstats live soccer tracker app provides extensive soccer stats beyond the basics:
- Live soccer stats and sport scores for over 2,000 leagues, including Major League Soccer tracker, Championship, and more.
- Original rtP and xP values, comparing Real-time Team live Power with Expected Power, enabling quick match insights through the Performance Graph.
- Technology for finding similar matches, addressing key questions about on-field activities, including Performance Uniqueness and outcomes.
- Pre-match soccer stats, offering deeper insights into team and player stats from using historical data and performance comparisons.
- Customized real-time soccer games notifications, including unique performance alerts based on rtP and other metrics.
- Smart sort feature, quickly identifying the most interesting matches from hundreds in real-time.
The AIstats live soccer manager answers questions beyond traditional player stats:
- Evaluate team live strength in real-time and compare it to expectations.
- Assess the dynamics of a match using a graph.
- Evaluate the prospects of a match's development.
- Compare the strength of teams from different leagues.
- Obtain information quickly using sorting and customized alerts.
Explore AIstats live soccer tracker app for unique features that elevate soccer analysis:
REAL-TIME POWER (rtP) - Shows team strength based on comprehensive statistics, with average and dynamic (10-minute changes) views. Calculates live soccer score from 1 to 100 that reflects the gameplay quality.
EXPECTED POWER (xP) - Reflects expected team strength from historical data of over 500,000 matches, available in average and dynamic formats.
REAL-TIME ADVANTAGE (rtA) - Measures current team performance as the difference between rtP and xP.
EXPECTED POWER GROWTH (xPG) - Indicates changes in expected strength during soccer games, with positive values suggesting underestimation and negative ones overestimation.
PERFORMANCE GRAPH - Visualizes changes in rtP and xP during a soccer match to detail game dynamics.
PLAY MATCH - Replays the Performance Graph to review match dynamics instantly.
HISTORICAL-BASED GRAPH - Analyzes potential changes in rtP and xP during a soccer match based on 12 million historical scenarios.
SIMILAR MATCHES TECHNOLOGY - Uses statistics and machine learning to find and analyze matches with similar trajectories.
PERFORMANCE UNIQUENESS - Evaluates how unique a performance is compared to similar matches.
SIMILAR MATCHES OUTCOMES - Assesses potential soccer match outcomes from the 100 most similar matches.
SHARE STATS - Allows sharing of real-time and post-match live score and in-depth statistics.
GOAL NOTIFICATIONS - Sends alerts for goals and status changes without needing to open the app.
SMART SORTING - Sorts matches by various metrics like rtP, rtA, xPG, and more to quickly find relevant information.
REAL-TIME EVENTS - Offers immediate updates on critical match events.
REAL-TIME SOCCER STATS - Evaluates teams based on up-to-the-minute statistics and historical comparisons.
Covering over 2,000 global leagues, including Major League Soccer, Championship, and more, AIstats will give you a soccer score, player stats, and unique metrics for deeper analysis!
Read more about our terms and conditions and privacy policy here:
Terms and Conditions: https://aistats.pro/terms
Privacy Policy: https://aistats.pro/privacy-policy

Liv X - Mobile Banking App, powered by Emirates NBD.
Step up to a bespoke digital banking experience with Liv Digital Bank's new and improved app.
The Liv X - Mobile Banking App offers you the fastest, safest, and most convenient way of banking on the go. Easy to download and use, this state-of-the-art app serves as the ultimate tool for managing your finances.
Open an account in just a few minutes with zero paperwork. Log in and bank securely through a multi-layered verification system. Navigate seamlessly between products, simplify and streamline your finances, and manage your everyday banking activities effortlessly.
Grow your money with a range of lucrative offerings like Millionaire Account, Instant Interest Fixed Deposits, Gold Account, UAE Equities, IPOs, and more.
Automate savings for life’s biggest milestones using the Goal Account. Or apply for a Personal Loan to fulfil them at the best interest rates.
Enable your kids and dependents financially with the Liv Lite app. Featuring a digital wallet with a personal Debit Card facility, this app allows them to have their own bank account which can be controlled and managed by the Liv X app.
Discover unbeatable cashback and rewards with our Credit Cards. Avail premium benefits with a Liv Credit Card such as Balance Transfer, Installment Payment Plan at Point of Sale (PoS), and Loan on Card.
Choose from a host of lifestyle offers and deals from 2000+ merchants across dining, shopping, entertainment, fitness and more.
The Liv X app offers trust and innovation combined to serve as your one-stop-shop for all things banking and more. All through a user-friendly design for a fast, secure, and exceptional digital banking experience.
Key features include:
▪ Paperless & instant: Open an account in just a few minutes from the app with your Emirates ID and passport only. No paperwork required at all.
▪ Secure banking: Transact and manage your money securely through a multi-layered validation system.
▪ Money management: Add money to your account via any (UAE) debit card or through bank transfers. Track budgets, income and spends through the dashboard at a glance.
▪ Real-time alerts: Stay updated through personalized notifications. Get transactional updates as well as the latest offers across products and value-added services.
▪ Quick & easy bill payment: Pay utility bills in just a few taps. Choose from a list of service providers like Du, Etisalat, DEWA, Nol, Salik, and many more.
▪ Card management: Ensure the utmost safety of your card in a hassle-free way. Activate, lock, and unlock your Liv cards at the click of a button.
▪ Free local & international transfers: Make quick and easy transfers to any UAE bank using just their IBAN numbers. Transfer funds internationally using DirectRemit (across Egypt, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Philippines, and United Kingdom).
▪ Exclusive services: Transfer money within UAE in a flash using AANI Pay with just the recipient’s mobile number. Generate validated e-statements directly from the app.
▪ Lifestyle benefits: Access the best deals across top entertainment destinations. Or participate in our biggest draws and investment opportunities such as IPO.
▪ Grow your wealth: Tap into the stability and security of Digital Gold or trade effortlessly in UAE Equities from the comfort of your home.
▪ Prompt support: Connect for assistance easily via Call or WhatsApp on 600521212.
Get onboard the new Liv X - Mobile Banking App today to enjoy the many benefits and features that it has to offer. Upgrade to a brand-new digital banking experience. Liv Ahead, Bank Ahead.
Elevate your banking experience today. Download the Liv X - Mobile Banking App, powered by Emirates NBD, and take control of your finances!

bluejetty:00026483:ios.description:
WeRead is an App for fiction reading, dedicated to serving all the fiction lovers!
We have a variety of themes, including fantasy, martial arts, romance, urban, campus and so much more. 
Everything that you can think of is all here!
We update bookstore everyday, releasing new chapters in seconds. It couldn’t be more convenient for readers! And we also have various event awaiting you!
We keep trying and revising, just to be your closest reading companion.
We have-
【Massive Fictions】
Cover popular online fictions with various lists and fine classification, including male and female section, selected books, smart recommendation and more!
【Quality Reading Experience】
Customize your read with simulated 3D page turning, offline download, switching fonts, background and night mode. We present exquisite book covers, neat content layout, and many other delicate designs to ensure a good experience.
【Personalized Service】
Various background colors, skins and fonts. Set your personal reader with a simple click. 
【Intelligent Synchronization】
Reading progress and notes can be intelligently synchronized and saved in your account. No need to worry about changing devices.
About Auto-Renewable Subscriptions
- Auto-renewable subscriptions in the app include Check-in Coins Packs 
- Billing period: The Check-in Coins Packs are available on the monthly, quarterly and yearly bases. 
- Price: The charges of the Check-in Coins Pack for a monthly billing period are USD 5, 7, 10 and 13, a quarterly billing period USD 14, 20, 29 and 38, and a yearly billing period USD 60 and 98. 
- Payment: The purchase will be charged to your iTunes account.
- Renewal: When you subscribe to check-in coins pack, your subscription will renew automatically. You'll be charged at the start of each billing cycle until you cancel your subscription. Subscriptions are automatically charged each billing period, whether monthly or another period, and you may be charged no more than 24 hours before the beginning of each billing period.
- Cancellation: You may cancel a subscription at any time more than 24 hours before your renewal date.
- Privacy Policy: https://web.cdreader.com/en/appPrivacyPolicy.html?client_proid=177&mt=1
- Subscription Terms and Conditions: https://promotion.cdreader.com/CheckinCard/agreement.html?client_proid=177&mt=1
- Terms of Use: https://www.moboreader.net/agreement/service_term.html?client_proid=177&mt=1

bluejetty:00078280:ios.name: Your Resume AI
bluejetty:00078280:ios.summary:
Create a professional resume with modern templates, powerful AI tools, and an easy-to-use resume builder.
Whether you’re applying for your first job, changing careers, or updating your existing resume, you can create a polished, job-ready
bluejetty:00078280:ios.description:
Create a professional resume with modern templates, powerful AI tools, and an easy-to-use resume builder.
Whether you’re applying for your first job, changing careers, or updating your existing resume, you can create a polished, job-ready resume without spending hours writing and formatting.
PROFESSIONAL RESUME TEMPLATES
Choose from professionally designed resume templates created for different careers, industries, and experience levels.
• Modern and professional resume designs
• Multiple styles and layouts
• High-quality typography and vector graphics
• Clean, polished PDF documents
• Easy switching between templates without re-entering your information
AI RESUME BUILDER
Build your resume faster with AI-powered tools designed to help throughout the entire process.
Use AI to:
• Import information and create your profile
• Improve existing resume content
• Generate professional work experience descriptions
• Create content for sections that need more detail
• Turn your ideas into clear, concise resume text
• Add information using your voice
SMART RESUME EDITOR
Complete your resume step by step with a simple, structured profile editor.
Add and manage:
• Professional summary
• Contact information
• Skills
• Languages
• Education
• Work experience
• Websites and links
• Hobbies
• Additional sections
See the completion progress for each section, so you always know what’s finished and what still needs your attention.
VOICE INPUT WITH AI
Creating a resume doesn’t have to mean typing everything manually.
Describe your experience, education, skills, or other information using your voice. AI helps turn your input into structured content that you can review, edit, and add to your resume.
WRITE & IMPROVE WITH AI
Not sure how to describe your experience?
Generate professional descriptions with AI or improve text you’ve already written. Make your resume clearer, more concise, and easier for employers to understand.
PREVIEW YOUR RESUME
See how your resume looks while you’re building it. Switch between templates and find the design that works best for your experience and style.
EXPORT TO PDF
Export your finished resume as a high-quality PDF that’s ready for job applications.
Use your resume to:
• Apply for jobs
• Send it to recruiters and employers
• Attach it to online applications
• Share it through email or messaging apps
• Save it as a professional PDF
FROM PROFILE TO FINISHED RESUME
Choose a template, complete your profile, create and improve your content with AI, preview your resume, and export a professional PDF when you’re ready.
Create your resume and get ready for your next opportunity.

Vibrant Visuals: Smooth animations and eye-catching graphics.

bluejetty:00072945:ios.summary:
Harness your mood, shape your life! Embark on a happy journey with Moodlife!

bluejetty:00072945:ios.description:
Harness your mood, shape your life! Embark on a happy journey with Moodlife!
Moodlife helps you understand and manage your emotions effortlessly. Track your mood, identify emotions and triggers, and gain valuable insights through a visual journal. Take control of your well-being, find inner balance, and experience a happier, more fulfilling life.
Moodlife's unique feature: 
Weekly Mood Score that allows you to visually perceive your emotional state over the past week. Take control of your future by gaining valuable insights into your emotions and live a more fulfilling week ahead.
Moodlife helps you to:
① Keep tabs on your mood and understand its triggers.
② Get a daily dose of motivation to uplift your spirits.
③ Gain insights into your past self through weekly mood scores.
④ Chronicle your daily emotions with personal journal entries.
⑤ Ease anxiety and boost your overall well-being.
⑥ Cultivate a deeper sense of self-awareness.
Common scenarios of Moodlife include：
① Self-awareness and Personal Growth
To understand emotions, identify patterns, and foster personal development.
② Mental Health Management
To monitor moods, identify triggers, and seek effective support.
③ Stress Management
To recognize stressors and implement techniques for relaxation.
④ Relationship and Communication Improvement: 
To enhance communication and build healthier connections.
⑤ Emotional Well-being during Pregnancy
To manage emotions and reduce anxiety during pregnancy.
⑥ Mood Management for Chronic Illness
To track moods and symptoms for effective symptom management.
⑦ Behavior Modification
To identify emotional triggers and develop coping strategies for behavior change.
Subsequent function planning:
① Identify Cognitive Biases
Users will be informed about the specific cognitive biases related to their negative emotions.
② Calming Sounds Recommended
When experiencing negative emotions, Moodlife will suggest soothing audio tracks for relaxation and stress relief.
③ AI-based Psychological Counseling
Integrate AI-driven psychological counseling to help users gain deeper insights into their emotions.
④ Mood Score Widget
Add a widget displaying the current mood score and allowing quick recording of emotions.
Important Note:
* NOT INTENDED FOR MEDICAL USE *
* ALWAYS CONSULT WITH YOUR DOCTOR * 
SUBSCRIPTION
Moodlife offers monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscription options to get unlimited access to all content in the app. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. bluejetty:00119520:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00119520:ios.description:
Say goodbye to laundry day and trips to the cleaners! 
Rinse is the #1 delivery app for laundry and dry cleaning services. We serve the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, Chicago, the Washington DC metro, Boston, New York, New Jersey, Seattle, Austin, Dallas and Toronto, Canada.
GET 3+ HOURS BACK PER WEEK
You have better things to do than laundry. Get your clothes cleaned with just a few taps in the app. Schedule your pickup and your Rinse Valet will stop by to grab your laundry and/or dry cleaning right from your front door. Your clothes will be cleaned by our experts with decades of experience, so you can sit back and relax. Your Valet will deliver your freshly cleaned clothes back to you, saving you 3+ hours per week on laundry.
PROFESSIONAL CLEANING, GOOD FOR THE ENVIRONMENT
1. Your clothes will receive high-quality cleaning from experts in clothing care.
2. Your items will be checked for stains that need treatment and items that don’t belong, such as pens and receipts.
3. Your clothes will be cleaned according to your set cleaning preferences and your items will never interact with garments from other customers.
4. Your items will be returned crisply pressed on hangers, or neatly folded with paired socks, depending on the service you select.
5. You save water with our high-efficiency washers, can recycle hangers, can donate clothing to charities, and help us permanently remove harmful chemicals from dry cleaning like perchloroethylene (“perc”)! 
CONTACTLESS PICKUP AND DELIVERY
Schedule your pickup for any day of the week. Our service window is 8pm to 10pm, 7 days a week to fit your busy schedule. Use the app to see when your Rinse Valet will arrive. 
NOT HOME? NO PROBLEM
With our optional Rinse Drop service, we can pick up and drop off right from your doorstep or concierge.
SUBSCRIBE TO RINSE REPEAT
Rinse Repeat, our Wash & Fold subscription service, offers even more convenience. Priced by the bag, not by the pound. With Rinse Repeat, you can save up to 52% over our Pay-As-You-Go service, saving you even more time & money.
With Rinse, you’ll also get:
+ 100% High-quality cleaning guarantee - if you’re not completely satisfied, we will re-clean free of charge.
+ Pick up and drop off service 7 days a week, including weekends.
+ Competitive pricing comparable to local cleaners, without all the hassle.
+ Responsive and dedicated customer support.
+ Convenient, cashless payment.
ABOUT RINSE
Rinse is building the first and largest national brand in clothing care. We pick up, clean, and deliver customers’ laundry and dry cleaning, straight to their doors. Inspired to solve massive pain points on both sides of the laundry and dry cleaning business, we have created a significantly better experience for consumers, while helping local cleaning partners grow their businesses. Our services include Wash & Fold, Dry Cleaning, Launder & Press, Hang Dry, and more.
Rinse is expanding and currently serves customers in 10 major markets, including the San Francisco Bay Area, Los Angeles, Chicago, Washington DC metro, Boston, New York, New Jersey, Seattle, Dallas, and Austin. 
Visit www.rinse.com to learn more.

Game of Sky is a brand-new strategy game with a sky island theme. In this enchanting sky world, you can dispatch a fleet of airships to navigate the skies, travel between floating islands, gather resources, oversee the labor of residents, and construct your very own city in the sky. Discover the uncharted islands concealed beneath the clouds, unravel the enigmas left behind by the ancient forebears, decipher the mechanisms, and claim these isles as your territory.

Forge powerful alliances with players from across the globe, uniting your strengths to engage in epic battles. Collaborate, share resources, and collectively advance towards victory.

• 400M+ interior design projects created

• BROWSE a huge catalogue of interior design elements
• SHARE your project with friends or professional designers for feedback or collaboration
• CONTINUE your project on any device (cross-compatible platform)

Mix and match furniture to find the perfect interior style. Our Room Planner has everything you need — from floor plan creation to full interior design.

• Apple Pencil support

▶ PREMIUM VERSION
• Access to the entire 8400+ item catalog

bluejetty:00081815:ios.name: Airtasker
bluejetty:00081815:ios.summary: To-do list never getting shorter? Take the burden off and find the help you need on Airtasker. Simply let people know what you need done by posting a task, then pick the offer that works best for you! Sort out the details while we hold the
bluejetty:00081815:ios.description:
To-do list never getting shorter? Take the burden off and find the help you need on Airtasker. Simply let people know what you need done by posting a task, then pick the offer that works best for you! Sort out the details while we hold the payment securely for you, then once it’s done you can release it to the Tasker.
Or are you looking to earn some extra money? Airtasker gives you the flexibility to work when you want, with whomever you want and doing whatever you want. Plus you decide what is a fair price for the task - you’re in control!!
TASKERS IN YOUR COMMUNITY
We’ve got a huge community of Taskers ready and willing to help out. So when you post a task you need done, there’s a good chance there’ll be someone round the corner eager to help!
RATED & REVIEWED TASKERS
When a task is done it gets rated and reviewed - so you can find out about the quality of a Tasker’s work and how reliable they are before you accept an offer.
PAY SECURELY
Payment for the task gets sorted out when an offer is accepted and held securely until the task is done. So both Posters and Taskers can be confident that payment is ready and the task can get done without hesitation.
COVERED BY INSURANCE
Insurance is there to ease any worries – making sure the Tasker has liability insurance while performing most task activities*.
POPULAR TASKS
We get all sorts of weird and wonderful tasks on Airtasker - after all, nearly anything can be done through it! But here are some of our most popular types:
- House cleaning services
- Moving services
- Home repairs & handyman jobs
- Yardwork services
- Pick-up & delivery
- IKEA furniture assembly
- Virtual and online assistance
- Photography
- Blog support
- Personal assistant and office services
- Airbnb tasks (cleaning, key drop off)
For Posters:
• GET ANYTHING DONE - Post whatever you need done
• VERIFIED TASKERS - Find great Taskers with independently verified badges
• YOU CHOOSE - Choose the offer that’s best for you
• PAY SECURELY - Make payment upfront and keep it secure until the task is done
• MESSAGE PRIVATELY - Get live updates on your task progress
For Taskers:
• 1000s OF TASKS - Browse thousands of new tasks to do every day
• YOUR SKILLS MATTER - Use your own unique skills and experience to tailor your offer
• YOU’RE THE BOSS - Set what you’ll do, when you’ll work and for how much
• BOOST YOUR PROFILE - Show off your skills with verified badges
• YOU’RE COVERED - Get a range of benefits (including insurance*) with each task
*T&C’s apply.

bluejetty:00157392:ios.description:
Welcome to Femin, the all-in-one fertility and pregnancy app designed to support you every step of the way.
Whether you're tracking your menstrual cycle, planning for pregnancy, or embracing motherhood, Femin offers the tools and guidance to enhance your journey.
Fertility & Ovulation Tracking
- Track your periods and ovulation with our user-friendly Cycle Tracker and Symptom Tracker.
- Gain insights into your cycle with Cycle Insights and an advanced Ovulation Tracker.
- Receive personalized reminders for Natural Cycle, essential ovulation-related tips, and birth control.
- Monitor your fertility window to maximize your chances of conception.
Pregnancy & Baby Tracking
- Track your pregnancy week by week with expert advice, including Baby Bump development and Baby Size guides. Visualize your baby’s growth with interactive fruit, Baby 2D, and bump size comparisons.
- Stay connected to your baby’s development with Baby 2D images, tracking your baby's growth with each milestone.
- Keep track of your baby's heartbeat and kick counter.
- Use our Weight Tracker to monitor changes in your pregnancy weight.
- Stay organized with our Pregnancy Calendar, To-Do List, and Baby Names database.
- Record your personal thoughts and milestones with Letters to My Baby.
Femin's New Features for Every Stage of Your Journey
- AI Chat Support
- Get personalized advice tailored to your needs, whether you're tracking your period, planning to conceive, or navigating pregnancy. The AI Chat assistant is here to answer your questions and offer guidance every step of the way.
- Habit Tracker
- Stay on top of your daily routine and make lasting changes with our Habit Tracker. Perfect for managing medication, tracking new habits, or organizing your day-to-day life. Build a healthier lifestyle with personalized suggestions.
- Breathe Exercise (Relaxation & Breathing Exercises)
- Designed to reduce stress and improve your emotional well-being, the Breathe Exercise feature helps you stay calm during stressful moments. Engage in breathing techniques for relaxation and balance throughout your fertility, pregnancy, and wellness journey.
- Wellbeing & Affirmations
- Explore customized affirmations for period tracking, conceiving, and pregnancy to keep you empowered and positive throughout your journey.
Why Choose Femin?
- Personalized Insights: Get accurate advice for period tracking, ovulation, and fertility, plus a deep dive into your menstrual cycle.
- Symptom Tracker: Log your symptoms, track your cycle, and access cycle insights and sleep tracker for a holistic approach to health.
- Comprehensive Tools: Track your baby's growth, manage your pregnancy calendar, and monitor milestones like Baby Bump, Kick Counter, and Baby Size.
- Full Pregnancy Journey: Experience your pregnancy visually with 2D images, Baby Bump tracking, and detailed Baby Size guides.
- Wellbeing & Support: Enjoy personalized AI Chat, Habit Tracker, Breathe Exercise, and affirmations for a complete, empowered journey through fertility, pregnancy, and beyond.
- Data Privacy & Security: Your privacy matters. Femin ensures the highest level of security with industry-leading encryption.
-Femin’s Premium Features
- Exclusive Tools: Unlock advanced pregnancy features like Symptom Checker, Expert Reviews.
- Deep Insights: Dive deeper into your baby's growth, symptom tracking, and pregnancy milestones with exclusive premium insights.
Disclaimer:
Femin is not a diagnostic tool and should not be used as a method of contraception or for fertility treatment. Always consult a healthcare professional for any health concerns.
Join Femin today – your trusted fertility & pregnancy tracker. Download now for an empowering experience from conception to motherhood!

bluejetty:00175078:ios.description:
The Johns Hopkins Guides provide:
• Evidence-based recommendations
• Expert analysis and commentary
• Important literature references -- with abstracts and links to full-text articles
• Webinars from Johns Hopkins content experts
• Monthly content updates
ANTIBIOTIC (ABX) GUIDE FEATURES: 
• Hundreds of detailed Antimicrobial Drug listings
• In-depth sections on Forms, Dosing, Spectrum, Resistance, Adverse Reactions, and Interactions
• Comprehensive Disease, Pathogen, Management, and Vaccine topics
PSYCHIATRY GUIDE FEATURES (Entire Guide Updated in October '25): 
• NEW - Actionable psychedelic medicine guidance covering clinical applications, safety, and ethical considerations
• NEW - Patient education materials for direct sharing or inclusion in clinical notes
• New - Clinical pearls offering expert takeaways for real-world practice
• New - Aligned with DSM-5-TR criteria
• New - A complete rewrite of all drug modulesHundreds of detailed psychiatry topics
• Fast access to Symptoms, Differential Diagnoses, Treatments and When to Refer
HIV GUIDE FEATURES: 
• Hundreds of HIV-specific topics 
• Point-of-need access to Diseases, Drugs, and Management 
• HIV Drug listings with Dosing, Adverse Reactions, and Drug Interactions
DIABETES GUIDE FEATURES: 
• Hundreds of specialized Diabetes topics 
• Evidence-based details on Diagnoses, Tests, Drugs, and Complications
• Special coverage of specific populations 
UNBOUND APP FEATURES: 
• Enhanced Search to find topics quickly 
• “Favorites” for bookmarking important entries 
• Highlighting and note-taking within entries 
• Access to the official HopkinsGuides.com website
TRIAL / SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• New users can access any of the Johns Hopkins Guides free for 30 days.
• After 30 days, your iTunes account will be charged $29.99 for a one-year subscription to each trialed Guide (or $79.99 for the 4-Guide Bundle) unless you have turned off auto-renew in Account Settings at least 24 hours before the free trial ends.
• At the end of the one-year period, your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off in Account Settings 24 hours prior to the renewal date.
• If you choose not to renew, you will still be able to use the app but will not receive medication updates
Publisher: Johns Hopkins Medicine
Powered by: Unbound Medicine
Unbound Privacy Policy: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy
Unbound Terms of Use: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/end_user_license_agreement

bluejetty:00100956:android.summary:
Using the m.Ticket app, you can quickly purchase, accumulate or activate various types of Vilnius public transport tickets and plan your trip - choose the fastest and most convenient route.
Simple:
- No pre-registration required. Just down
bluejetty:00100956:android.description:
Using the m.Ticket app, you can quickly purchase, accumulate or activate various types of Vilnius public transport tickets and plan your trip - choose the fastest and most convenient route.
Simple:
- No pre-registration required. Just download and install the free app.
- The app allows you to buy and activate the desired type of ticket and the number of tickets.
- You can pay for public transport tickets with a payment card or using electronic banking.
Comfortable:
- Available tickets can always be viewed in the "My tickets" section.
- Several tickets of any type can be purchased and activated at the same time, the app can contain 30 or 60 minute tickets, 30 days or other types of electronic tickets, with or without a discount.
- You can pay for your own trip and that of a passenger traveling with you.
- The selected ticket can be easily transferred from one phone number to another.
- It's easy to find the fastest route, view bus and trolleybus schedules, and monitor the movement of public transport in Vilnius in real time.
Current:
- When traveling by bus or trolleybus, at least one public transport ticket must be activated. We remind you that the ticket is activated 15 seconds after you press the "Confirm" button
- For public transport control, the user must prepare an activated ticket - press the "Prepare for control" button. The user must show the code that appears on the screen to the controller to read the control code and confirm the validity of the activated ticket.
- m.Ticket user is responsible for the correct selection of ticket type, quantity, type of discount and other entered and selected data.
If the app failed to find your phone number. Check:
- Are you disconnected from the WiFi network (the user is authenticated through the operator's connection);
- Is data transfer activated on the phone;
- If VPN is enabled on the phone - temporarily disable it while using the app.
www.judu.lt

bluejetty:00017288:ios.summary:

▸ Our amazing Toddlers Seek & Find apps have already bee
bluejetty:00017288:ios.description:
You in the farmyard: animals, tractors and lots of adventures.
Explore life in the country in our hidden object game with over 90 interactive stories, funny sounds and loads of fun! 
▸ Our amazing Toddlers Seek & Find apps have already been downloaded over 4 million times.
▸ Kids ages 2-6 ▸ get an entertaining and playful glimpse into the thrilling world of the farmyard and country living. With real interactive adventures! 
▸ In 4 scenes ▸ with around 90 hidden animations and things to discover, children and parents experience life on the farm, and discover at the same time a whole host of crazy, detail-rich stories:
(You get one scene with lots of fun for free. If you like what we do, please support us and unlock the full version. It really helps. Thank you.)
SCENE 1 - Highlights (On the Farm)
------------------------------ 
 Help the farmer plant the beets.
 Feed the donkey.
 Give the piglet a little shower!
 The proud rooster watches over everyone.
SCENE 2 - Highlights (In the Country)
------------------------------
 Mow the field with the combine harvester and sow the new crops
 Let the boys in the treehouse slide down the flying fox.
 Find out why the sheep is so funny.
 Ride the pony: walk, trot or canter! 
SCENE 3 - Highlights (In the Barn)
------------------------------
 Give the sheep the funniest haircuts!
 Paint the eggs with your favorite color.
 Feed the animals.
 Help the farm fix the tractor.
 SCENE 4 - Highlights (The Farmyard at Night)
------------------------------ 
 Now the moon is out.
 The animals are all sleeping.
 But what's happening behind the doors and windows of the old homestead? Find out!
MORE HIGHLIGHTS
------------------------------ 
▸ So many adorable stories on the theme of farmyards and country life.
▸ Why is Granny rattling around on the scooter? 
▸ Why is the goat grabbing all the apples?
▸ What does the cow like to eat?
▸ Play with the children by the lake!
▸ Why has the fisher caught a shoe?
▸ What's the robot doing in the barn?
 … and there's still so much more to do: 
Complete tasks in every scence, find out why the sheep and the pig are such close friends and dive into our adorable farmyard world together!
Our promise
------------------------------ 
▸ Your child will discover lots of little connected stories.
▸ Parents too will keep finding new hidden details.
▸ Your child won’t be the only one enjoying this app.
Fully supported languages
------------------------------ 
▸ Arabic
▸ Chinese (traditional and simplified)
▸ Dutch
▸ English 
▸ French

▸ Korean

bluejetty:00022119:ios.name: MoshUp
bluejetty:00022119:ios.summary: With Moshup you can do live datamoshing on your iPhone or iPad. Capture a short clip and then film something different. The first recording will stick to the second recording and will be transformed by its motion. You can create some intere
bluejetty:00022119:ios.description:
With Moshup you can do live datamoshing on your iPhone or iPad. Capture a short clip and then film something different. The first recording will stick to the second recording and will be transformed by its motion. You can create some interesting mapping effects. The app was mainly used on the viral TikTok datamoshing videos over the last two years.
You can also repeat Frames in order or randomly.
Save the result as image or video. While data moshing you can now fade back to a clean camera input. It's now also possible to watch a preview to decide if you want to save or continue with your video recording.
Full Version Features:
- import videos or pictures from your gallery
- videos can be imported in reverse
- step back if you want to repeat the last capture
- loop back to the first frame
- different mirror and color modes
- sound can be recorded
- reverse the final videos in the gallery
- mix camera input with pictures, text and emojis
Have fun datamoshing :)
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00120162:ios.description:
Effortlessly organize your students into effective teams with Groups, promoting meaningful collaboration and building teamwork skills in the classroom.
ADVANCED TEAM BUILDING
Have certain students who don’t work well together? Simply list these pairs in the app and Groups will handle the rest, with its advanced team-building algorithm.
BALANCE GENDERS

EDIT GROUPS
Need to fine tune the generated groups? Easily rearrange the result to achieve a perfect team composition.
RANDOM STUDENT PICKER
Encourage equal participation in the classroom with Groups’ random student picker. This makes sure everyone gets a chance to provide input, ensuring all voices are heard.
EXPORT AND PRINT

BULK IMPORT
Add students from Microsoft Excel workbooks, CSV files, or plain text lists.

CROSS DEVICE SYNC
Add your classes once, and use them across all your Apple devices with iCloud sync.

Groups has helped tens of thousands of teachers sort their students into groups, fostering more positive learning environments for students worldwide.

bluejetty:00016192:ios.description:
After years of exploration, Classic Miner finally found more gold mines. Classic Miner use skilled techniques to dig gold and diamond to earn more cash. Let’s work together to mine new mines and become a billionaire! 
* The score of each level reaches the goal, and you will go to the next level. The game has a save function, you can start from that level if you exit level.
* Skill guide : When you play for a few seconds and the score does not reach the target, if you want to replay that level, you can press “Exit Level” before time 0, then press “Menu”, then press “Start”, then choose “Continue”.
 If you fail, please press Retry, and you can resurrect to continue playing after watching the video. If there is no video stock, you must wait or press Back to exit and start again.
* Many unique levels but play endlessly to get a high score
* Classic Miner is one of most popular online games. Now it’s available on iOS. Hope you will enjoy it!
* Aim on the gold while the hook swings, and click on the screen to release the hook.
* Every time you play, the map of each level may be different, so every time you play it is a new challenge!
