bluejetty:00064012:ios.description:
¿Tienes lugares preferidos para tus pasatiempos y compras? Mientras estás allí, Rocketpin te desafía a cumplir misiones interactivas de manera muy simple y divertida a través de tu celular.
Por cumplir las misiones, gana dinero directo en tu cuenta bancaria, depositado en menos de 24 horas.
*** ¡Únete a nuestra gran comunidad, y disfruta de sus beneficios! ***
*** ¿DE QUÉ SE TRATAN LAS MISIONES? ***
RocketPin es una aplicación de cliente incógnito (mystery shopper) que combina el poder del crowdsourcing con tecnología móvil donde tú, como cliente, tienes la oportunidad de mostrar tu experiencia de compra a través de nuestras Misiones. 
Una misión promedio consiste en tomar fotos de algún producto determinado en un punto de venta donde estés cerca (supermercado, farmacia, bar, etc.) y responder unas simples preguntas sobre el producto/servicio. Esto te tomará aproximadamente 5 minutos. 
Cada misión tiene un pago diferente dependiendo de la complejidad. A mayor cantidad de misiones realizadas puedes acceder a niveles más altos, y por ende, mejor pago. 
Al juntar $5.000 puedes pedir la transferencia del dinero o el canje por minutos a tu celular. Las misiones están disponibles para todo el país.
*** ¿NECESITAS AYUDA CON ROCKETPIN? ***
Nuestro Equipo de Soporte estará encantado de facilitarte la vida.

RocketPin es una aplicación de cliente incógnito (mystery shopper) que combina el poder del crowdsourcing con tecnología móvil donde tú, como cliente, tienes la oportunidad de mostrar tu experiencia de compra a través de nuestras Misiones. 

Una misión promedio consiste en tomar fotos de algún producto determinado en un punto de venta donde estés cerca (supermercado, farmacia, bar, etc.) y responder unas simples preguntas sobre el producto/servicio. Esto te tomará aproximadamente 5 minutos. 

Cada misión tiene un pago diferente dependiendo de la complejidad. A mayor cantidad de misiones realizadas puedes acceder a niveles más altos, y por ende, mejor pago. 

Al juntar $5.000 puedes pedir la transferencia del dinero o el canje por minutos a tu celular. Las misiones están disponibles para todo el país.

bluejetty:00178205:ios.summary: Welcome to Resource War, the exciting new multiplayer mobile game that puts you in the midst of a fierce warzone for resources on a distant planet. As a space marine, you'll need to use all of your combat skills and strategy to emerge victo
bluejetty:00178205:ios.description:
Welcome to Resource War, the exciting new multiplayer mobile game that puts you in the midst of a fierce warzone for resources on a distant planet. As a space marine, you'll need to use all of your combat skills and strategy to emerge victorious in this intense and brutal conflict.
In this game, you'll have the opportunity to customize your character's appearance and equip them with an arsenal of powerful weapons and armor. You can also upgrade your skills to become even more formidable on the battlefield.
Play Modes:
The game features multiple game modes to choose from, including team deathmatch, capture the flag, and survivor mode and coming soon battle-royale mode. Each game mode offers a unique challenge and the chance to showcase your combat skills against other players and online.
Story:
In Resource War, players must battle for control of valuable resources on a distant planet. This mobile game challenges players to strategize and fight their way to victory in an all-out warzone to be the last survivor. Game puts players in the midst of an intense and immersive experience. Resource War offers an exciting and engaging gameplay experience for players of all skill level
Game elements:
But be warned: there are gore cartoony elements in the game. You'll need to be ready for anything if you want to emerge victorious in this brutal warzone for resources.
Languages:
This action game is localized to several languages: Ukrainian, Polish, English, Italian, Portuguese, French, Turkish, German and Spanish and others.
Key features:
- rpg elements
- shmup gameplay
- fallout feel
- team matches
- bullet echo vibes
- tons of weapons, armours and other items
- unique look of your character
- great sounds effects
- roguelike elements
- unique stylized graphics
A network connection is also required as it's an online multiplayer game.
Game has a cloud save option.
So gear up and get ready to fight for survival in Resource War. Can you emerge victorious in this epic conflict and be the last survivor?

bluejetty:00161734:ios.description:
No more relying on busy friends and family to get your important tasks done back home. Use the InstaKin mobile app to get a simple, instant, and budget-friendly solution. InstaKin provides a one-stop solution that reduces complexity in current and future immigrants’ lives. 
InstaKin is a platform for the migrant communities, enabling them to conveniently and securely manage and pay for the tasks they need to get done in their native countries. Use InstaKin services to find the right vendor and make secure payments directly to the service provider.
Core Services:
- Documentation: Lost your education certificates or want to get them attested? InstaKin can help you with any documentation work that you require. Whether it's a MOFA, IBCC, HEC attestation, getting a Marriage or Character certificate from the relevant institutes or any documentation required from different embassies such as UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, InstaKin has got it all covered.
- InstaRunner: Manage errands and tasks back home. Get medicines, food items, and other essentials delivered to an address in your home country.
- InstaShop: Curated gifts that are beautifully wrapped and delivered with utmost care. Send gifts back home with InstaKin.
InstaShop can help you in:
 -Sending Gifts
 -Grocery Delivery
 -Food Delivery 
 -Consumer Electronics delivered to all the major cities of Pakistan including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, and Rawalpindi. 
- Special Requests: For any unique need that is outside of our regular services, InstaKin will make every effort to fulfill your requirements
- Event Management: The best event planners will help with any special occasion: wedding ceremonies, birthdays, and even corporate events.
- Property Management: InstaKin keeps you updated on your property activity, including vacancies, leasing, maintenance, and financial reports.

bluejetty:00032145:android.description:
Welcome to Blocktava: The Mesmerizing Colorful Block Puzzle Game!
Prepare yourself for an addictive puzzle adventure like no other! Blocktava is here to captivate your senses and challenge your puzzle-solving skills. Dive into a world of vibrant colors, creative challenges, and endless block puzzle fun – all in the palm of your hand.
Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master:
Blocktava's simple and intuitive gameplay makes becoming a block master accessible to players of all ages. Place colorful blocks on the block puzzle grid, clear lines, and score points to progress through the levels. But don't be fooled by its ease; as you advance, the block games become more intricate, requiring strategic thinking and clever moves to conquer. Can you rise to the challenge and become the block master?
Boundless Levels of Colorful Fun:
With a vast array of levels, Blocktava ensures you'll never run out of exciting block games to solve. Explore diverse landscapes and themes, from tranquil gardens to futuristic cities, each offering a unique and immersive puzzle-solving experience.
Relax and Recharge:
Need a break? Blocktava offers a soothing and meditative puzzle experience. Unwind, clear your mind, and recharge your mental energy while surrounded by delightful visuals and calming sounds.
Stay Tuned for Exciting Events:
The fun never stops in Blocktava! Keep an eye out for thrilling events, limited-time challenges, and exclusive rewards. Participate to put your skills to the test and earn unique prizes that set you apart as a Blocktava block master!
Ready to Embark on a Colorful Puzzle Adventure? Download Blocktava’s Block Games Now!
Are you ready for a mesmerizing and challenging puzzle experience? Download Blocktava now and immerse yourself in a world of colorful blocks, creative challenges, and endless excitement. Show off your strategic skills, design your puzzles, and conquer the world of Blocktava!

bluejetty:00075556:ios.name: Warcraft Rumble
bluejetty:00075556:ios.summary:
Warcraft Rumble has arrived, reinventing the RTS genre for mobile gaming. Critically acclaimed and embraced by strategy enthusiasts worldwide—your adventure begins now!
THE BATTLEFIELD AWAITS!
Warcraft Rumble is a fast-paced, action strate
bluejetty:00075556:ios.description:
Warcraft Rumble has arrived, reinventing the RTS genre for mobile gaming. Critically acclaimed and embraced by strategy enthusiasts worldwide—your adventure begins now!
THE BATTLEFIELD AWAITS!
Warcraft Rumble is a fast-paced, action strategy game, transforming traditional tower defense into an aggressive tower offense. No prizes for staying defensive in this tower game! Unlock, collect & upgrade your units. Command your army against 70+ bosses in PvE campaign mode or defeat fellow players in epic PvP battles in this all-new Warcraft arcade battle showdown.
QUICK BITES OF EPIC BATTLES!
Quick, engaging gameplay packed with fun - in a matter of minutes! Command epic battles anytime, anywhere, from quick games to extensive strategy quests.
A TEST OF WITS & WILL!
A true mobile RTS experience that's fast-paced and brimming with challenges, Warcraft Rumble demands your sharpest strategies. Dive into a rich world of content, from PvP arenas to a gripping PvE campaign, featuring 70+ intense boss fights. Master the art of war with an array of modes and characters. Are you ready to lead?
UNLEASH DEVASTATING POWER WITH 60+ HEROES!
Collect and upgrade a formidable array of characters. Each unit, from the mighty Horde to the noble Alliance, can be enhanced to wreak havoc upon the enemy. Build your ultimate army and watch your foes crumble in tower defense clashes.
FORGE ALLIANCES. GO FOR VICTORY!
Join forces in clans and rise together. In Warcraft Rumble, camaraderie is your greatest asset. Boost your prowess with the strength of your allies and conquer the kingdom as one.
A NOSTALGIC RETURN TO AZEROTH!
Set in the beloved Warcraft universe, Warcraft Rumble brings back favorite characters and landscapes. From the dark depths of the Blackfathom Deeps dungeon, to the icy realms of Winterspring, experience a rich tapestry of nostalgia and innovation.
YOUR LEGEND AWAITS!
The call to arms rings out once more in Warcraft Rumble. Are you prepared to claim victory and carve your name into the annals of history? The challenge has been laid down—join the fray and become a legend in the ultimate action strategy arcade battle.

Introducing Dual Space, the ultimate app for iOS and iPhone users seeking seamless management of multiple accounts across various social media and messaging platforms
bluejetty:00179840:ios.description:
Dual Space: Your All-in-One Solution for Multi-Account Management on iOS!
Introducing Dual Space, the ultimate app for iOS and iPhone users seeking seamless management of multiple accounts across various social media and messaging platforms. With Dual Space, you can effortlessly juggle between accounts on popular apps like Facebook, WhatsApp, Messenger, and many more, without the hassle of constantly logging in and out.
Key features main:
Multi-Account
- Empowers you to access and manage multiple accounts for your favorite social media and messaging apps simultaneously
- Dual Space lets you toggle between accounts with just a tap. 
Secret Notes
- Keep your sensitive information with Dual Space
- Safely store passwords, confidential memos, or anything else you want to keep hidden from unauthorized access.
Private Browser
- Browse the web with peace of mind using Dual Space's private browser.
- Protecting your browsing history and online activities from being tracked or recorded.
Secret Gallery
- Store your private photos and videos securely within Dual Space's secret gallery.
- Keep your precious memories safe from unwanted viewers, knowing that only you have access to them.
File Management
- Organize your files effortlessly with Dual Space's intuitive file management system. 
Notes
- Data & Privacy: To protect user privacy, Multiple Accounts does not collect or store any personal information.
Subscriptions
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the period.
- If you want to continue the service, your subscription should be continued.

bluejetty:00088604:ios.name: RC Car Setup App by So Dialed
bluejetty:00088604:ios.summary: The modern way to manage your RC setups. Track settings for 600+ cars, log your races to see what changes actually made you faster, and get live AI advice on how to tune for your track conditions. Off-road, on-road, oval, drift, drag, and m
bluejetty:00088604:ios.description:
The modern way to manage your RC setups. Track settings for 600+ cars, log your races to see what changes actually made you faster, and get live AI advice on how to tune for your track conditions. Off-road, on-road, oval, drift, drag, and more — from 1/5th to 1/28th scale.
Racers agree:
* Robbie Dodge, XRAY: “You can look back on what worked from a week or even a year ago and know exactly what change you want to make.” 
* Josh Bommer, Team Associated: “It's a game changer - a one-stop shop to track all of your RC setups.” 
* Wyatt Wilson, TLR: "It's the future of setups. Use So Dialed to work smarter and in turn spend more time on the track."
* Bob Taylor, TLR: "It's super easy to use, and a must for all skill and experience levels."
AI MECHANIC
Enter your setup and ask the AI for help. It knows your car's specific settings, the kit defaults, and what other racers are running. Ask things like:
"Is my setup good for high-grip carpet?"
"How do I get more turn-in on clay?"
"What should I change for loose dirt?"
SETUP TRACKING
Save settings for suspension, shocks, drivetrain, tires, diffs, electronics, and more. Compare any two setups instantly to see exactly what changed.
RACE LOG
Log races with track conditions, grip level, and weather. Go back later to see which setup changes improved your lap times — and which didn't.
SHARING
Keep setups private or share them with friends. Find setups shared by other drivers, and export to manufacturer PDFs for supported models.
FREE TO USE
The app is free for racers who want to track a few cars and get setup advice. Upgrade for unlimited storage, unlimited AI questions, and more.
See the full list of supported cars here:
https://www.sodialed.com/supported-cars
----------

https://www.sodialed.com/apps/rc-pit-calc-pro
RC Maintenance Timer
https://www.sodialed.com/apps/rc-maintenance-timer
----------

https://www.facebook.com/sodialed/

bluejetty:00084581:ios.description:
“Michael钱儿频道”-国内知名亲子儿童故事音频品牌；
拥有千万忠实听众，是喜马拉雅排名前列的知名主播；
为孩子们录制超过数千个中英文国际大奖绘本和中国经典名著故事；
原创儿童亲子自媒体公众号，为百万中国家庭分享育儿心得。
【我们是谁】
钱儿爸，即韩先生，两获金鹰奖，两获五个一工程奖，语言艺术家。代表作《故宫100》《乔布斯传》等，解说多部BBC及国内外经典纪录片。
钱儿妈，粉丝们爱称“白大人”，中国传媒大学播音系毕业，中英文双硕士。专业纪录片英文翻译，讲解的英文绘本故事广受孩子们喜爱。
【精彩内容】
目前钱儿频道故事内容涵盖绘本故事、英语启蒙、学科入门、分级阅读、长篇故事、四大名著、国学经典等，涉及绘本、英语、古诗、成语、历史、地理、名著、传记、科普等不同题材。
《经典绘本故事》适合0-6岁孩子收听，涵盖经典童话、科普百科、大奖作品、习惯养成、情绪管理、人文历史、入学准备
《成语启蒙故事》原创改编三百多个成语故事，钱儿爸和Michael钱儿共同录制，内容集知识性和趣味性于一身，深受孩子和家长喜爱
《Michael钱儿叫起神器》Michael钱儿每天1分钟叫起，内容包含小心情，中外名人格言和一首古诗，讲述小学生自己的生活小事，陪伴孩子早起
《讲给孩子的中国历史》把中国上下五千年历史给孩子们梳理一遍，每个时期每个朝代选取有代表性的人和史实，用故事的形式讲给孩子们听，图书《少年读中国史》已上市
《超级西游记》钱儿爸改编播讲首部传统名著，百万家庭持续追听，为孩子改编录制的一部全本西游记作品，图书版已上市
《超级红楼梦》一部咱们中国传统人情世故的百科全书，让孩子们能领略古代豪门大族的奢华日常，也能理解平民百姓生活之不易，更能对比如今的生活，知道珍惜
《超级隋唐英雄》故事里讲到的人物，上至隋文帝隋炀帝，唐王李渊，唐太宗李世民，下到秦琼，徐茂公，尉迟恭，程咬金等等这些大唐开国功臣，无不是那个全盛时期典型代表形象，通过这部故事，会激发孩子对隋唐那段历史的浓厚兴趣
《超级封神榜》从哪咤闹海到最终封神大会，让孩子听到一部完整的封神传说，融入成语典故、百科常识边听边学
《超级西游运动会》神仙妖怪师徒四人与现代体育运动结合，共计303集故事涵盖27项体育项目、500个体育知识点、1000+成语及俗语的应用，让孩子了解体育、尊重规则、爱上运动，图书版已上市
《超级三国》中国第一部长篇章回体历史演义小说，为孩子改编演绎160小时全本剧情，融入无数典故与成语，学习中国传统文化的最佳内容，图书《少年读三国》已上市
《超级水浒传》一百零八好汉传奇故事，480集最大化保留原著完整情节，放手删改不适合孩子内容，融入事件的分析整理，打造孩子也能听的水浒
新增支持CarPlay，可以在车机上使用钱儿频道APP收听播放故事
【内容系列】
原创超级英雄宇宙：超级红楼梦、超级西游记、超级三国、超级水浒传、超级隋唐英雄、超级西游运动会、超级封神榜、超级名人传、超级北欧神话、超级小孩子、超级三十六计、超级金兰谱
精彩故事：蒙施爷爷讲故事、利奥叔叔历险记、世界经典童话、中国经典故事、科普故事、习惯养成、畅销绘本等
精彩栏目：讲给孩子的中国历史故事、成语启蒙故事、读给孩子的世界地理历史、伊索寓言、Michael钱儿叫醒、学诗词、Michael Show、聆听经典、读给孩子的诗、读给孩子的散文
双语绘本：牛津阅读树、培生故事屋、英语故事系列、情商培育系列、行为习惯礼貌书等
【联系我们】
微信公众号：Michael钱儿频道

Football Superstar focuses on character development rather than quick reflexes. Start the game as a talented 17 year old rookie and play until you retire. What happens in-between is up to you.
IMPROVE YOUR ABILITIES
As you gain experience, you can upgrade abilities that suit your playing style and position. Perhaps you become a superstar quarterback, lightning fast wide receiver or even a defensive powerhouse?
BECOME A LEGEND
Work your way up through college football to the very top level. Can you make it to the professional game? Maybe even the Super Bowl MVP?
MANAGE RELATIONSHIPS
Manage relationships throughout your career. Build a rapport with your teammates, fans and coach. Look after your parents, perhaps get married and even have a kid!
CONTROL YOUR DESTINY
Throughout your career various decisions and events mould you as a person. Do you chase the money or focus on becoming the best you can be? How do you handle fame and fortune?
INCREASE YOUR WEALTH
Why not invest your hard-earned cash in a gym, restaurant or even buy a local football team? Make that money work for you!
LIVE THE LIFE
With success comes money and fame. Perhaps buy a Supercar or even a Yacht? Your lifestyle will make you more appealing to potential endorsement deals!
ARE YOU THE BEST?
As your reputation improves, you will gain the attention of bigger and better teams. Do you stay loyal to your current team or move to pastures new? Do you move for money or join your favourite team?
Can you become the superstar you know you can be?
Prove it…

bluejetty:00080393:ios.name: Guncho
bluejetty:00080393:ios.summary: Guncho is a single player turn based tactical wild west shooter-roguelike. Engage in a unique positional shooting mechanic and fight your way through a series of randomly generated levels. Ride your donkey and use a variety of skills and bu
bluejetty:00080393:ios.description:
Guncho is a single player turn based tactical wild west shooter-roguelike. Engage in a unique positional shooting mechanic and fight your way through a series of randomly generated levels. Ride your donkey and use a variety of skills and bullet upgrades to become the ultimate gun slinger.
About this game
In this single-player tactical Wild West shooter-roguelike, you play as Guncho against a variety of bandits and outlaws. In a series of randomly generated levels, you use your trusty revolver to fight your way through each encounter. At the end of every run, you will face a final boss which you need to defeat in order to become the ultimate gun slinger.
Gameplay
Guncho's gameplay revolves around a unique positional shooting mechanic. By moving, shooting, and unloading bullets, you influence Guncho's revolver rotation. To outwit your enemies, align your bullets through clever tactical moves. You can also use the environment to overcome the challenges of each level, by targeting explosive barrels or pushing your foes into fire or deadly cacti. After each level, choose from a variety of bullet upgrades and skills to further improve your tactical abilities. In each run, you face a final boss that will test your skills and tactical finesse.
Features
- Unique positional shooting mechanic.
- Turn-based Wild West roguelike shootouts.
- Hex-based tactics gameplay.
- Randomly generated levels.
- A variety of enemy types, with different movement and skill sets.
- Easy and Expert game modes.
- Daily game challenge.
- Unlocks and Achievements.
- Cloud saves.

bluejetty:00140181:ios.summary: Numa Player is a completely free virtual instrument. It's not only the perfect companion for your SL Keyboard, but it is also much more! The User Interface scales to different monitor sizes to fit best in your Audio/MIDI setup and makes Num
bluejetty:00140181:ios.description:
Numa Player is a completely free virtual instrument. It's not only the perfect companion for your SL Keyboard, but it is also much more! The User Interface scales to different monitor sizes to fit best in your Audio/MIDI setup and makes Numa Player the first Studiologic Instrument Player available for macOS, Windows, Linux and iOS.
KEY POINTS
 • A completely free Multitimbral Instrument Player.
 • The Only Cross-Platform Instrument: macOS, Windows, Linux and iOS. 
 • Works in Standalone or Plugin mode.
 • The perfect match for Studiologic SL Controllers.
 • Live performances and Studio features.
 • A new "easy to use" user interface.
 • 4 Parts, 27 free sounds.
 • 9 Insert Effects and 3 Master Effects.
MULTI-CORE.
The advanced sound engine of Numa Player 2 takes your performance to the next level. It's now optimized to harness the full power of your device's multi-core cpu, delivering exceptional performance and ultra-low latency even in the most demanding setups1. Enjoy higher polyphony and smoother playback, no matter how complex your project gets.
MULTIZONE.
Designed with ultimate flexibility in mind, Numa Player 2 allows you to create and manage infinite Zones effortlessly. Add, duplicate, or drag and reposition zones with ease, all within an intuitive interface that puts full creative control at your fingertips. Customize each zone with its own sound parameters, keyboard ranges, and MIDI settings, or even assign custom colors for clear and easy navigation during your performance.
MANY SOUNDS.
Numa Player 2 comes packed with an extensive library of professionally recorded, high-quality sounds, covering a wide range of music genres and styles. Among Acoustic Pianos, punchy leads, orchestral textures and intricate percussive elements, find the perfect sound to bring your music to life.
WHAT'S YOUR PROGRAM?
In a Program you can combine any sound with its own insert effects. Save and load your program sets for Live performances and Studio sessions.
9x3 SOUND EFFECTS. MULTIPLY YOUR MOODS.
Numa Player provides up to 9 integrated insert effects for each part and a Master effects section.
LIVE OR STUDIO. PLAY SMARTER LIKE NEVER BEFORE.
Organize the best Live Performarce setup with your devices and MIDI controllers or use Numa Player as an instrument plugin inside your DAW2 to create professional music sequences.

bluejetty:00015837:ios.description:
With this free US Citizenship Test (Updated), you can use it to study and prepare for the US citizenship final interview. In order to become a US citizen you will need to answer at least 12 out of 20 questions correctly for the 128-question version or 6 out of 10 questions correctly for the 100-question version.
The app contains many features designed to help you study effectively:
-FLASHCARDS mode: study the citizenship test questions by hiding the answers until you reveal them.
-star your flashcards for later review
-play all questions and answers audio automatically in LISTEN mode without touching your phone.
-pronounce all questions and answers
-INTERVIEW mode: this simulates a test environment style which asks 10 or 20 questions depending on the test version you choose. You will need to answer 60% of the questions correctly to pass your test.
-CRAMMING mode: use this to quickly and effectively study and memorize the question and answer combos which will get you ready for your test.

bluejetty:00075152:ios.description:
Hands-free video feedback for coaching & self-analysis. Sports Training Made Simple!
 #1 Sports App on iPad 
* Pro-grade features - Trusted by major league teams
* Instant feedback - No stopping to review videos
* All sports - Baseball, volleyball, gymnastics, golf, swimming
* External camera support (GoPro Hero 10+ / UVC USB-C / IP / RTSP / NDI)
* Privacy first - No login required
* Try free - No account, no card required
JASON KANZLER, Farm Director with the Chicago Cubs:
"Video Delay Instant Replay has been one of the most consistently valuable tools we’ve used. I first introduced it in Houston, where it was quickly embraced across hitting, defense, baserunning, catching, and other training domains. Since joining the Cubs, we've brought it into our work again, and it continues to be a simple and effective way to deliver immediate visual feedback—a cornerstone of quality skill development. I'm grateful for tools like this that make coaching better and athletes more empowered. I fully recommend it to anyone looking to enhance learning in a training environment."
Transform any iPhone or iPad into a sports analysis tool. Get instant video feedback without stopping your training - see your technique seconds after you perform it.
Ideal For:
* YOUTH SPORTS COACHING / PLAYER DEVELOPMENT: Great for coaches who work with athletes needing visual feedback to understand proper form.
* PHYSICAL EDUCATION CLASSES: Excellent for students to conduct self-assessments.
* INDIVIDUAL SKILL DEVELOPMENT: Perfect for athletes training alone who want to analyze their technique and make faster progress.
* SPORTS REHABILITATION: Useful for physical therapists and trainers assisting athletes recovering from injuries and working on rebuilding proper movement patterns.
* PERFORMERS: Refine acting, dancing, or presentation skills.
How it works - 5 Simple Steps
- Set 5 seconds delay time (for video buffering)
- Perform your action (swing, throw, kick, etc.)
- 5 seconds later watch your performance played back on the screen
- Immediately adjust your form based on what you saw
- Repeat the cycle for continuous improvement
Replay in slow-motion for frame-by-frame analysis

JASON KANZLER, Farm Director with the Chicago Cubs:
"Video Delay Instant Replay has been one of the most consistently valuable tools we’ve used. I first introduced it in Houston, where it was quickly embraced across hitting, defense, baserunning, catching, and other training domains. Since joining the Cubs, we've brought it into our work again, and it continues to be a simple and effective way to deliver immediate visual feedback—a cornerstone of quality skill development. I'm grateful for tools like this that make coaching better and athletes more empowered. I fully recommend it to anyone looking to enhance learning in a training environment."

Transform any iPhone or iPad into a sports analysis tool. Get instant video feedback without stopping your training - see your technique seconds after you perform it.

Ideal For:
* YOUTH SPORTS COACHING / PLAYER DEVELOPMENT: Great for coaches who work with athletes needing visual feedback to understand proper form.
* PHYSICAL EDUCATION CLASSES: Excellent for students to conduct self-assessments.
* INDIVIDUAL SKILL DEVELOPMENT: Perfect for athletes training alone who want to analyze their technique and make faster progress.
* SPORTS REHABILITATION: Useful for physical therapists and trainers assisting athletes recovering from injuries and working on rebuilding proper movement patterns.
* PERFORMERS: Refine acting, dancing, or presentation skills.

How it works - 5 Simple Steps
- Set 5 seconds delay time (for video buffering)
- Perform your action (swing, throw, kick, etc.)
- 5 seconds later watch your performance played back on the screen
- Immediately adjust your form based on what you saw
- Repeat the cycle for continuous improvement

bluejetty:00017108:ios.description:
A WORLD OF ADVENTURE IN YOUR POCKET!
Follow in the footsteps of the great captain Seabeard and discover a giant ocean teeming with islands to explore! 
Live life at your own pace and choose your own path - whether you have ambitions of being a world-famous chef, fearless archaeologist, or deadly warrior, you can realise those dreams.
Awarded “Game of GDC” by Touch Arcade.
WORLD IN YOUR POCKET
Discover a rich, charming world that you can jump into anytime, anywhere. The oceans of Seabeard are filled with surprises around every corner.
MAKE NEW FRIENDS
Meet the Doza, Yorubo and Nook tribes and the fascinating characters that inhabit Seabeard’s villages, farms, holiday resorts and dungeons. Seabeard’s “Perpetual Adventure Machine” will ensure that there is always a villager in need of your help.
RECRUIT AN EXPERT CREW
Engage in a huge variety of activities: from sailing and fishing to combat and cookery. Build your team from a one-man band to a crew of legend!
REVIVE YOUR TRADING EMPIRE
Set sail to discover lucrative trading routes and source rare and valuable items. Rebuild the legendary trading capital, Accordia, and hire the finest market traders.
CONQUER THE SEAS
Set sail to encounter the challenges of the ocean, from feeding whales and rescuing shipwrecked passengers to battling with menacing sea monsters.
GET CREATIVE
Whether building out your island to attract visitors, or dressing up your crew in outrageous styles, there are countless ways to personalise.
PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Explore the Islands of your friends, trade with them and tell them what you think of their crew!
Seabeard is completely free to play, but some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases. Seabeard requires an internet connection to play (3G or WiFi). iPod Touch (4th Generation) & iPhone 4 are NOT supported.
>> Install Seabeard today. It’s FREE!

bluejetty:00070656:ios.description:
Welcome to Fly Delta, Delta’s award winning iOS app. With our dynamic Today screen which provides quick access to your boarding pass and other important day-of-travel information, Fly Delta makes travel easier than ever before.
• Enroll in Delta's SkyMiles® program and earn miles every time you travel
• Find, compare and book Domestic and International flights
• Book SkyMiles award tickets
• Purchase Delta Comfort+™ seats and Trip Extras, including in-flight Wi-Fi, Priority Boarding and more
• Reserve Preferred Seats like bulkhead and aisle
• Rebook cancelled flights or missed connections
• Manage your trips, profile and customize your travel preferences
• Check your SkyMiles account balance and current Medallion® status
• Check in, view your boarding pass and add it to Apple Wallet
• Pay for checked bags and track their location
• Check the latest flight status and receive flight and gate change notifications
• Save a photo to remember your parking spot
• Check your status on the upgrade or standby list
• View or change your seat
• Locate Delta Sky Club® lounges
• View interactive airport maps, public transportation details and weather information
• Get detailed info about our fleet and partners
• Map flights en route with an interactive flight tracker
• “Today” gathers everything you need for your day of travel into one convenient place
• “Notifications” ensures you always have the latest flight updates, gate changes and more

bluejetty:00161958:ios.description:
Vox City stands out as the ultimate travel companion app, integrating the features and functionalities of a digital tour guide to offer a seamless experience for tourists exploring cities worldwide. With its precisely crafted multilingual audio-guided tours, curated city guides, and insider tips from local experts, Vox City ensures a personalized journey through captivating destinations. Our team of expert local writers and editors has carefully curated each audio tour guide, with recommendations to travelers' needs and interests, from must-see landmarks to hidden gems, making it one of the best tour guide apps for iPhone users.
Renovated to offer users a wealth of knowledge, Vox City empowers travelers to plan their experiences effectively. Serving as a top-notch walking tour app, Vox City provides self-guided tours, enabling exploration at one's own pace and convenience. Recognized as one of the best travel apps, Vox City boasts a user-friendly interface, helpful features, and an extensive range of self-guided audio tours. Additionally, travelers can seamlessly book Tours & Tickets for various activities and experiences, making Vox City a comprehensive travel solution and a leading choice among travel guide apps.
Key Features:
• Digital maps, sightseeing itineraries, and 100+ Points of Interest (POIs), catering to users looking for self-guided tours and audio tours.
• High-quality multilingual audio commentary by local storytellers, offering cultural and historical insights, highlighting Vox City as a premier audio traveler guide.
• Suggested sightseeing and self-guided tours, allowing exploration at one's pace, making it ideal for those interested in self-guided audio tours.
• Booking and trip management on-the-go, enhancing the functionality of travel apps.
• Access to tours and activities with exclusive discounts and offers, appealing to users searching for the best tour guide app for iPhone.
• Auto-play function for audio commentary at POIs, a feature sought after in audio tour apps.
• Navigation by foot or vehicle with estimated travel time and distance, ensuring a smooth experience for users of digital tour guide apps.
• Offline geo-localization and navigation to avoid roaming charges, a critical feature for travel guide apps.
• Recommended photo locations and free Wi-Fi hotspots, adding value for users of travel apps.
With the Vox City app travel audio guide, travelers can make the most of their trip and discover the hidden wonders of each city they visit. So if you're looking for a unique and unforgettable travel experience, download Vox City today and start exploring your favorite cities like a true local.
Important:
For guidance on app usage, please visit www.voxcity.com.
Disclaimers:
To conserve battery, we recommend using GPS only when necessary. Vox City utilizes location data to provide a seamless experience, automatically playing audio and guiding to nearby POIs.

bluejetty:00121795:ios.description:
Drop in some fun with PAPLINKO!
In PAPLINKO, the goal is to bounce balls into cups, collecting coins and prizes as you go along! It's not all just about collecting prizes though- bouncing off the pegs earns points and careful play will rack up your high score! The balls bounce off multiple pegs, each hit racking up points and changing the ball's path to the bottom. You can carefully aim and shoot each one, but the peg board is constantly shifting, so you'll have to rethink your strategy as you play! Hordes of special pegs shake things up, from bomb pegs to teleporter pegs! Use special multiplier pegs and bonus boxes to make that score grow and grow! Beware, prizes aren't the only things at the bottom- slimes will break your high score if you're not careful! Trade in all the coins you've collected to buy new backgrounds and ball characters to customize your game! Don't worry if you run out of balls, check back later and you'll have more available! 
“Never before have bouncing balls been so hypnotizing!”
“More fun than Angry Birds!”
Fun is just a bounce away!
Features:
- Over 30 prizes to collect!
- Mobile pegs that change as you play!
- Multiple puzzles to complete, with each puzzle set showing a different story!
- Over 25 achievements to complete!
- A huge variety of special bonus effects to collect from the bonus box!
- Combines some of the action you loved in Peggle and Plinko
Check back for new prizes, new customizations and more!
Try other games by Game Circus, including COIN DOZER, PRIZE CLAW and TAPS TO RICHES!

Tone up and see results! Join the best fitness app and community for women. Get access to everything you need to feel strong, confident, and supported.
Whether you’re new to movement or already active, Tone It Up has a program for you. Designed for women’s health, Tone It Up is the daily fitness app built to support your body and mind.
THE BEST WORKOUTS FOR WOMEN 
Varied Styles: Toning, sculpting, yoga, pregnancy, postnatal, strength training, dance, kickboxing, and barre!
1000+ Workouts: From beginner to advanced with full-length follow-along videos.
Nourishing Recipes: Enjoy meal plans and recipes designed to fuel workouts.
Cycle Syncing: Align your training with your menstrual cycle for optimal energy and results.
---------
Subscription Pricing & Terms
Your Tone It Up app is free to download and access. All new customers are welcome to a one-time free trial period of the premium, in-app subscription purchase. Once this period ends, if you opt to continue using the premium features, including the workout videos, we offer auto-renewing subscription options for monthly and annual plans.
Payment will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn auto-renewal off in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. No cancellations or refunds will be provided for any unused portions of a subscription term. Apple charges sales tax for digital media when required by law. For information about your local government's laws on taxing digital items, please contact your tax office.
If you don’t elect to purchase premium features, you can continue using your TIU App for free.
The health and fitness information provided in this app is for general informational purposes only. Please consult with a healthcare professional before starting any diet or exercise program.
User Safety and Moderation Policy
Tone It Up maintains a zero-tolerance policy toward objectionable content and abusive users. To ensure a safe community environment:
Users may report any content or behavior that violates our community standards. Reports and requests for content removal can be submitted 24/7 through our dedicated Support Portal at: https://toneitup.uvdesk.com/en/customer/create-ticket/
24-Hour Action: We are committed to reviewing and responding to all safety reports and removing violating content within 24 hours of receipt.
Strict Enforcement: Any user who violates these community guidelines or engages in abusive behavior will be subject to immediate removal from the platform and permanent termination of their account.
Please read our full Terms and Conditions at https://my.toneitup.com/pages/terms-and-conditions and our Privacy Policy at https://my.toneitup.com/pages/privacy-policy

Features:

bluejetty:00073090:ios.description:
Blood Oxygen SpO₂ Tracker presents existing blood oxygen (SpO₂) readings from Apple Health on iPhone and Apple Watch. Review the latest available value, spot trends, and understand your history in a focused interface.
Features:
• Latest available SpO₂ reading on iPhone and Apple Watch
• History with daily values, 7-day averages, and min/max views
• iPhone widgets and Apple Watch face complications
• Optional notifications for readings below your chosen threshold
• Views for outliers and value distribution
• Barometric pressure and altitude context for personal interpretation
How it works:
The app requests read-only access to Blood Oxygen in Apple Health. To display values, compatible SpO₂ samples must already exist in Apple Health. Blood oxygen measurement availability depends on device and region.
Important:
The app does not measure SpO₂, is not a medical device, and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Information is for general wellness only and is not medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional with health concerns.
Premium:
Some features require Premium, available through auto-renewable monthly or yearly subscriptions or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings, and restore purchases in the app.
Privacy Policy: https://bernhardhering.de/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00068092:ios.description:
Sur La Croix, suivez l’actualité en France et à l’international.
La promesse de La Croix ne réside pas dans le sensationnalisme des actualités brûlantes ni dans un traitement biaisé des événements. Ce qui distingue La Croix, c'est son approche pédagogique de l'actualité : La Croix établit les faits pour restaurer la confiance et rétablir la vérité, donner du sens aux événements et au contexte, prendre du recul avec un regard singulier.
La singularité du contenu de La Croix vous attend sans délai sur notre application et notre site, entièrement repensé autour des axes forts : pédagogie, récit, dialogue.
Fonctionnalités de l’app :
Avec l’application La Croix, profitez chaque jour où que vous soyez de l'essentiel de l'actualité en France et dans le monde :
-Profitez des notifications pour être informé des dernières actualités
-Suivez l’actualité en continu via l’onglet « Direct »
-Accédez au journal et au magazine même hors ligne, en téléchargeant les éditions sur votre téléphone ou tablette
-Gérez votre abonnement et accédez aux avantages abonnés
Sur l’application, profitez des différentes fonctionnalités pensées pour améliorer vos expériences de lecture : le mode « sombre », le choix de la taille de la police pour un réel confort de lecture, votre sélection d’articles à lire plus tard.
L’application La Croix, c’est une interface simplifiée qui s’articule autour de deux onglets : « L’actu » et « le Journal »
L’Actu : vous y retrouverez l’actualité par rubrique : France, International, Économie, Religion, Culture, Planète, Santé, Sport…
La Croix laisse une large place au débat dans sa rubrique A vif pour permettre un approfondissement de l'actualité et sa mise en perspective.
Vous retrouverez également dans le menu les podcasts, les vidéos, les dossiers, et les blogs.
Le Journal :
Vous y retrouverez toutes les éditions numériques dès 20h.
Les commentaires :
Nos articles sont ouverts aux commentaires à toute personne s’étant créé un compte La Croix.
 Abonnement :
L’application propose plusieurs offres d’abonnement à partir de 7,99€/mois (1er mois à 0,99€) sans engagement permettant d’accéder :
-à tous les articles abonnés en illimités,
-au journal quotidien en version numérique dès 20h00,
-au magazine La Croix L’Hebdo,
-à plusieurs comptes simultanés
-aux newsletters premium
Si vous ne souhaitez pas vous abonner mais tout de même faire partie de notre communauté La Croix, vous pouvez créer un compte gratuitement et profiter de nos avantages membres :
-Accès aux articles gratuits
-Mise en favoris de vos contenus préférés
-Espace commentaire
-Réception des notifications
-Choix de vos newsletters
 Note :
 * Si vous téléchargez L’application La Croix depuis l’App Store en dehors de l'Union européenne, le montant de l’abonnement sera converti dans une autre devise selon les tarifs établis par défaut par iTunes.
* Le paiement sera porté à votre compte iTunes.
* L'abonnement va se renouveler automatiquement si vous n'annulez pas au moins 24 heures avant la date de renouvellement.
* Toute partie inutilisée d’une période d’essai gratuite, si elle est offerte, sera abandonnée lorsque l’utilisateur achètera un abonnement.
* Les frais seront portés au compte dans les 24 heures précédant le renouvellement et vous serez informé du coût de la transaction.
* Vous pouvez gérer vos abonnements dans votre compte iTunes et le renouvellement automatique peut être désactivé dans les paramètres du compte.
* Veuillez consulter nos conditions d'utilisation et politiques de confidentialité si vous avez des questions :
http://services.la-croix.com/cgu/cgu.html
https://www.groupebayard.com/fr/politique-de-confidentialite
Retrouvez La Croix sur les réseaux sociaux :
Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/lacroix.journal/
Bluesky : https://bsky.app/profile/la-croix.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/journal.lacroix/
YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/user/lacroixvideo
 A bientôt dans l'application La Croix !

bluejetty:00148736:ios.description:
Chair Workout for Men~Easy Fit is a fitness solution tailored specifically for older adults, offering a series of low-impact chair exercises that help you lose belly fat, build muscle, and stay strong, all from the comfort of your chair. Whether you're just starting your fitness journey or looking for a gentle routine that fits seamlessly into your lifestyle, this app is designed to meet your needs. In just 7 minutes a day, you can transform your body, boost your metabolism, and achieve lasting, visible results—no gym required. The chair-based workouts target fat loss and muscle building simultaneously, helping you sculpt a leaner, more toned body while minimizing strain on your joint.
WHY CHAIR WORKOUT FOR MEN~EASY FIT?
1) Tailored for Men Over 50 - Focused on building strength, flexibility, and balance, all from the comfort of your chair.
2) Gentle Yet Powerful - Low-impact, joint-friendly exercises that reduce back, knee, and joint pain while effectively targeting belly fat and toning muscles.
3) Quick Daily Routines - Short, impactful workouts designed to fit into any schedule, delivering fast, noticeable results.
4) Step-by-Step Guidance - Clear, easy-to-follow instructions and soothing videos, ensuring safe and confident movement throughout.
5) Personalized Workout Plans - Customized routines based on your unique fitness level and goals.
6) Progress Tracker - Stay motivated and celebrate your transformation by tracking milestones along the way.
HOW IT WORKS
· Set Your Goal - Whether it'sweight loss, muscle gain, strength gain, flexibility or recovery.
· Choose Your Focus Area - Target core, arms, pecs, chest, legs, or a full-body routine.
· Enter your personal data - Age, gender, height, weight, fitness level.
· Get Your Personalized Plan - Receive a customized workout based on your age, fitness level, and goals.
· Track Your Progress and stay motivated - Celebrate milestones, from shrinking your waist to building muscle.Daily reminders and easy workouts keep you on track.
Ready to lose fat, build muscle, and get stronger with chair workout? Download now and begin your journey to a stronger, more energized you!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew in your iTunes Account settings. Your iTunes Account will be charged upon confirmation of purchase. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the remainder of the trial period will be forfeited upon confirmation of purchase.
Note: This app is intended for informational purposes only. Always consult your physician or doctor before starting any new fitness program.

bluejetty:00027393:ios.description:
Secret Desires is a private intimacy game for couples curious about what they might both be into — especially the things that feel a little awkward to bring up out of nowhere. A new place. Roleplay. More control. Less control. A fantasy you've thought about but never said out loud. Or maybe something you haven't even thought about yet — you can know someone really well and still have no idea what they'd say yes to.
That's what Secret Desires is for. You take turns on one phone, each swiping privately through cards with intimate ideas, fantasies, scenarios, positions, kinks, and playful things to try — your partner never sees your session, and you never see theirs. Swipe right for Yes, left for No; nothing is revealed until you both say yes to the same card. No awkward confession, no rejection, no need to explain yourself. And if you match? Now you know.
It's meant to feel like a game, not a Serious Conversation About Our Sex Life. You don't need a list of fantasies ready to go — just start swiping and see what catches your attention.
Cards start easy — romantic, playful, teasing — and gradually move toward bolder fantasies, roleplay, toys, BDSM-inspired experiences, and more adventurous themes. You decide how far to go, and you're always free to skip categories that aren't for you.
Every mutual match goes into your shared collection — a private wishlist of things you might want to try together. Pick something for tonight, hit random match, explore guided scenarios, mark what you've tried, and keep discovering as you go.
Maybe you already want the same thing. You just haven't said it yet.

bluejetty:00132899:ios.description:
The army of "Deathless" spread the horrors to every corner of the Nevria, growing amid mutual hostility and suspicion between humans, orcs, and elves.
To save your family from being turned into undead monsters, you embark on an adventure. But as your journey progresses, you discover that thousands of "Deathless" are just pawns in the hands of the Necromancer Balor...
You can summon epic hero combinations from all races and faiths to form your team, take on powerful foes, and discover another dark force cloaked in the shadows as the campaign continues.
Beautiful Fully 3D Fantasy World
Several years of research and development, ultra-realistic 3D graphics and models, and a grand worldview are all packed into this amazing fantasy RPG! 
Unique Heroes & Strategic Game-Play
Form a party by recruiting thousands of Heroes from seven different factions, including Illuminated, Ardent, Vitalus, Eternal, Euda-Anointed, Daeva-Anointed, and Elemental. 
Level up your Heroes, unlock ultimate skills, learn your factional strengths and weaknesses, develop a strategy... and you will crush all the enemies in Ever Legion!
Offline Rewards & Various Side Quests
Are you fed up with overly time-consuming gameplay? Come and enjoy our Mobile Fantasy Idle RPG! Each time you come back to the game, you'll find yourself better able to face the challenges!
With many side quests like the Spirit Realm and the Isle of Mists, you can enjoy epic adventures with Rogue-like elements. 
More fun challenges and rewards are on the way!
PVP Combat & Global Coliseum 
Form a Guild with players from all over the world and defeat Guild Boss to earn great rewards. Compete with adventurers in the global Coliseum to earn a place in the Rankings. 
Fighting for glory! Fight for the champion!
Official Customer Support Email: everlegion@carolgames.com
Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/everlegionEN

bluejetty:00064598:ios.description:
Bienvenido a la Banca Móvil Bankinter. 
Descárgala de forma gratuita y realiza todas las gestiones de tu banco 24h al día. Podrás enviar o solicitar dinero de forma inmediata a tus familiares o amigos y podrás conectarte fácilmente utilizando la huella digital en tu dispositivo. 
Estas son algunas funcionalidades que disfrutarás con nuestra App: 
NAVEGACIÓN INTUITIVA 
Consulta y opera con tus cuentas y tarjetas de manera ágil y sencilla. 
CUENTAS
Consulta todas tus cuentas y tarjetas. Y accede al detalle de todos tus movimientos. 
Realiza de forma ágil las operativas más habituales: domiciliación de recibos, financiación de movimientos,... 
TRANSFERENCIAS 
Podrás realizar transferencias nacionales e internacionales, así como planificar aquellas que sean periódicas. 
Además, podrás consultar tu histórico de movimientos, repetir aquellos que desees y guardar tu justificante. 
BIZUM 
Envía o solicita dinero a quienes desees de forma inmediata. 
También podrás realizar donaciones y pagar la lotería a través de Bizum. 
TARJETAS 
Financia tus compras con tu tarjeta de crédito. Activa y bloquea tu tarjeta o modifica la forma de pago. 
Si lo necesitas, recupera tu PIN en cualquier momento. 
CONTRATACIÓN DE PRODUCTOS 
Con la App también podrás contratar todo tipo de productos como cuentas y tarjetas, depósitos, fondos de inversión y jubilación, así como diversos seguros de salud y hogar. 
También podrás realizar simulaciones de préstamos, depósitos e hipotecas y planificar cómo quedarían tus cuotas de forma muy visual. 
Descarga la App Bankinter y realiza todas tus operaciones sin moverte de casa. 
Si tienes alguna sugerencia o alguna incidencia dentro de la App, escríbenos a Appmovil@bankinter.com 
Más información de los servicios de Bankinter en www.bankinter.es

bluejetty:00148286:ios.description:
Quer conquistar sua habilitação de Arrais ou Motonauta?
O Simulados Arrais e Motonauta foi desenvolvido para quem quer chegar preparado e aumentar suas chances de aprovação nas provas da Marinha do Brasil.
Treine com estratégia, identifique seus erros e evolua com confiança.
Por que escolher este app?
• Simulados no padrão da prova real
• Questões atualizadas
• Modo prova com tempo cronometrado
• Correção com explicações para aprendizado rápido
• Estatísticas para acompanhar sua evolução
• Interface simples, rápida e intuitiva
Estude com inteligência
Descubra exatamente onde você está errando, revise seus pontos fracos e foque no que realmente importa para a prova.
Acompanhe seu progresso
Veja seu desempenho, refaça simulados e evolua de forma consistente até se sentir pronto.

Ideal para quem está se preparando para a prova de Arrais Amador ou Motonauta, seja iniciante ou em fase final de estudo, além de escolas náuticas que desejam apoiar seus alunos.
Baixe agora e comece a treinar hoje mesmo.

Oferecemos compras dentro do app para desbloquear recursos adicionais.
As assinaturas renovam automaticamente ao final de cada período, a menos que a renovação automática seja desativada nas configurações da App Store com pelo menos 24 horas de antecedência.

bluejetty:00130003:ios.name: Champions of Avan - Idle RPG
bluejetty:00130003:ios.summary:
The fate of Avan is yours to write.
From small acorns great oaks grow. In this idle miner game you start with a small and humble village, tucked away in a shadowy corner of the land of Rokmyer, and are tasked with building it up into a gr
bluejetty:00130003:ios.description:
The fate of Avan is yours to write.
From small acorns great oaks grow. In this idle miner game you start with a small and humble village, tucked away in a shadowy corner of the land of Rokmyer, and are tasked with building it up into a grand and prosperous city deserving of a place of pride on both the map of the land and in the pages of history books.
Starting with just a few units at your disposal, source the materials you need to build bigger and better, loot the gold required to afford grander structures and slay those who dare stand in your way. This is the town of Avan and, with the right balance of wisdom and ambition, you could grow it into something great. 
Collect resources to grow your city!
A small kingdom or a colossal empire? In this idle mining game you can grow your town into either, or anything else you dream of! With diverse resources such as wood, stone and gold at your disposal, as well as a wealth of medieval technology, the only thing holding you back is your own ambition.
Conquer enemies!
Deadly enemies, like the vicious Mountain Sentinels and the terrifying Dragonling Mother, dominate the land. They won’t go down without a fight so, to get your hands on their gold, you’ll need to brandish the best weapons and wear the strongest armor as you march into one epic battle after another!
Recruit and personalize your heroes!
In this action RPG you will encounter incredible heroes and recruit them into your roster! From the gung-ho Inyen to the creepy Xaphan to the mysterious Ayabe, they all have unique ways of aiding your progress- bringing exciting levels of depth and strategy to the genre of ‘idle game.’
Explore distant lands!
Your village is part of Rokmyer, a world full of resources for you to collect and take advantage of. From lakes and swamps to mountain valleys and shadowy forests, they all have assets for the taking- but not without trial, challenge and combat. This is a mining game where the fate of an entire city is in your hands, so pray you can face the darkness that this world will throw your way...
New and fresh ideas, diverse idle gameplay, and monsters that will make your skin crawl- Champions of Avan is an adventure that has it all. Grow your village, become a top collector of RPG heroes, and do whatever else it takes to build a legacy.

bluejetty:00095053:ios.description:
People playground meets a floating sandbox games in this realistic water physics simulation!
This water physics sandbox games lets you experiment with realistic fluid behavior, sink ships by using bomb explosions, and enjoy a ragdoll people playground built to simulate destruction.
Features:
Water Simulation & Powder Game
- Simulate liquids like lava, petrol, oil, nitro, viruses, fireworks, and more – each with unique behaviors.
- Enjoy a beautiful underwater sandbox games with up to 200,000 water particles.
Ragdoll & People Playground
- Discover the many unpredictable outcomes of ragdoll experiments!
- Use virus liquids to infect them or make them go crazy with chemicals & mods.
- Realistic gore ragdoll playground: they can walk, drown, burn, or react to your experiments.
Ship Sinking Simulator & Floating Sandbox
- Build ships from scratch or choose from pre-built ones like cargo ships, submarines, and even the Titanic.
- Test their strength against waves, bombs, stormworks, floods, or tsunamis.
- Watch ships float, sink, burn, or explode in realistic fashion.
- The inbuilt ship sinking simulator is very sophisticated
- Includes 50+ pre-built experiments and machines to explore.
- Build and test your own ships, vehicles, titanic clones, tanks rockets and share mods in the new online workshop.
- Construct using different materials like wood, rubber or stone.
Gore Sandboxels & Destruction Simulator
- Use explosives like nukes, grenades, and rockets to smash anything.
- Unleash god-powers like airstrikes, tsunamis, stormworks, floods or firestorms.
- Choose among an arsenal of weapons to wreak havoc against your subjects!
Alchemy, Fire & Physics Sandbox

If you like relaxing and fun casual games, and want to show your creativity, this is definitely your best choice! This casual game that combines brain-burning and creativity will take you to experience the fun of pouring water from bottles, and also allow you to fully display your decoration talents in your own virtual room. ● Each level has been carefully designed, and the difficulty gradually increases, testing your logical thinking and patience!
Room decoration: create a unique space
After completing the bottle challenge, you can unlock unique decorative items to dress up your own virtual room!
● From simple modern to retro style, you can freely match furniture, wallpaper, floor and other elements.
● Show your design talent and create a unique and personalized space!

● Global leaderboard: Challenge other players and compete for the throne of the world's number one!
● Local leaderboard: compete with your friends to see who is the real bottle master!
Whether it is the high score record of bottle pouring water or the creative score of room decoration, there is a place for you on the leaderboard!
Why choose us?
● Easy to use: No complicated operation is required, you can enjoy the game anytime and anywhere.
● Rich content: Not only the brain-burning levels of bottle pouring water, but also the infinite possibilities of room decoration gameplay.
● Social interaction: Interact with other players through the leaderboard to inspire more inspiration!
Whether you want to relax or find an intellectual challenge, this game can bring you endless fun! Start your bottle and home journey now!

bluejetty:00016553:ios.description:
I am City Hero is a Tower Defense game that combines Strategy, Action and Role Playing.
The whole city has been suffered from evil ghost’s attack. It’s time to protect the city and fight against the evil enemies! Grabbing your weapons to shoot, building towers to defense, using special skill to wipe out enemy, creating base to resist attacks, recruiting hero to fight! Everyone can be a hero!
*****How to Play***** 
You can choose different feature turrets and traps to fight against the ghost enemies. Of course, the “key man” is Sam. You can slay specters by controlling the little warrior Sam to shoot and use powerful skills. But the enemies are not so easy to be defeated. Each boss has his own special skill so you have to strategic select different combination when you meet different ghost army.
*****Features***** 
- Combined Tower Defense (TD), Strategy, Action and Role Playing elements
- Use visual joystick to control Sam to move and fight
- Multiple game mode designed, get endless clash fun in this tower defense game
- 12 special traps and defense towers designed, customize your strategy
- Talent and Rune System help you get stronger
- 33 bosses to defeat, each one sporting unique skills and powers
- Over 8 abilities to get! Select them properly to get victory
- Keep a sharp eye on the hidden items and helping hands. They can help you turn the tide
Build a defensive line with your powerful towers and defend your city. Pay special attention on strategy to make a best combination! Enjoy your clash fight in I am City Hero!

bluejetty:00078394:ios.description:
Authenticator App by KeyGuard is the ultimate free authenticator app for managing two-factor authentication (2FA) and multi-factor authentication (MFA) on your iPhone and iPad. Protect your online accounts, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Microsoft, Roblox, and thousands more, with secure 2FA codes. Whether you're securing emails, social media, or financial accounts, KeyGuard Authenticator App is your trusted solution for reliable and free two-factor authentication. Download today on your iPhone or iPad and take control of your online security!
Why Choose KeyGuard?
KeyGuard goes beyond basic two-step verification. It’s a comprehensive tool for managing your 2FA codes, passwords, and digital security. Whether you need an authenticator app, password manager with autofill, or a built-in VPN, KeyGuard App delivers unmatched convenience and peace of mind.
Key Features:
Two-Factor Authentication (2FA):
Protect your accounts with time-based codes (OTP, TOTP). Works seamlessly with Google, Facebook, Microsoft, Instagram, and more.
Password Manager with Autofill:
Securely store, organize, and autofill your passwords. Generate strong, unique passwords effortlessly.
Encrypted Backups:
Keep your 2FA codes and passwords safe with end-to-end encrypted iCloud backups.
Cross-Device Sync:
Access your 2FA codes and passwords across iPhone, iPad, and other Apple devices in real time.
Offline Access:
Generate 2FA codes even without an internet connection, ensuring constant protection.
Advanced Security Options:
Lock your app with Touch ID, Face ID, or a secure PIN to ensure only you can access your data.
Built-In VPN Protection:
Secure your internet connection and browse safely with an integrated VPN.
Getting Started is Easy:
- Log in to the account you want to secure (e.g., Google, Facebook, Amazon).
- Go to the account's security settings and enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).
- Select the “Authentication App” option.
- Scan the QR code using KeyGuard App.
- Enter the generated code to confirm setup.
- Enable encrypted backups for added peace of mind.
Your Data, Fully Protected
KeyGuard Authenticator App uses end-to-end encryption to secure your sensitive information, ensuring only you can access it—even when it’s stored in the cloud. With offline access, secure backups, and cross-device sync, staying safe has never been easier.
Compatible with Thousands of Services
Secure your favorite accounts, including Gmail, Discord, Reddit, Twitch, PlayStation, Binance, Coinbase, Shopify, Salesforce, PayPal, LinkedIn and many more.
Download KeyGuard Authenticator App Now!
Take control of your online security today. With features like password manager, VPN, and encrypted backups, KeyGuard App is the ultimate tool for protecting your accounts.
Subscription Details
Upgrade to premium for unlimited tokens, advanced password management, and enhanced VPN protection. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in your App Store settings.
Support & Contact
Need help? Reach out to us anytime at: https://appshub.com.tr/support-authenticator/

bluejetty:00155899:ios.description:

OUTAGE INFORMATION
- Report a power outage
- Check outage status and track restoration progress
- Easy access to view outage maps in your area
ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT

- View your real-time account balance, payment due date, and balance details
- View and download your bill (PDF)

- Make automatic or scheduled payments
- Other ways to pay (credit/debit card, in-person, by phone)
- Switch between multiple accounts
ENERGY USAGE

SETTINGS 
- Enroll in and manage your paperless billing
- Add or delete your bank accounts
- Enroll in and manage billing and outage alerts
*Logging into the SWEPCO app requires an active account that is registered online at SWEPCO.com

bluejetty:00148214:ios.description:
Let this FREE and RELAXING Mahjong Matching game blow your mind!
Daily Mahjong Match is a fun and challenging Exclusive Tile Matching game! Immerse yourself in our latest innovation: a twist of classic mahjong gameplay. Come here and enjoy endless fun with players from all over the world!
Join millions of players all over the world and hear what they say! Senior players say: "Daily Mahjong Match is relaxing & concentrates your mind". Mahjong enthusiasts think it is "A little bit more challenging than your regular Mahjong games".
How to Play:
- Choose a difficulty level from Easy, Normal, and Expert. Sharpen your mind and improve your ability in memory.
- Tap matching mahjong pairs! Find out mahjong tiles on the board with identical images and tap to eliminate them.
- Scan each row carefully! Pairs can be vertical or horizontal.
- Watch for empty cells! There can also be empty cells between the 2 matching tiles.
- Drag a mahjong tile vertically or horizontally to match it with another!
- Clear the board! Try to clear all mahjong tiles on the board to break your record.
Features:
- Exclusive Mahjong Gameplay: Just move mahjong tiles and eliminate tile pairs!
- Designed for Seniors: User-friendly interface, perfect for seniors and Mahjong lovers of all ages.
- Daily Challenge: New content updated every day! Always something new for you to explore!
- Useful Props: Free Hints to help you go further and win!
- Relaxing & No Timer: Focus on relaxing and tile matching at your own pace.
- Offline Mode: No wifi needed! Play ANYWHERE, ANYTIME!
If you're a fan of classic mahjong solitaire or any other matching or puzzle game, Daily Mahjong Match is the ultimate game for you.
Daily Mahjong Match offers a perfect blend of relaxation and challenge. Test your observation skills and complete each game with ease as you immerse yourself in the art of matching!
Download Daily Mahjong Match – the Exclusive classic, fun and challenging tile matching game – FREE today!
Note: This game is a puzzle game that does not contain the gameplay of traditional Mahjong or other types of solitaire or card games. Here "Mahjong" only refers to the visual style of the tiles.

Welcome to the pulse-pounding realm of Hero Tactics—a multiplayer arena where every move shapes your destiny and strategy wins the day! Immerse yourself in the real-time auto-battle arena, rely on your skills, and grasp victory from the jaws of defeat!

- Dynamic Auto-Battle Arenas:
Dive into intense 2-player battles where your every choice matters. Stay on your toes in these 3-minute PvP contests as you strategically deploy your deck, counter your opponents, and claim victory!
- Strategic Depth:
There are no weaker or stronger heroes, only unique traits and skills. From the Dark Arrow's long-range attacks to the Hammerfury's close-quarters devastation, it's down to you to craft a strategy that outwits, outplays, and conquers!
In this immersive strategy game inspired by the best elements of the genre, skilled players know that every action counts. They merge identical heroes, leverage unique abilities, and craft synergies that outshine the competition.

Challenge players worldwide in head-to-head 2-player battles, prove your tactical prowess, and dominate the online leaderboards. Show that your strategies in the arena are unmatched, and earn your place among the legends!
- Trophy Road:
Clash against others in the multiplayer PvP to climb the Trophy Road and unlock new arenas, heroes, and strategic opportunities. Every win propels you further and grants new and unique challenges. Can you reach the pinnacle and become the true tactician of Hero Tactics?
- Constant Evolution:
Hero Tactics is a living, breathing battlefield. Regular game updates bring new heroes, arenas, and features, creating an ever-changing strategic landscape. Stay tuned for exciting challenges and rewards!
Now is the time to command your team to victory. Download Hero Tactics now and become the strategist this world deserves!

Quer saber mais sobre o novo app Drogarias Tamoio?

Conheça todas as vantagens que o novo app pode proporcionar para você:

 - Ofertas e condições exclusivas

E aí, o que você está esperando?

Baixe o novo app Drogarias Tamoio e aproveite todas as vantagens que uma farmácia online oferece!

bluejetty:00174651:ios.description:
Capture, Share & Relive Your Adventures with Journo! Imagine having a beautifully crafted travel journal that combines your words, photos, videos, and maps into one seamless experience. With Journo, you can document your entire journey — whether it's a weekend getaway, a family vacation, or a global adventure — and share it with the world!
Journo is more than just a journal — it's your personal travel companion. Effortlessly write, publish, and print your adventures—so you can relive your memories for years to come.
WHY CHOOSE JOURNO TODAY?
• Track Your Journey on Custom Maps: Whether you’re traveling the world or taking a road trip, our custom maps help you visualize your adventure. See your entire route unfold as you travel.
• Capture Every Moment: Don’t just write about your journey — document it. Add photos, videos, and notes on the go, and let Journo automatically tag where you were. Never forget a sunset, meal, or special moment again.
• Turn Memories into a Work of Art: With our ‘automagical’ layout feature, you can print your Journo as a stunning coffee table book or map. It’s more than a journal — it’s a keepsake to treasure forever.
• Collaborate with Friends & Family: Create shared Journos with your travel companions. Everyone can add their own notes, photos, and experiences. Capture the trip from every perspective in one shared story.
• Go Offline Anytime: No signal? No problem. Journo works offline, so you can journal from anywhere. Once you’re connected again, we’ll sync everything for you automatically. Never worry about losing a moment.
• Publish & Share Online: Share your Journo with friends or the public on your own dedicated web page. No need for anyone to download the app — they can experience your adventures from any browser.
PERFECT FOR ANY KIND OF JOURNEY
Journo isn't just for long trips — use it for day trips, weekend escapes, family vacations, or even daily reflections. Whether you're an adventurer, travel blogger, or someone who just wants to capture life's moments, Journo makes it easy.
REAL USERS, REAL STORIES
“Simply the best travel diary/journal app out there! We sailed 4,500 miles from the UK to the Med, and Journo was perfect for recording and sharing our journey. Highly recommended!” – APMlondon
“I’ve tried many apps, but Journo is exactly what I needed. It’s user-friendly, easy to load pictures, and the map feature helps me see my entire journey.” – Tabblite1
“Journo made it so simple to capture beautiful moments while traveling. I love sharing my adventures with friends and family, and Journo’s layout is perfect for that.” – Bethie is me
“I love this app! So easy to use and I’m thrilled with how it captured my adventure on a three-week Mediterranean cruise. Can’t wait to use it again on my next trip!” – inazip
“This app is perfect for documenting travels with photos and maps. I’ve used it daily on my 6-month trip around Australia, and it’s been an awesome way to keep friends and family updated.” – Rordale
TRUSTED BY THE TRAVEL COMMUNITY
• Awarded "Best Travel App" by IMA Awards
• “Journo makes sharing trip memories easy and fun.” – National Geographic Travel
• “Perfect for creating lasting memories.” – The Gadget Flow
UNLOCK THE POWER OF JOURNO
With Journo, you're not just documenting a trip — you're creating a legacy. Whether it’s the photos of breathtaking landscapes, funny moments with loved ones, or a thoughtful note you jot down while sipping coffee in a foreign city, every memory is preserved perfectly. And with our printing options, these memories become tangible keepsakes.
WE'D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU
Have questions or feedback? We’re always eager to hear your thoughts on Journo. Feel free to reach out to us at support@journohq.com!
Download Journo now and start turning your adventures into timeless stories!
Terms of Service - https://www.journohq.com/terms

bluejetty:00096059:ios.name: Friend Controls: Screen Time
bluejetty:00096059:ios.summary:
Friend Controls is the screen time app that actually works. Set your daily limits, and when time runs out, your real friends decide if you get more. No algorithms. No willpower tricks. Just real social accountability.
Unlike every other sc
bluejetty:00096059:ios.description:
Friend Controls is the screen time app that actually works. Set your daily limits, and when time runs out, your real friends decide if you get more. No algorithms. No willpower tricks. Just real social accountability.
Unlike every other screen time app you have tried, Friend Controls puts your friends in charge. The result? Users reduce screen time by an average of 60%.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Download and choose which apps you want to limit.
2. Set your daily screen time for each app.
3. Invite friends to be your buddies.
4. When your time runs out, the app locks. Want more? Send a request to your friends.
5. Your friends see your request and decide: approve or deny. No mercy required.
That is it. Simple, social, and surprisingly effective.
KEY FEATURES
App Blocking That Works: Choose any app on your phone to restrict. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, games, dating apps, or anything else draining your hours.
Real Friend Accountability: Your friends are not bots or timers you can snooze. They are real people who can say no.
Request and Approve System: Run out of time? Send a plea to your Controllers. Make your case. Accept their judgment.
Usage Tracking: See exactly how much time you spend on each app. Daily, weekly, and monthly breakdowns so you can track your progress.
Focus and Study Mode: Block distracting apps during study sessions, work hours, or any time you need to concentrate.
Privacy First: We do not sell your data. We do not track what you do inside apps. We only monitor time spent so your friends can help you stay on track.
WHO IS THIS FOR?
Students who need to focus during exam season. Couples who want to spend less time on their phones together. Friends who want to hold each other accountable. Anyone who has tried every screen time app and failed. People who know they waste hours every day but cannot stop on their own.
THE SCIENCE BEHIND IT
Research shows that social accountability is one of the most powerful behavior change tools. When someone else is watching, you try harder. Friend Controls takes that principle and puts it in your pocket.
Download now and take back your time. Your friends are waiting to help.
PRIVACY
Friend Controls uses Apple's ScreenTime API. All your monitoring and blocking run on your device. Your browsing data does not leave your phone
TERMS OF USE
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
**App blocking feature requires a purchase if you choose to block more than 1 app. All other features are free.**

bluejetty:00143449:ios.description:
Just got engaged and have no idea how to plan a wedding? Let’s fix that! Bridebook is a wedding planning app where you can manage your to-do list, budget, guest list, search for venues all over the world, and much more.
From a wedding specific checklist to a guest list tool, we’ve got “everything you need to plan your dream wedding” (Brides Magazine) as soon as you get engaged. With over 1.9 million weddings already planned on Bridebook, we know exactly how to get you your dream day. After all, there’s a reason we’re “the highest-rated wedding app in the world” (The Telegraph)!
With Bridebook, you’ll have access to:
- Venue Search: Find and book your ideal wedding venue with our extensive directory
- Destination Wedding: Search for venues around the world to find the perfect place for your destination wedding
- Checklist: Keep your wedding planning on track with your personalised Checklist
- Countdown: Count down the days until you say “I do!”
- Budget: Unlock your unique budget breakdown and track your spending with our expert Budget Planner
- Guest List: Manage your Guest List, including RSVPs, +1s and dietary requirements
- Expert Advice: Get advice and inspiration from our team of top wedding experts
- Collaborator: Link your account with your partner to plan together
Ready to tie the knot? Join hundreds of brides and grooms to be who’ve already ditched their spreadsheets and downloaded Bridebook. Together, we’ll have your wedding sorted quicker than you can say, “I do!”
Read the Terms of Use here:
https://bridebook.com/terms
Read the Privacy Policy here:
https://bridebook.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00172348:ios.description:
myFilms - Explore the World of Movies & IPTV at Your Fingertips 
Do you want to watch live TV anytime, anywhere? Are you a movie enthusiast who wants to stay updated with the latest releases? myFilms is the perfect app that lets you enjoy both IPTV and movies, all in one convenient platform on your device. 
Main Features: 
- Live IPTV Streaming: Watch IPTV channels directly in the app. Supports Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode and background playback, even when your screen is off. Enjoy your favorite shows without interruption. 
- Latest Movie Updates: With myFilms, you'll never miss a movie. The app provides information on the latest films and TV series. Check showtimes, community reviews, and receive notifications about movies you’re interested in. 
- Movie Collection: Create your own watchlist and rate movies. myFilms allows you to build a personal collection to track the movies you’ve watched and those you plan to see. 
- Detailed Actor Information: Not only can you find information about movies, but you can also explore details about actors, including their careers, popularity, and filmography. 
- Search for Movies and Actors: Easily search for movies by title, actor name, or even keywords related to the film's content. 
- Movie Tracking Options: Follow any movie with myFilms to stay updated with the latest news and information about it. 
Why Choose myFilms? 
myFilms is the perfect companion for all movie and TV lovers. With this app, you can browse through thousands of movies, learn more about actors, explore engaging IPTV content, and stay up to date with the ever-changing world of entertainment. 
Download myFilms today and experience the convenience and excitement of discovering movies & IPTV right at your fingertips!
