bluejetty:00152005:ios.description:
Globy‘s Quiz Voyage - Master Cultural Before You Travel
Discover the world's hidden cultural rules and avoid embarrassing mistakes with GlobysQuizVoyage, the ultimate cultural awareness quiz app that prepares you for authentic global experiences.
Why GlobysQuizVoyage?
Every culture has unspoken rules that can make or break your travel experience. From accidentally offending locals in Japan by sticking chopsticks upright in rice, to unknowingly disrespecting elders in African communities, cultural missteps can turn dream vacations into uncomfortable situations. GlobysQuizVoyage transforms cultural learning into an engaging quiz adventure that builds your global cultural intelligence.
Comprehensive Global Coverage
Explore cultural taboos and etiquette across all 7 continents with over 300 carefully researched questions covering:
Asia: Navigate complex social hierarchies, religious customs, and dining etiquette from Japan to India
Europe: Master regional differences from Scandinavian social norms to Mediterranean hospitality
North America: Understand diverse cultural landscapes from indigenous traditions to modern urban customs
South America: Respect indigenous heritage and colonial influences across diverse nations
Africa: Appreciate traditional governance, religious diversity, and community values
Oceania: Learn Pacific island protocols and environmental conservation ethics
Antarctica: Understand international cooperation and extreme environment protocols
Smart Learning Features
15-Second Challenge: Quick-fire questions keep you engaged while building knowledge efficiently
Detailed Explanations: Every answer includes comprehensive cultural context explaining the "why" behind customs
Achievement System: Track your cultural expertise across continents and unlock new knowledge milestones
Beautiful Gradient Design: Immersive visual experience that makes learning enjoyable
Progress Tracking: Monitor your cultural awareness growth with detailed statistics
Real-World Impact
GlobysQuizVoyage isn't just trivia—it's practical preparation for meaningful cultural exchange. Learn essential knowledge like:
Proper greeting customs and gift-giving etiquette
Religious site protocols and dress codes
Business meeting behaviors and social hierarchies
Dining customs and food-related taboos
Photography restrictions and privacy norms

Why GlobysQuizVoyage?

Every culture has unspoken rules that can make or break your travel experience. GlobysQuizVoyage transforms cultural learning into an engaging quiz adventure that builds your global cultural intelligence.

Your next vacation is ready and waiting for you in this new match-3 experience!
Play Tropic Trouble today!

bluejetty:00021576:ios.description:
Design beautiful invitation cards effortlessly. Choose from 10,000+ templates and manage event RSVPs all in one place.
Looking to invite guests to your wedding, birthday party, baby shower, or corporate event with stunning invitations? Our Invitation Maker app helps you design professional cards in minutes — even if you've never designed before.

- 30,000+ ready-to-use templates designed for weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, baby showers, and 500+ events & festivals
- Customize easily with fonts, stickers, backgrounds, borders & decorative elements
- Add your photos, event details, and personal touches to every invitation

Smart RSVP & Guest Management
Our app goes beyond just creating invitations with powerful guest management features:
Built-in RSVP Tracking – Collect guest responses directly through your digital invitations
Guest List Management – Track who's attending, dietary preferences, and plus-ones in one place
Automated Reminders – Send follow-up messages to guests who haven't responded
Real-time Updates – See RSVPs as they come in and manage your guest count effortlessly
AI Tools for Effortless Design

QR Code Generator – Add scannable QR codes for event details, venue maps, or gift registries
Clickable Links in PDFs – Insert links to your event website, RSVP form, registry, or venue directions that work when your PDF invitation is opened
Fast, Simple & Professional
- Choose a template that matches your event
- Customize with text, photos, event details, and colors
- Enable RSVP tracking and guest management
- Add clickable links for venue maps, registries, or event websites
- Export or share directly via email, WhatsApp, social media, or print
Beautiful invitations made easy. Choose from 10,000+ templates and track RSVPs effortlessly.
Make Every Invitation Special
Download the Invitation Maker app today and start designing cards that excite your guests and set the perfect tone for your celebration.

MAKING CREATIVE DESSERTS
Rainbow popsicle, smoothie with pearls, colorful fruity mix, hot air balloon ice cream, and ice cream in a chocolate bowl. You can make all of the top 5 creative desserts in the ice cream truck. Be creative and make your own ice cream! 
USING VARIOUS PROPS
There are all kinds of ingredients and DIY tools you can use in the ice cream truck! Eggs, strawberries, candies, blenders...60 kinds of ingredients, 90 kinds of toppings, and more than 50 tools to help you create 100 flavors of desserts!

You may upgrade your ice cream truck by making more ice creams and selling to more customers. Kids, let's get to work!

- Make 5 kinds of fancy ice cream desserts. 
- Bananas, yogurt, chocolate...60 kinds of ingredients available. 
- Blender, eggbeater, refrigerator...Choose from more than 50 tools for easy operation. 
- Lollipops, marshmallows, cookies...90 kinds of snacks available to decorate the ice cream dessert. 
- 2 kinds of ice cream trucks available: Dreamy blue or lovely pink.

bluejetty:00068354:ios.description:
Catalog your entire home library in an afternoon. Snap a photo of any shelf
and the AI adds every title. No typing, no spreadsheets, no scattered notes. 
Trusted by 600+ readers and rated 4.1 stars on the App Store since 2011. 
• Catalog a 200-book shelf in five minutes. Point your camera. AI reads the 
spines and adds the books. 
• Add a single book in seconds by scanning the barcode on the back cover. 
• Bring your Kindle library across in one tap. No CSV juggling. 
• Find anything in plain English. "That biography about the architect" works. 
• AI sorts your shelves by genre, mood, and theme so you stop tagging by hand.
• Read on iPhone, edit on iPad, look something up offline at the bookstore. 
Sync handles the rest. 
How it works: 
1. Point your camera at a shelf and let AI populate your library.
2. Sort, tag, and mark books as Read, Reading, or To Read. 
3. Pick up on any device. Share with friends, join a club, ask for a
recommendation when you want one. 
Coming from another app or a spreadsheet? Import CSV, TSV, JSON, XLSX, BibTeX,
or RIS files. Field mapping is built in. 
Real review: 
"I had a bunch of books I needed to inventory and the barcode scanner made it
incredibly easy. Great app." 
BuckeyeCityCates, App Store review, 2024 
Free to start with twenty books and three barcode scans. Open the app and add 
your first shelf. 
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. 
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24
hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for 
renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage
and cancel your subscriptions in your Account Settings on the App Store after
purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when purchasing a
subscription.

bluejetty:00070595:ios.name: Hospital Escape Room Horror
bluejetty:00070595:ios.summary: Are you brave enough to become a character in a creepy thriller? Prove it! Set off on new scary escape adventures and try to survive. You’ll have to search dark rooms, solve scary puzzles, and open doors to find a way out and end this night
bluejetty:00070595:ios.description:
Are you brave enough to become a character in a creepy thriller? Prove it! Set off on new scary escape adventures and try to survive. You’ll have to search dark rooms, solve scary puzzles, and open doors to find a way out and end this nightmare. Overcome your terror and escape from horror hospital conceals!
INTRIGUING PLOT:
You wake up in a creepy place that looks like an abandoned hospital or a horrifying mental asylum. How did you get here? You have no idea! The last thing you remember is getting drunk in some bar. God, can you find out what’s going on in this place and get out of here alive? 
BEST FEATURES:
▪ Thrilling atmosphere of horror escape games
▪ Spine-tingling sound effects and good graphics *bloodcurdling in headphones*
▪ Challenging puzzles and mini-games
▪ Point and click adventure with many secrets and clues
▪ Simple controls and free hints
Challenge yourself with this atmospheric horror game. Rack your brains, collect all the hidden clues and use logic to solve those puzzles, brain teasers, and mysteries. Feel the primal fear that horror hospital can strike. Stay focused, ignore your goosebumps, find out how to escape room by room and win the scary game.
You’ll see creepy rooms of a mental hospital, immerse into complete darkness, try to find the light and tools that help you escape and go further. You may have to search those rooms twice, try to get information from psychos and dying lunatics, bring them what they want, and solve the mystery piece by piece, feel true fear.
If you’re into thrillers and horror quests, puzzling adventures or scary games with interesting plots, you’ll enjoy this horror escape game about the abandoned hospital of horror.

bluejetty:00021992:ios.name: IMAIOS e-Anatomy
bluejetty:00021992:ios.summary: IMAIOS e-Anatomy is an atlas of human anatomy for physicians, radiologists, medical students and radiology technicians. Get a sneak peek at more than 26 000 medical and anatomical images for free before subscribing to our detailed atlas of
bluejetty:00021992:ios.description:
IMAIOS e-Anatomy is an atlas of human anatomy for physicians, radiologists, medical students and radiology technicians. Get a sneak peek at more than 26 000 medical and anatomical images for free before subscribing to our detailed atlas of human anatomy.
e-Anatomy is based on the award-winning IMAIOS e-Anatomy online atlas. Carry with you the most complete reference of human anatomy, wherever you go, on your mobile device or tablet.
e-Anatomy has over 26 000 images containing series of images in axial, coronal and sagittal views as well as radiography, angiography, dissection pictures, anatomical charts and illustrations. All medical images were carefully labeled, more than 967 000 labels available in 12 languages including the Latin Terminologia Anatomica.
(More details on: https://www.imaios.com/en/e-Anatomy)
Features: 
- Scroll through image sets by dragging your finger
- Zoom in and out
- Tap labels to display anatomical structures
- Select anatomical labels by category
- Easily locate anatomical structures thanks to the index search
- Multiple screen orientations
- Switch languages at the touch of a button
The subscription also gives you access to e-Anatomy on IMAIOS website.
e-Anatomy is an atlas of anatomy continuously being improved: updates and new module are part of the subscription!
Additional downloads are required for full use of the application.
The medical information on this application is provided as a tool and reference for use by licensed medical professionals, competent healthcare professionals and no others, it does not and should not be construed as any form of medical diagnosis or professional medical advice on any matter.
About module activation.
IMAIOS e-Anatomy has three methods of activation for our different users:
1) IMAIOS members who have access provided by their university or library, may use their user account to enjoy full access to all modules. However, an internet connection is periodically required to verify their user account.
2) Users who have purchased the modules in previous versions of IMAIOS e-Anatomy can use the ""Restore"" feature to activate all previously purchased content. You will not be charged again and the content available by the time of your purchase is permanently accessible offline.
3) New users are invited to subscribe to e-Anatomy. All modules and features will be active for a limited period of time. Subscriptions will be automatically renewed so that they can enjoy continuous access to e-Anatomy.
Additional auto-renewable subscription Information:
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions and auto-renewals may be turned off by going to the user's account settings on the App Store after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
The screenshots are part of the full e-Anatomy application with all modules enabled.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use 
- https://www.imaios.com/en/privacy-policy
- https://www.imaios.com/en/conditions-of-access-and-use"

bluejetty:00069508:ios.summary: A large-scale disaster strikes while you’re at work. The roads are clogged, communications are down. Do you have a plan of action? Do you know how to find your family in the chaos? Do you have what you need to make it back home safely?
bluejetty:00069508:ios.description:
A large-scale disaster strikes while you’re at work. The roads are clogged, communications are down. Do you have a plan of action? Do you know how to find your family in the chaos? Do you have what you need to make it back home safely? Disasters, whether man-made or natural present a whole different set of challenges in urban environments.
RECOIL OFFGRID takes a fresh look at these and other emergency-related scenarios from the URBAN/CITY dweller’s point of view. We speak to experts about what to do to stay alive and how. Plus, we feature products, equipment and supplies that all urbanites should use. Topics covered in the magazine include survival gear, food preparation, medical care, protection, and communications, as well as prepping your home and vehicle.

This Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. The cost of the renewal will match the initial subscription price.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00027592:ios.description:
RemoteLink 2 provides you with discreet, improved control over your hearing aids – so you can personalise your listening experience for any environment, find your hearing aids if they become lost, get remote support from your hearing care professional when you need it, and much more.
Certain app features may require a specific hearing aid model or a firmware update. Please consult your hearing care professional for assistance with firmware updates.
With RemoteLink 2, you can:
• Adjust the volume of your hearing aids and various settings (e.g. remote microphone, noise reduction, and sound and streaming equalizer)
• Switch between predefined programs according to the different listening situation you are in
• Monitor your battery levels
• Help you find your hearing aids if you lose them
• Use SpeechBooster to reduce background noise and enhance speech when you need to focus on conversation. 
• Use your device as a remote microphone and get better access to the voice of another speaker in noisy environments
• Customize your surrounding sounds with the sound equalizer
• Set and track hearing aid wear-time goals with the MyDailyHearing feature
• Use the streaming equalizer for a personalized listening experience. 
• Have your hearing aids adjusted and receive counseling from the comfort of your own home – via a live video call with your hearing care professional
• Handle wireless accessories paired with your hearing aids; control multiple TV Adapters or devices, such as EduMic or ConnectClip, which can be used both for streaming and as a remote microphone
• Connect to and adjust an Auracast™ broadcast (available with select hearing aids)
• Get reminders to replace your wax filters to maintain sound quality (available with select hearing aids)
• Reduce background noise while streaming with Streaming comfort (available with select hearing aids)
First use:
You need to pair your hearing aids with this app to use it to control your hearing aids. 
For optimal performance, we recommend updating your device to iOS 18 or later.

apple-macos:792864867.name: Le VPN: Fast & Secure
apple-macos:792864867.description:
Le VPN for iPhone and iPad protects you on any WiFi network and keeps what you do online private. Pick one of our VPN servers in 100+ locations, tap Connect, and you browse with that server's IP address over an encrypted connection. Enjoy the Internet by Your Own Rules!
Change your IP address to 100+ locations
Le VPN gives your device the IP address of any of our VPN servers, in 100+ locations. Websites and apps then see the server's location instead of yours. The servers are fast, and encryption protects the connection on every WiFi network.
One tap to connect
Choose a country and tap "Connect". From that moment the app encrypts everything your iPhone or iPad sends and receives. Your favorite servers stay at the top of the list, and you can switch to another server without disconnecting first.
Stealth mode for restricted networks
Some networks block or slow down VPN connections. Stealth mode disguises your VPN traffic so that it gets through. It has three levels, and you choose one in the VPN settings of the app.
Block ads while you browse
The Ad Blocker removes ads from websites and apps before they load: while the VPN is on, Le VPN's own DNS servers drop the requests that ads come from. Nothing to install, nothing to configure, one switch in the menu.
More than a VPN connection
• Threat Protection blocks malware and phishing websites.
• Automatic VPN reconnection brings the VPN back when your network changes.
• "Test your IP" shows your current IP address, its location and whether you are protected.
• A live traffic graph shows what you download and upload while connected.
• The globe on the main screen shows the location of your server.
• Data Breach Scanner checks known data leaks for your email address and tells you what to do if it turns up.
• Le VPN widgets connect and disconnect from your Home Screen, your Lock Screen and Control Center.
• Bypass VPN for local networks keeps printers and other home devices reachable.
• The app has light and dark themes, comes in 15 languages and fits both iPhone and iPad.
One subscription for all your devices
Le VPN is a paid service, and you need a subscription to use this app. New accounts start with a 7-day free trial. A plan you buy in this app also covers your other devices: desktops, laptops, other phones and tablets, routers, game consoles and smart TVs. On iOS the app connects through WireGuard, IKEv2 or IPSec. OpenVPN is available on other devices.
What every Le VPN plan includes
• Use on an unlimited number of devices.
• 10 VPN connections at the same time.
• Unlimited traffic and bandwidth at high speeds.
• No logs of your online activity.
• Support 24/7, in several languages.
Why choose Le VPN?
• Le VPN has been a VPN provider since 2010 and has protected millions of users around the world.
• We keep no traffic logs, and an email address is the only personal detail we ask for.
• WireGuard, IKEv2 and IPSec encrypt everything between your device and the VPN server.
• On public WiFi in a hotel or an airport, other people on the network cannot read your traffic.
• Websites see the IP address of the VPN server, so your own stays hidden.

• Feed
Share updates, photos, and videos with the Yaar community. Discover conversations and engage with people both locally and around the world.
• Events
Find and share events happening near you. Stay informed about meetups, gatherings, and local activities.
• Stores
Explore businesses and services recommended by the community. Businesses can showcase their offerings and connect directly with users.
• Privacy-Focused Design
Yaar is built to minimize data collection and give users greater control over their personal information and not to use their data against them.
• Community Moderation
Users can report inappropriate content, helping maintain a respectful and safe environment for everyone.
Yaar is designed to bring people closer to their communities without the noise and complexity often found in traditional platforms.
It’s a really great platform for small and medium businesses that don’t have the budget to build a website, pay for hosting, hire a developer, and then bring in a marketing agency for search engine optimization. Instead, they can simply create a store on Yaar, where millions of users can easily discover them.
Discover what’s happening around you, connect with people around the world, and be part of a more meaningful social experience.
